Abathur.title: Pressurized Glands
Abathur.description: Increases the range of Symbiote's Spike Burst by 25% and decreases the cooldown by 1 second.

Abathur.title: Envenomed Nest
Abathur.description: Toxic Nests deal 75% more damage over 3 seconds and reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 10 for 4 seconds.

Abathur.title: Reinforced Carapace
Abathur.description: Increase the Shield amount of Carapace by 40%.

Abathur.title: Survival Instincts
Abathur.description: Increases Locust's Health by 100% and damage by 60%.

Abathur.title: Adrenal Overload
Abathur.description: Heroic Symbiote hosts gain 25% increased Attack Speed.

Abathur.title: Needlespine
Abathur.description: Increases the damage and range of Symbiote's Stab by 20%.

Abathur.title: Prolific Dispersal
Abathur.description: Increase the duration of Toxic Nests by 45 seconds, reduce its cooldown by 2 seconds, and add 2 additional charges.

Abathur.title: Vile Nest
Abathur.description: Toxic Nests Slow enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

Abathur.title: Networked Carapace
Abathur.description: Using Symbiote's Carapace also applies an untalented Carapace Shield to all nearby allied Heroes, Minions, and Mercenaries.

Abathur.title: Calldown: MULE
Abathur.description: Activate to calldown a Mule that repairs Structures, one at a time, near target point for 40 seconds, healing for 90 Health every 1 second.

Abathur.title: Ultimate Evolution
Abathur.description: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

Abathur.title: Evolve Monstrosity
Abathur.description: Turn an allied Minion or Locust into a Monstrosity. When enemy Minions near the Monstrosity die, it gains 2% Health and 2% Basic Attack damage, stacking up to 40 times.  The Monstrosity can be healed by Carapace and has the ability to Burrow to a visible location every 80 seconds.  Using Symbiote on the Monstrosity allows Abathur to control it, in addition to Symbiote's normal benefits.  This Ability can be reactivated to automatically cast Symbiote on his Monstrosity.

Abathur.title: Spatial Efficiency
Abathur.description: Symbiote's Stab gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by .5 seconds.

Abathur.title: Soma Transference
Abathur.description: Symbiote's Spike Burst heals the host for 64 (+4% per level) Health per enemy Hero hit.

Abathur.title: Bombard Strain
Abathur.description: Locust's Basic Attacks become a long-range siege attack and their duration is increased by 75%.

Abathur.title: Envenomed Spikes
Abathur.description: Abathur's Symbiote's Spike Burst also Slows enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2 seconds.

Abathur.title: Adrenaline Boost
Abathur.description: Symbiote's Carapace increases the Movement Speed of the target by 40% for 3.5 seconds.

Abathur.title: Volatile Mutation
Abathur.description: Ultimate Evolution clones and Monstrosities deal 137 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 3 seconds and when they die. Enemy Heroes hit heal the clone or Monstrosity for 100% of the damage dealt.

Abathur.title: Locust Brood
Abathur.description: Activate to spawn 3 Locusts at a nearby location.

Abathur.title: Evolutionary Link
Abathur.description: Increase the duration of Ultimate Evolution by 50%.  As long as the Ultimate Evolution is alive, the original target of the clone gains a Shield equal to 35% of their maximum Health.  Refreshes every 5 seconds.

Abathur.title: Evolution Complete
Abathur.description: Increase Monstrosity's Basic Attack damage by 100%.

Abathur.title: Hivemind
Abathur.description: Symbiote creates an additional Symbiote on a nearby allied Hero.  This Symbiote mimics the commands of the first, but does half damage and Shielding.

Abathur.title: Locust Nest
Abathur.description: Activate to create a nest that periodically spawns Locusts. Only one Locust Nest can be active at a time.

Alarak.title: Overwhelming Power
Alarak.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 40% Attack Speed and causes Basic Attacks to heal for 50% of the damage dealt for 4 seconds.

Alarak.title: Ruthless Momentum
Alarak.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Telekinesis from 30 to 20.  Telekinesis's cooldown recharges 100% faster while above 80% Health.

Alarak.title: Extended Lightning
Alarak.description: Reduce Sadism by 10%.  Quest: Hit Heroes with the center of Lightning Surge.  Reward: After hitting 5 Heroes, increase Lightning Surge's range by 20%.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Lightning Surge's center also Slows enemies by 40% for 2 seconds.  Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with the center of a single cast, increase Sadism by 10% and instantly gain all other Rewards.

Alarak.title: Chaos Reigns
Alarak.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Discord Strike.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, increase Discord Strike's damage by 60.  Reward: After hitting 2 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 60.  Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 100 and instantly gain all other Rewards.

Alarak.title: Negatively Charged
Alarak.description: Increase the Lightning Surge damage bonus to enemies between Alarak and his victim to 175%.  Repeatable Quest: Each Hero hit by the center of Lightning Surge permanently increases the damage bonus by 5%.

Alarak.title: Show of Force
Alarak.description: Heroes hit with 3 of Alarak's Abilities within 2 seconds take an additional 61 (+4% per level) damage and increase Sadism by 2%, stacking up to 20%.   Sadism gained from Show of Force is lost on death.

Alarak.title: Dissonance
Alarak.description: Increase Discord Strike's Silence duration by 0.75 seconds.

Alarak.title: Hindered Motion
Alarak.description: Telekinesis Slows enemies by 30% for 3 seconds.

Alarak.title: Applied Force
Alarak.description: Reduce Sadism by 10%, but Telekinesis pushes 20% further and has 20% increased range.

Alarak.title: Deadly Charge
Alarak.description: After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds.  Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

Alarak.title: Counter-Strike
Alarak.description: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.

Alarak.title: Blade of the Highlord
Alarak.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Sadism by 2% stacking up to 40%.  Sadism gained from Blade of the Highlord is lost on death.

Alarak.title: Pure Malice
Alarak.description: Increase Sadism by 10% any time an allied Hero dies, up to 40%.  Sadism gained from Pure Malice is lost on death.

Alarak.title: Rite of Rak'Shir
Alarak.description: Activate to mark an enemy Hero for 300 seconds.  Hitting the marked Hero with Discord Strike increases Sadism by 3%. Killing the marked Hero increases Sadism by 5% and lowers the cooldown of Rite of Rak'Shir to 10 seconds.  Sadism gained from Rite of Rak'Shir is lost on death.

Alarak.title: Lethal Onslaught
Alarak.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 50% of Sadism's damage bonus to Alarak's Basic Attacks for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh this duration.

Alarak.title: Lightning Barrage
Alarak.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with the center of Lightning Surge allows it to be cast again for free on a different primary target within the next 3 seconds. This free cast cannot benefit from Lightning Barrage.

Alarak.title: Mocking Strikes
Alarak.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Alarak's Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds.  This bonus is doubled against enemy Heroes who are Stunned, Silenced, Slowed, or Rooted.

Alarak.title: Counter-Strike
Alarak.description: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.  This ability will take over Alarak's Trait button.

Alarak.title: Deadly Charge
Alarak.description: After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds.  Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

Alarak.title: Last Laugh
Alarak.description: Activate to teleport to the chosen location and remove all Roots, Slows, and damage over time effects. If Alarak fails to hit enemy Heroes 3 times with Basic Abilities within 4 seconds of using Last Laugh, his Health is reduced to 1.

Alarak.title: Hasty Bargain
Alarak.description: Activate to permanently reduce Alarak's Sadism by 4% and reset the cooldowns of his Basic Abilities.

Alexstrasza.title: Live and Let Live
Alexstrasza.description: While Alexstrasza is above 75% Health, Gift of Life's cooldown recharges 125% faster.

Alexstrasza.title: Circle of Life
Alexstrasza.description: Quest: Collect Regeneration Globes.  Reward: After collecting 10 Regeneration Globes, Abundance heals for an additional 5% maximum Health.  Reward: After collecting 15 Regeneration Globes, Abundance's healing burst creates a Regeneration Globe.

Alexstrasza.title: Flames of Fury
Alexstrasza.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Flame Buffet from 50 to 40.  Quest: Hit 20 Burning Heroes with Flame Buffet.  Reward: Hitting a Burning Hero with Flame Buffet reduces Dragonqueen's cooldown by 5 seconds.

Alexstrasza.title: Surge of Vitality
Alexstrasza.description: Abundance's healing burst grants allied Heroes 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

Alexstrasza.title: Heat Exhaustion
Alexstrasza.description: Increase Flame Buffet's Slow from 40% to 50% and cause it to no longer decay.

Alexstrasza.title: Exuberance
Alexstrasza.description: While above 75% Health, gain 15% Movement Speed.

Alexstrasza.title: Lifeblossom
Alexstrasza.description: While Alexstrasza is above 75% Health, Gift of Life creates a Lifeblossom at the target's location. Alexstrasza can collect the Lifeblossom to make her next Gift of Life cost no Health.  Passive: Reduces the cost of Gift of Life to 10% of Alexstrasza's current Health.

Alexstrasza.title: Verdant Flourish
Alexstrasza.description: Alexstrasza receives 40% more healing from Abundance and 100% more healing from Regeneration Globes.

Alexstrasza.title: Fire Within
Alexstrasza.description: Hitting a Burning Hero with Flame Buffet heals Alexstrasza for 10% of her maximum Health.

Alexstrasza.title: Life-Binder
Alexstrasza.description: Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for 480 (+4% per level) Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.

Alexstrasza.title: Cleansing Flame
Alexstrasza.description: After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal 135 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for 300 (+4% per level) Health.  2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.

Alexstrasza.title: Dragon Scales
Alexstrasza.description: Gain 50 Armor while Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced, and for 2 seconds after. Can only trigger once every 10 seconds.

Alexstrasza.title: Pacify
Alexstrasza.description: Activate to Slow and reduce an enemy Hero's damage by 50% for 3 seconds.  Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Pacify's cooldown by 30 seconds.

Alexstrasza.title: Life Unbound
Alexstrasza.description: Activate to heal an allied Hero for 15% of their maximum Health and deal 200 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Life Unbound's cooldown by 30 seconds.  Cannot be used on Alexstrasza.

Alexstrasza.title: Tough Love
Alexstrasza.description: Gift of Life grants its target 10 Armor for 2.5 seconds, increased to 30 while Alexstrasza is above 75% Health.

Alexstrasza.title: Overprotective
Alexstrasza.description: Heroes healed by Abundance gain a Shield for 6 seconds equal to 70% of the amount healed.

Alexstrasza.title: Draconic Discipline
Alexstrasza.description: Increase Dragonqueen's duration by 6 seconds, and Basic Attack healing by 50%.

Alexstrasza.title: Ritual of Life
Alexstrasza.description: Life-Binder activates 3 times over 6 seconds.

Alexstrasza.title: On Ruby Wings
Alexstrasza.description: Healing or damaging Heroes 8 or more times with Cleansing Flame activates Dragonqueen for 15 seconds upon landing.

Alexstrasza.title: Ancient Flame
Alexstrasza.description: While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Basic Attacks apply Flame Buffet.

Alexstrasza.title: Blessing of the Red
Alexstrasza.description: Activate to grant an allied Hero 500 bonus maximum Health until they die.  Cannot be used on Alexstrasza, or on a Hero who already has Blessing of the Red.

Ana.title: Contact Healing
Ana.description: Hitting Heroes with Biotic Grenade increases its damage and healing by 30% per Hero hit.

Ana.title: Slumber Shells
Ana.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sleep Dart by 2 seconds. Upon waking, enemy Heroes are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds.

Ana.title: Vampiric Rounds
Ana.description: Quest: Stack 5 Doses on an enemy Hero or Basic Attack a Hero with 5 Doses.  Reward: Stack 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 1%.  Reward: Basic Attack a Hero with 5 Doses to increase Shrike's healing by 0.25%.

Ana.title: Biotic Enhancements
Ana.description: Increase the bonus healing duration of Biotic Grenade by 50% and reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds.

Ana.title: Overdose
Ana.description: Sleep Dart applies 4 Doses.  While Aim Down Sights is active, Sleep Dart pierces all enemy Heroes.

Ana.title: Debilitating Dart
Ana.description: Fire a dart which Slows the Movement Speed and reduces the damage dealt by the first enemy Hero it hits by 50% for 4 seconds. If no Heroes are hit, reduce this cooldown by 8 seconds.

Ana.title: Anti-Healer
Ana.description: Increase the area of Biotic Grenade by 25% and the duration of the healing reduction by 0.75 seconds.

Ana.title: Night Terrors
Ana.description: Gain 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds for every Hero hit by Sleep Dart. Upon waking, enemy Heroes take 8% of their Maximum Health in damage.

Ana.title: Mind-Numbing Agent
Ana.description: Every Dose a Hero has reduces their Spell Power by 10%.

Ana.title: Nano Boost
Ana.description: Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster.  Cannot be used on Ana.

Ana.title: Eye of Horus
Ana.description: Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. Rounds pierce allied and enemy Heroes but collide with enemy Structures in their path. Allies are healed for 225 (+4% per level) and enemies are damaged for 135 (+4% per level). Deals 50% less damage to Structures.  Ana is unable to move while Eye of Horus is active.

Ana.title: Speed Serum
Ana.description: Healing Dart grants 25% Movement Speed to affected Heroes for 2 seconds.

Ana.title: Purifying Darts
Ana.description: Healing Dart removes Roots and Slows from the target, and heals for 20% more when doing so.

Ana.title: Smelling Salts
Ana.description: Healing Dart removes Stuns from the target, and grants them 50 Armor for 2 seconds when doing so.

Ana.title: Sharpshooter
Ana.description: Healing Dart's healing is increased by 5% if it heals a Hero, up to 50%. At maximum bonus, further increase its healing by 35%. This bonus is reset if Healing Dart fails to hit a Hero.

Ana.title: Concentrated Doses
Ana.description: Increase Healing Dart's healing by 12% for each Dose active on enemy Heroes.

Ana.title: Active Reload
Ana.description: Activate to instantly gain 3 charges of Healing Dart.

Ana.title: Nano Infusion
Ana.description: Allies affected by Nano Boost heal for 50% of Spell Damage dealt.

Ana.title: Deadeye
Ana.description: Increase Eye Of Horus' healing and damage by 5% for every Hero hit. This bonus resets after all shots have been fired.

Ana.title: Armored Stance
Ana.description: Increase Shrike's damage by 50%. While Aim Down Sights is active, gain 25 Armor.

Ana.title: Dynamic Optics
Ana.description: Basic Attacks increase Attack Speed by 10% for 3 seconds, up to 100%. While Aim Down Sights is active, increase your Basic Attack Range by 4.

Anduin.title: Evenhanded Blessings
Anduin.description: If Flash Heal is cast on a different target from its last, increase its healing by 15% and refund 40% of its cooldown.

Anduin.title: Power Word: Shield
Anduin.description: While Divine Star is traveling out, allies in its path gain a Shield that absorbs 128 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.  If Divine Star hits an enemy Hero, Anduin gains a Shield that absorbs 185 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.

Anduin.title: Lightwell
Anduin.description: Summon a Lightwell that periodically heals a nearby allied Hero for 50 (+4% per level). The well only fades after healing 15 times or when recast.  This cooldown is reduced by 1 second each time Anduin heals an allied Hero.

Anduin.title: Moral Compass
Anduin.description: Divine Star fires Basic Attacks at Heroes close to its apex.  Passive: Increase Attack Range by 1.1.

Anduin.title: Surge of Light
Anduin.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Chastise by 0.75 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes Rooted by Chastise launch an additional Basic Attack and restore 25 Mana.

Anduin.title: Piercing Light
Anduin.description: Chastise pierces to hit an additional Hero.  Quest: Hitting two Heroes with a single Chastise permanently increases Spell Power by 1, to a maximum of 10.

Anduin.title: Binding Heal
Anduin.description: Casting Flash Heal on an ally heals Anduin for 135 (+4% per level).

Anduin.title: Blessed Recovery
Anduin.description: If Anduin loses more than 8% of his maximum Health at once, recover 15% Health over 3 seconds.  This effect has a 10 second cooldown.  Current Health required: 133 (+4% per level)

Anduin.title: Desperate Prayer
Anduin.description: Activate to instantly heal an allied Hero for 375 (+4% per level), but kneel for 2 seconds, unable to act.

Anduin.title: Holy Word: Salvation
Anduin.description: After 0.5 seconds, Channel to invoke the Light for 3 seconds. While nearby, allied Heroes heal for up to 30% of their max Health and are Protected.

Anduin.title: Lightbomb
Anduin.description: Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.  The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

Anduin.title: Speed of the Pious
Anduin.description: While Divine Star is traveling, gain 30% Movement Speed.  Each allied Hero healed by Divine Star on its return to Anduin reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

Anduin.title: Push Forward!
Anduin.description: Damaging an enemy Hero increases Movement Speed by 2.5% and the amount healed by Pursued By Grace by 5% for 6 seconds. These effects stack up to 8 times.

Anduin.title: Enchant Boots - Lion's Speed
Anduin.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. This bonus is quadrupled while Leap of Faith's cooldown is available. Allies pulled by Leap of Faith are healed for 280 (+4% per level) over 4 seconds.

Anduin.title: Renew
Anduin.description: Flash Heal heals an additional 180 (+4% per level) over 6 seconds. The duration of this heal is refreshed each time Anduin hits an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack.

Anduin.title: Holy Nova
Anduin.description: After Anduin catches Divine Star, it explodes, healing nearby allied Heroes for 105 (+4% per level) and damaging enemies for 150 (+4% per level).

Anduin.title: Glyph of Faith
Anduin.description: Leap of Faith gains a 2nd charge.

Anduin.title: Inner Focus
Anduin.description: Activate to reset the cooldown of Flash Heal and its next cast heals for 25% more.  Damaging enemy Heroes reduces this cooldown by 1 second.

Anduin.title: Light of Stormwind
Anduin.description: Holy Word: Salvation grants allied Heroes Invulnerability instead of Protected. This does not affect Anduin.  Channeling Holy Word: Salvation for its full duration reduces its cooldown by 60 seconds.

Anduin.title: Inner Fire
Anduin.description: The target of Light Bomb gains 40% Move Speed and 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

Anduin.title: Censure
Anduin.description: Chastise Stuns for 0.75 seconds and its Root duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

Anduin.title: Varian's Legacy
Anduin.description: Basic Attacks burn enemies for 87 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds and Anduin heals for 50% of the damage dealt.

Anub'arak.title: Nerubian Armor
Anub'arak.description: Increase Hardened Carapace's Spell Armor by 25.

Anub'arak.title: Legion of Beetles
Anub'arak.description: Beetles have 30 Spell Armor. Automatically spawn a Beetle every 12 seconds. Can be toggled on and off.

Anub'arak.title: Regeneration Master
Anub'arak.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases your Health Regeneration by 1 per second, up to 30.  Reward: After gathering 30 Regeneration Globes, you also gain 500 Health.

Anub'arak.title: Bed of Barbs
Anub'arak.description: Create a bed of spikes along Impale's path that slows enemies by 25% and deals 21 (+4% per level) damage per second.  Spikes persist for 3.5 seconds.

Anub'arak.title: Shed Exoskeleton
Anub'arak.description: Harden Carapace grants 30% increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

Anub'arak.title: Underking
Anub'arak.description: Increases Burrow Charge range by 20% and damage by 100%.

Anub'arak.title: Chitinous Plating
Anub'arak.description: While Harden Carapace is active, taking damage from enemy Abilities reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 3 seconds.

Anub'arak.title: Subterranean Shield
Anub'arak.description: Burrow Charge also grants a 400 (+4% per level) point Shield for 5 seconds.

Anub'arak.title: Leeching Scarabs
Anub'arak.description: Beetles gain 30% bonus attack damage and they heal Anub'arak for 50% of their damage with each attack if he is nearby.

Anub'arak.title: Locust Swarm
Anub'arak.description: Deal 68 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Each enemy damaged restores 24 (+4% per level) Health. Lasts 6 seconds.

Anub'arak.title: Cocoon
Anub'arak.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

Anub'arak.title: Urticating Spines
Anub'arak.description: Casting Harden Carapace will also deal 90 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Deals double damage against Heroes.

Anub'arak.title: Burning Beetles
Anub'arak.description: Deal 21 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Beetles deal 6 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

Anub'arak.title: Acid Drenched Mandibles
Anub'arak.description: Attacking a Hero that is slowed, rooted, or stunned increases Anub'arak's Basic Attack damage by 80% for 4 seconds.

Anub'arak.title: Epicenter
Anub'arak.description: Increases Burrow Charge impact area by 60% and lowers the cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

Anub'arak.title: Debilitation
Anub'arak.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Burrow Charge or Impale have their Spell Power reduced by 50% for 4 seconds.

Anub'arak.title: Beetle, Juiced
Anub'arak.description: Passive: Beetles gain 30% increased health.  Every 4th Basic Attack spawns a Beetle.

Anub'arak.title: Hive Master
Anub'arak.description: Gain a permanent Vampire Locust that attacks a nearby enemy every 3 seconds. The Vampire Locust deals 165 (+4% per level) damage and returns to heal Anub'arak for 80 (+4% per level) health.

Anub'arak.title: Cryptweave
Anub'arak.description: Staying near the Cocoon allows Anub'arak to extend the duration by up to 6 seconds per Cocoon. Upon exiting the Cocoon, enemies take 60 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% for each second that they were inside.

Anub'arak.title: The Traitor King
Anub'arak.description: Gain 10% bonus maximum Health and 20 Spell Armor.  Activate to gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds.

Anub'arak.title: Rewind
Anub'arak.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.

Artanis.title: Reactive Parry
Artanis.description: Damaging enemy Heroes with Twin Blades or Blade Dash grants Artanis 50 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing its damage by 50%.  Stores up to 2 charges.

Artanis.title: Amateur Opponent
Artanis.description: Twin Blades attacks deal 150% bonus damage to non-Heroes.

Artanis.title: Protector Of Aiur
Artanis.description: Quest: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase Artanis's Attack damage by 0.1%.  Takedowns grant 1% bonus damage.

Artanis.title: Psionic Synergy
Artanis.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Phase Prism grants 30 Armor for 5 seconds.

Artanis.title: Shield Battery
Artanis.description: Shield Overload's cooldown recharges 125% faster while its Shield is active.  Passive: Reduce Shield Overload's cooldown by 4 seconds.

Artanis.title: Shield Surge
Artanis.description: Increases Shield Overload's Shields by 80% while below 25% Health.

Artanis.title: Solarite Reaper
Artanis.description: Increases the damage of the first dash of Blade Dash by 175%.

Artanis.title: Chrono Surge
Artanis.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Phase Prism grants 40% bonus Attack Speed for 5 seconds and Slows the enemy's Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds.

Artanis.title: Final Cut
Artanis.description: After using an Ability, your next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 40% additional damage. While under 25% Health, this damage bonus is increased to 60%.

Artanis.title: Suppression Pulse
Artanis.description: Fire a large area pulse from the Spear of Adun, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Blinding enemies for 4 seconds. Unlimited range.

Artanis.title: Purifier Beam
Artanis.description: Target an enemy Hero with an orbital beam from the Spear of Adun, dealing 184 (+4% per level) damage per second for 8 seconds. The beam will chase the target as they move.  Unlimited range.

Artanis.title: Templar's Zeal
Artanis.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Blade Dash from 50 to 25. Each time that Shield Overload activates, reduce the cooldown of Blade Dash by 6 seconds.

Artanis.title: Triple Strike
Artanis.description: Increases Twin Blades's number of Basic Attacks to 3, but increase its cooldown by 1 second.

Artanis.title: Graviton Vortex
Artanis.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Phase Prism from 50 to 25. Hitting an enemy Hero with Basic Attacks or Blade Dash reduces the cooldown of Phase Prism by 2 seconds.

Artanis.title: Phase Bulwark
Artanis.description: Shield Overload grants 50 Spell Armor while active and for 2 seconds after it expires.

Artanis.title: Titan Killer
Artanis.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 0.5% of the target's maximum Health in damage, increased to 1.5% when empowered by Twin Blades.

Artanis.title: Force of Will
Artanis.description: Casting Basic Abilities reduces the cooldown of Shield Overload by 5 seconds.

Artanis.title: Blades of a Templar
Artanis.description: Increase Attack Speed by 20%. Basic Attacks Slow by 20% for 1.25 seconds.

Artanis.title: Orbital Bombardment
Artanis.description: Suppression Pulse gains an additional charge.  There is a 10 second cooldown between uses.

Artanis.title: Target Purified
Artanis.description: Increase the speed of Purifier Beam by 15%. If the target of Purifier Beam dies, it automatically recasts on the nearest visible enemy Hero.

Artanis.title: Zealot Charge
Artanis.description: Increase Twin Blades' charge distance by 75%.

Artanis.title: Plasma Burn
Artanis.description: While Shield Overload is active, deal 70 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

Arthas.title: Frost Presence
Arthas.description: Quest: Root enemy Heroes with Howling Blast.  Reward: After Rooting 5 Heroes, Howling Blast's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.  Reward: After Rooting 10 Heroes, Howling Blast's range is increased by 20%.  Reward: After Rooting 20 Heroes, Howling Blast also Roots enemies in its path.

Arthas.title: Eternal Hunger
Arthas.description: Quest: Use Frostmourne Hungers on an enemy Hero.  Reward: Increases the Mana it restores by 4, to a maximum of 40, and its damage by 4.

Arthas.title: Rime
Arthas.description: Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 3 charges.

Arthas.title: Deathlord
Arthas.description: Increase the range of Death Coil by 30%, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and if Death Coil is used on an enemy Hero, its Mana cost is refunded.

Arthas.title: Frozen Wastes
Arthas.description: Frozen Tempest Mana cost reduced by 2 per second.  Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Frozen Tempest.  Reward: After damaging enemy Heroes 150 times with Frozen Tempest, the Movement and Attack Speed Slows of Frozen Tempest last an extra 1.5 seconds against enemy Heroes.

Arthas.title: Icy Talons
Arthas.description: Gain 3% Attack Speed for 1.5 seconds every time a Hero is damaged by Frozen Tempest, to a maximum of 60%.

Arthas.title: Immortal Coil
Arthas.description: Gain the healing effect of Death Coil even when used on enemies. If Death Coil is used on Arthas, it heals for an additional 50% bonus healing.

Arthas.title: Rune Tap
Arthas.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack heals Arthas for 5% of his max Health.

Arthas.title: Icebound Fortitude
Arthas.description: Activate to gain 25 Armor, reducing damage taken by 25%, and reduce the duration of Stuns, Slows, and Roots against Arthas by 75% for 3 seconds.

Arthas.title: Army of the Dead
Arthas.description: Summons Ghouls that last 15 seconds and atttack for 20 (+4% per level) damage. Sacrifice Ghouls to heal for 267 (+4% per level) Health.

Arthas.title: Summon Sindragosa
Arthas.description: Deals 230 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

Arthas.title: Shattered Armor
Arthas.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Howling Blast have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

Arthas.title: Biting Cold
Arthas.description: Each second an enemy is damaged by Frozen Tempest, it deals 12.5% bonus damage, up to a 50% bonus.

Arthas.title: Frost Strike
Arthas.description: Reduces Frostmourne Hungers' cooldown by 2 seconds. Frostmourne Hungers also Slows the enemy by 50% for 1.5 seconds.

Arthas.title: Embrace Death
Arthas.description: Death Coil deals more damage and heals more the lower Arthas's current Health is, to a maximum of 100% bonus damage and healing.

Arthas.title: Remorseless Winter
Arthas.description: Enemy Heroes that remain within Frozen Tempest for 3 seconds are Rooted for 1.25 seconds. This effect can only happen once every 10 seconds.

Arthas.title: Frostmourne Feeds
Arthas.description: Increases the amount of Basic Attacks empowered by Frostmourne Hungers to 2.

Arthas.title: Legion of Northrend
Arthas.description: 3 additional Ghouls are created. Ghouls deal 50% more damage, heal for an additional 50%, and last 5 seconds longer.

Arthas.title: Absolute Zero
Arthas.description: Sindragosa flies twice as far. Enemy Heroes are Rooted for 2.5 seconds, and then Slowed by 60% for 4 seconds.

Arthas.title: Death's Advance
Arthas.description: Increases Movement Speed by 10%. Frozen Tempest's maximum Movement Speed Slow and Attack Speed Slow increased from 40% to 60%

Arthas.title: Anti-Magic Shell
Arthas.description: Activate to make Arthas immune to Spell Damage for 4 seconds and heal Arthas for 25% of the damage prevented.

Auriel.title: Increasing Clarity
Auriel.description: Quest: Every time Sacred Sweep hits a Hero in the center, increase the center damage by 2, up to 50.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, this center damage bonus is increased to 180.

Auriel.title: Righteous Assault
Auriel.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by 3 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by its center.

Auriel.title: Searing Light
Auriel.description: Ray of Heaven also deals damage to enemies in the area equal to 30% of the energy consumed.

Auriel.title: Majestic Span
Auriel.description: Increases the radius of Sacred Sweep by 15%.

Auriel.title: Heavy Burden
Auriel.description: Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Slow amount and duration doubled on enemies it Stuns.  Passive: Increase Detainment Strikes' Stun duration by 0.25 seconds.

Auriel.title: Repeated Offense
Auriel.description: Enemies hit by Detainment Strike are knocked back 25% farther.  Quest: Every time Detainment Strike stuns a Hero, increase the stun damage by 10, up to 60.  Reward: After stunning 6 Heroes, increase this damage bonus to 250.

Auriel.title: Glimmer of Hope
Auriel.description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe reduces the cost of Auriel's next Ray of Heaven by 75%.

Auriel.title: Empathic Link
Auriel.description: Auriel stores 25% of damage taken by allies with Bestow Hope.

Auriel.title: Energized Cord
Auriel.description: Increases the energy stored from Auriel's Basic Attacks to 120% of the damage against Heroes and 55% of the damage against non-Heroes.  Does not affect Auriel's Bestow Hope ally.

Auriel.title: Resurrect
Auriel.description: Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 5 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.  Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

Auriel.title: Crystal Aegis
Auriel.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

Auriel.title: Blinding Flash
Auriel.description: Enemies hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep are blinded for 2 seconds.

Auriel.title: Converging Force
Auriel.description: Enemies hit by the outer area are pushed slightly toward the center.

Auriel.title: Piercing Lash
Auriel.description: Detainment Strike now pierces and hits all enemy Heroes in a line, reducing the cooldown by 2 seconds for each Hero hit.

Auriel.title: Reservoir of Hope
Auriel.description: Quest: Each maximum energy Ray of Heaven Auriel casts increases the maximum amount of energy that can be stored by 75.

Auriel.title: Will of Heaven
Auriel.description: Allies with Bestow Hope gain 20% Attack Speed.  Passive: Auriel gains 10% increased Basic Attack Damage.

Auriel.title: Wrath of Heaven
Auriel.description: Allies with Bestow Hope gain 10% Spell Power.  Enemy Heroes hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep or the terrain collision of Detainment Strike have their Spell Armor reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.

Auriel.title: Light Speed
Auriel.description: Resurrected allies gain 200% increased Movement Speed, decaying over 4 seconds.  While a resurrected ally remains alive, Resurrect's next cooldown recharges 100% faster.

Auriel.title: Diamond Resolve
Auriel.description: When Crystal Aegis expires, it grants the target 75 Armor for 5 seconds, reducing damage taken by 75%.

Auriel.title: Angelic Flight
Auriel.description: After 2 seconds, fly to a target location.

Auriel.title: Shield of Hope
Auriel.description: Activate to grant all nearby allied Heroes a shield for 3 seconds equal to 50% of the amount of Health they are missing.

Azmodan.title: Greed
Azmodan.description: Globe of Annihilation deals 15% more damage to non-Heroic targets.  Quest: After gaining 200 Annihilation, increase the range of All Shall Burn by 25% and Demon Warriors gain 20% Attack Speed and Movement Speed.

Azmodan.title: Gluttony
Azmodan.description: Increase the number of stacks of Annihilation gained by hitting Heroes with Globe of Annihilation from 2 to 4.  Quest: After gaining 200 Annihilation, each enemy hit by Globe of Annihilation reduces its cooldown by 0.25 seconds, doubled against Heroes.

Azmodan.title: Wrath
Azmodan.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes under 75% Health grant 1 Annihilation.  Quest: After gaining 200 Annihilation, hitting a Hero with Globe of Annihilation increases the damage of Azmodan's next Basic Attack against them within 3 seconds by 85% the amount of Annihilation he has.

Azmodan.title: Army of Hell
Azmodan.description: Summon Demon Warrior spawns an additional Demon, but its cooldown is increased by 10 seconds.

Azmodan.title: Hellforged Armor
Azmodan.description: Demon Warriors and Lieutenants gain 20 Armor and last 4 seconds longer.

Azmodan.title: Battleborn
Azmodan.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Summon Demon Warrior from 25 to 20.  Azmodan's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Summon Demon Warrior by 0.75 seconds and Demon Lieutenant by 1.5 seconds.

Azmodan.title: Art of Chaos
Azmodan.description: If Globe of Annihilation hits 2 or more Heroes, restore 40 Mana and gain an extra 4 Annihilation.

Azmodan.title: Bombardment
Azmodan.description: After casting Globe of Annihilation, Azmodan's Basic Attacks within the next 4 seconds have an additional 1.5 range and can hit 3 additional targets. Hitting Heroes with Basic Attacks empowered by Bombardment grant 1 Annihilation.

Azmodan.title: Master of Destruction
Azmodan.description: If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration, All Shall Burn's final damage applies to all enemies in an area around the target and grants 2 Annihilation per Hero hit.

Azmodan.title: Demonic Invasion
Azmodan.description: Rain a small army of Demonic Grunts down on enemies, dealing 85 (+4% per level) damage per impact. Grunts deal 39 (+4% per level) damage, have 750 (+4% per level) Health and last up to 10 seconds. When Grunts die they explode, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, doubled against enemy Heroes.  Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

Azmodan.title: Tide of Sin
Azmodan.description: Activate to make the next Globe of Annihilation cost no Mana and deal 50% more damage.  Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

Azmodan.title: Brutish Vanguard
Azmodan.description: Demon Warriors and Lieutenants gain 25% increased Health. Demon Warriors Slow nearby enemies by 20%.

Azmodan.title: Cydaea's Kiss
Azmodan.description: Reduces the Channel time of All Shall Burn by 0.5 seconds. If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration against a Hero, Azmodan is healed for 8% of his maximum Health.

Azmodan.title: Chain of Command
Azmodan.description: The cooldown of Demon Lieutenants' Demonic Smite is reduced by 2 seconds and they grant 25% increased damage to nearby friendly Minions, Mercenaries, and Azmodan's summoned Demons.

Azmodan.title: Total Annihilation
Azmodan.description: Globe of Annihilation damages Heroes for an additional 4% of their maximum Health.

Azmodan.title: Hell Rift
Azmodan.description: If All Shall Burn Channels for its full duration or kills the target, a Demon Warrior is summoned at the target's location and all Demon Warriors deal 75% increased damage for 5 seconds.

Azmodan.title: Trample
Azmodan.description: Activate to charge a short distance, dealing 275 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies caught in the path by 60% for 1.25 second.

Azmodan.title: Siegebreaker
Azmodan.description: Azmodan's Demons deal 40% increased damage to Structures.

Azmodan.title: Black Pool
Azmodan.description: Globes of Annihilation empowered by Tide of Sin also leave a Black Pool at their impact location for 5 seconds. Enemies within the pool lose 8 Armor per second, up to 15, and take 56 (+4% per level) damage per second.

Azmodan.title: Pride
Azmodan.description: After gaining 400 Annihilation, the area of Globe of Annihilation is increased by 15% and it deals 125 additional damage.

Azmodan.title: Sin's Grasp
Azmodan.description: All Shall Burn Slows enemy Heroes by 15% during its Channel. If All Shall Burn Channels for its full duration or kills an enemy Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 50%, and the target is Slowed by 50% for 2.5 seconds.

Blaze.title: Adrenaline Stimpack
Blaze.description: Passive: While over 80% Health, gain 25% bonus Attack Speed and 10% bonus Movement Speed.  Activate to gain 100% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

Blaze.title: Endurance Stimpack
Blaze.description: Activate to gain a Shield that absorbs 590 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds.  When taking damage while below 30% maximum Health, Endurance Stimpack will automatically be cast if it is not on cooldown.

Blaze.title: Neural Stimpack
Blaze.description: Activate to gain 40 Mana and cause Basic Ability cooldowns to recharge 100% faster for 5 seconds.

Blaze.title: New Habits
Blaze.description: Collecting Regeneration Globes reduces the cooldown of Pyromania by 6 seconds.  Quest: Collect 15 Regeneration Globes.  Reward: Pyromania grants Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

Blaze.title: Oil Dispersal
Blaze.description: Increase Oil Spill's area by 20%. Each enemy Hero hit by Flame Stream reduces the cooldown of Oil Spill by 0.75 seconds and refunds 5 Mana.

Blaze.title: Meltdown
Blaze.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Pyromania reduces their damage dealt by 8% for 2.5 seconds, up to 40%.

Blaze.title: Incinerator Gauntlets
Blaze.description: Increase Basic Attack area by 15%, and Basic Attack damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters by 50%.

Blaze.title: Suppressive Fire
Blaze.description: Each stream of Flame Stream reduces the Spell Power of Heroes hit by 25% for 4 seconds, up to 50%.

Blaze.title: Nanomachine Coating
Blaze.description: Enemies standing in Oil Spills and Ignited Oil Spills have their Attack Speed reduced by 50% for 3 seconds.

Blaze.title: Fuel Leak
Blaze.description: Jet Propulsion creates Oil Spills along Blaze's path. If Jet Propulsion impacts an enemy Hero, an additional Oil Spill is created underneath them.

Blaze.title: Bunker Drop
Blaze.description: After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435 (+4% per level) Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 170 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line.  Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

Blaze.title: Combustion
Blaze.description: Channel for up to 2.6 seconds. Upon ending, Slow nearby enemies by 60% and deal 55 (+4% per level) damage to them every 0.5 seconds. Combustion's Slow and damage over time duration is extended the longer Blaze Channels, from 1 second up to 5 seconds.  Blaze's Movement Speed is reduced by 40% while Channeling.

Blaze.title: Grill and Kill
Blaze.description: Increase Ignited Oil Spill damage by 45%.  Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Ignited Oil Spills 30 times.  Reward: Increase Oil Spill's Ignite duration by 2.5 seconds.

Blaze.title: Adhesive Petroleum
Blaze.description: Enemies standing in Oil Spill when it is Ignited are Slowed by 40% and take 35% more Basic Attack damage from Blaze for 3 seconds. Additionally, Basic Attack splashes Ignite Oil Spills.

Blaze.title: Collision Course
Blaze.description: Jet Propulsion's collision deals 275 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit.

Blaze.title: Thermal Protection
Blaze.description: Each enemy hit by Jet Propulsion grants 10 Armor for 3 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 1.25 seconds.

Blaze.title: Heat Treatment
Blaze.description: Heal for 75% of the damage dealt by Pyromania.

Blaze.title: Juggernaut Plating
Blaze.description: Activate to gain 50 Spell Armor for 3 seconds. Upon expiration, gain a Shield equal to 125% of the Spell Damage taken while Juggernaut Plating was active.

Blaze.title: Fortified Bunker
Blaze.description: Occupants can cast Oil Spill from Bunker Drop every 6 seconds. Additionally, Bunker Drop's Armor bonus upon exiting is increased by 25, and its duration by 1 second.

Blaze.title: Flash Fire
Blaze.description: While Channeling Combustion, Blaze's Movement Speed is no longer reduced, and nearby enemies are Slowed by 60%.

Blaze.title: Burn Notice
Blaze.description: Basic Attacks Slow enemies by 5% and deal an additional 18 (+4% per level) damage over 2.5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.

Brightwing.title: Greater Polymorph
Brightwing.description: Passive: Increase Polymorph's range by 30%.  If Brightwing hits an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center within 2 seconds of being Polymorphed, then reduce Polymorph's cooldown by 7 seconds and gain 50 Mana.

Brightwing.title: Hyper Shift
Brightwing.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 1 second.

Brightwing.title: Pixie Charm
Brightwing.description: Activate to consume 20 stacks of Bribe to instantly defeat an uncaptured non-Elite Mercenary.  Passive: Gain 1 stack of Bribe when a nearby enemy Minion dies, and 5 stacks when hitting an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center. Maximum 80 stacks.

Brightwing.title: Dream Shot
Brightwing.description: Increase Arcane Flare's range by 50%. Hitting a Hero with Arcane Flare's center reduces its cooldown to 2 seconds.

Brightwing.title: Unstable Anomaly
Brightwing.description: Increase Polymorph's Slow by 15%. Upon expiration, Polymorph deals damage to nearby enemy Heroes equal to 2% of their maximum Health.

Brightwing.title: Magic Spit
Brightwing.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

Brightwing.title: Sticky Flare
Brightwing.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Arcane Flare have their Movement Speed Slowed by 20% for 3 seconds. Increase the Slow to 40% if they are hit by the center portion.

Brightwing.title: Peekaboo!
Brightwing.description: Phase Shifting to an ally grants both Brightwing and her target a 335 (+4% per level) Shield for 4 seconds and reveals a large area around them for 5 seconds.

Brightwing.title: Critical Mist
Brightwing.description: Soothing Mist heals allied Heroes for 165 (+4% per level). Increase this healing by 140% if Soothing Mist removed a disabling effect from that ally.

Brightwing.title: Blink Heal
Brightwing.description: Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).  Stores up to 2 charges.

Brightwing.title: Emerald Wind
Brightwing.description: After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and pushing enemies away.

Brightwing.title: Pixie Boost
Brightwing.description: Pixie Dust gives 50% bonus Movement Speed, decaying to 20% over 3 seconds.

Brightwing.title: Safety Dust
Brightwing.description: Increase Pixie Dust's duration by 1 second. Soothing Mist and Blink Heal heal allies with an active Pixie Dust for 75% more.

Brightwing.title: Pixie Power
Brightwing.description: Reduce the cooldown of Pixie Dust by 3 seconds and increase the Spell Armor granted by 25.

Brightwing.title: Hush!
Brightwing.description: Enemy Heroes hit by the center of Arcane Flare are Silenced for 1 second and deal 25% less damage for 3 seconds.

Brightwing.title: Critterize
Brightwing.description: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

Brightwing.title: Phase Out
Brightwing.description: Activate to place Brightwing in Stasis for 0.75 seconds.

Brightwing.title: Invisible Friends
Brightwing.description: Blink Heal grants Stealth to Brightwing and her Heroic targets for 9 seconds, and they are Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds. While Stealthed by Invisible Friends, Heroes heal for 25 (+4% per level) health per second.  Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

Brightwing.title: Intensive Winds
Brightwing.description: Permanently reduce Emerald Wind's cooldown to 5 seconds.

Brightwing.title: Speedy Dragon
Brightwing.description: Permanently gain 20% Movement Speed. Reduce Phase Shift's cast time by 1 second.

Brightwing.title: Faerie Protector
Brightwing.description: Activate to apply Pixie Dust to all nearby Heroes.  Passive: Pixie Dust always bounces back and applies to Brightwing.

Cassia.title: Thunderstroke
Cassia.description: Increase the damage of Lightning Fury by 15.  Quest: Lightning Fury's damage is increased by 1.5 every time it hits a Hero.

Cassia.title: Impale
Cassia.description: Increase Fend's cast range and area of effect by 25%. It deals an additional 50% damage to enemies below 50% Health.

Cassia.title: Charged Strikes
Cassia.description: Gain 15% Attack Speed. Every 3rd Basic Attack deals 20% bonus damage and bounces to nearby enemy Heroes.

Cassia.title: Plate of the Whale
Cassia.description: Regenerate 6 (+4% per level) Health per second while Avoidance is active. If fully charged, gain an additional 12 (+4% per level) Health per second.

Cassia.title: Ring of the Leech
Cassia.description: Basic Attacks against your primary target heal for 20% of their damage. If an enemy is Blinded, this also affects Lightning Fury and Fend.

Cassia.title: Inner Light
Cassia.description: Activate to heal for 25% of your maximum Health over 5 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit with Lightning Fury lower the cooldown of this ability by 10 seconds.

Cassia.title: Grounding Rod
Cassia.description: Enemies hit by Lightning Fury or Fend are Slowed by 20% for 2 seconds.

Cassia.title: Seraph's Hymn
Cassia.description: Basic Attacks against your primary enemy Hero grant 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Blinding Light by 2 seconds.  Passive: Increase the passive damage bonus of Blinding Light from 15% to 30%.

Cassia.title: Surge of Light
Cassia.description: After taking 650 (+4% per level) damage with Avoidance active, Cassia can activate Avoidance to deal 220 (+4% per level) damage to enemies around her.

Cassia.title: Ball Lightning
Cassia.description: Throw a ball of lightning at an enemy Hero that bounces up to 6 times between nearby enemy Heroes and Cassia, dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit.

Cassia.title: Valkyrie
Cassia.description: Summon a Valkyrie that rushes to Cassia after 0.75 seconds, pulling the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds at the end of her path. The Valkyrie knocks back all other enemy Heroes in her way.

Cassia.title: War Matron
Cassia.description: Cassia becomes Protected while Channeling Fend and for an additional 1 second if the Channel is completed.

Cassia.title: War Traveler
Cassia.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. While Avoidance is fully charged, gain an additional 10% Movement Speed and Mounting is instant.

Cassia.title: Gloves of Alacrity
Cassia.description: Gain 1 Basic Attack range. While Avoidance is fully charged, gain an additional 1 Basic Attack range.

Cassia.title: Power Strike
Cassia.description: Lightning Fury pierces but only splits on Heroes. Enemy Heroes hit reduce its cooldown by 1 second and become marked for 15 seconds. Upon reaching 3 marks, remove them and cast a Blinding Light at their feet.

Cassia.title: Static Electricity
Cassia.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Lightning Fury. Fend's impact launches a lightning bolt towards each nearby enemy Hero.

Cassia.title: Martial Law
Cassia.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Increase this to 3% if they are Stunned, Rooted, Slowed, or Blinded.

Cassia.title: Infinite Lightning
Cassia.description: Ball Lightning can now bounce indefinitely. Every bounce reduces its cooldown by 5 seconds.

Cassia.title: Imprisoning Light
Cassia.description: Upon impaling an enemy Hero, they are Blinded for 5 seconds and Cassia's Valkyrie creates a wave of light that deals 200 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. This wave Silences and Roots them for 3 seconds.

Cassia.title: Titan's Revenge
Cassia.description: Cassia's Basic Attacks now ignore Armor and while Avoidance is fully charged, they deal an additional 20% bonus damage.

Cassia.title: Rockstopper
Cassia.description: Activate to fully charge Avoidance and increase its Armor value to 60 for 4 seconds.   Losing Avoidance removes this bonus.

Chen.title: Eye of the Tiger
Chen.description: Basic Attacks against Brew-soaked enemy Heroes deal 40% more damage and heal Chen for 40% of the damage done.

Chen.title: Freshest Ingredients
Chen.description: Increase the healing duration of Regeneration Globes by 150%.  Quest: Gather 15 Regeneration Globes.  Reward: Reduce Fortifying Brew's cooldown by 2 seconds, and 50% of its Shield persists indefinitely after drinking.

Chen.title: Stormstout Secret Recipe
Chen.description: Chen heals for 3.5% of his maximum Health when his Basic Abilities hit an enemy Hero.

Chen.title: Deadly Strike
Chen.description: Flying Kick no longer costs Brew. Additionally, its damage is increased by 125% while Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew.

Chen.title: Accumulating Flame
Chen.description: Increase Ignited damage by 20%.  Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes who are Ignited increase its duration by 0.75 seconds.

Chen.title: Withering Flames
Chen.description: Igniting an enemy Hero reduces their Spell Power by 60% for 4 seconds.

Chen.title: Gift of the Ox
Chen.description: Increase the duration of Stagger's damage prevention by 1.5 seconds, and reduce the amount of damage taken over time to 50% of damage taken.

Chen.title: Brewmaster's Balance
Chen.description: While at or below 50 Brew, gain 20% Movement Speed. While at or above 50 Brew, regenerate an additional 18 (+4% per level) Health per second.

Chen.title: Elusive Brawler
Chen.description: Activate to gain 30% Movement Speed and Evade enemy Basic Attacks for 2 seconds. Chen's Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 2 seconds.

Chen.title: Wandering Keg
Chen.description: Roll around inside an Unstoppable barrel with 70% increased Movement Speed and 25 Armor, dealing 59 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back. Lasts for 5 seconds.

Chen.title: Storm, Earth, Fire
Chen.description: After 1 second, Chen splits into three elemental spirits for 12 seconds, each with 70% of Chen's maximum Health and a unique Ability.  The last spirit Ability that is cast is empowered. If all three spirits are killed, Chen will die as well.  Storm can grant the spirits a Shield.  Earth can leap to an area and Slow enemies.  Fire can grant the spirits Attack Speed, damage.

Chen.title: Pressure Point
Chen.description: Flying Kick Slows the target enemy by 40% for 1 second, or by 80% if Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew.

Chen.title: A Touch of Honey
Chen.description: Increase the Slows from Keg Smash by 20% and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

Chen.title: Ring of Fire
Chen.description: After Igniting an enemy, become bathed in a fiery aura, dealing 55 (+4% per level) damage every second to nearby enemies for 5 seconds.

Chen.title: Enough to Share
Chen.description: Fortifying Brew instantly grants Chen a Shield that absorbs 180 (+4% per level) damage, and each second grants nearby allied Heroes a Shield that absorbs 140 (+4% per level) damage, up to 420 (+4% per level).

Chen.title: Flying Leap
Chen.description: Increase Flying Kick's range by 15% and reduce its cooldown by 0.5 seconds each time an enemy Hero takes damage from being Ignited.

Chen.title: Celerity
Chen.description: Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Stagger by 2 seconds and grant Chen 30 Armor for 3 seconds.

Chen.title: Combo Strikes
Chen.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same target deals 75% bonus damage.  While Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew and for 2 seconds after, he gains 35% Attack Speed.

Chen.title: Untapped Potential
Chen.description: Increase Wandering Keg's Movement Speed bonus from 70% to 125%, and its Armor bonus to 75 for its duration and 3 seconds afterwards.

Chen.title: Elemental Conduit
Chen.description: Increase the spirits' Health to 100% of Chen's maximum Health and all of their Abilities are empowered.

Chen.title: Purifying Brew
Chen.description: Casting Fortifying Brew grants Chen Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

Chen.title: Energizing Brew
Chen.description: If Chen Channels Fortifying Brew for its full duration, then he gains 20% bonus Health and 20% bonus damage for 25 seconds.

Cho.title: Consuming Fire
Cho.description: Consuming Blaze heals for 150% more when a Hero is Ignited.

Cho.title: Calloused Hide
Cho.description: While under 60% maximum Health, Cho gains 15% increased Movement Speed and healing received.

Cho.title: The Will of Cho
Cho.description: Quest: Killing enemy Minions grants 1 stack of The Will of Cho, and Hero takedowns grant 10 stacks.  Gain 1 Armor for every 30 stacks of The Will of Cho, up to a maximum of 10 Armor.  This Armor bonus stacks with Ogre Hide.

Cho.title: Uppercut
Cho.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Surging Fist deals additional damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their max Health and reduces the cooldown of Surging Fist by 5 seconds.

Cho.title: Rollback
Cho.description: Rune Bomb rolls back to Cho, damaging enemies in its path.

Cho.title: Seared Flesh
Cho.description: Each consecutive Basic Attack to enemy Heroes deals 20% more damage, to a maximum of 60% damage. This bonus lasts 5 seconds or until a non-Heroic enemy is attacked.

Cho.title: Power Surge
Cho.description: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Surging Fist are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds.  Gain 15% Movement Speed while charging Surging Fist and for 2.5 seconds after casting the Ability.

Cho.title: Firestarter
Cho.description: Basic Attacks against ignited Heroes decreases the cooldown of Consuming Blaze by 1 second.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Consuming Blaze by 3 seconds.

Cho.title: Enraged Regeneration
Cho.description: Each time Cho hits an enemy Hero with an Ability or Basic Attack, he heals for 60 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by Gall's Dread Orb receive 35% less healing for 2 seconds.

Cho.title: Hammer of Twilight
Cho.description: Activate to swing the Hammer of Twilight, dealing 150 (+4.5% per level) damage, pushing enemies away, and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.  Passive: Cho's Basic Attacks deal 25% increased damage.

Cho.title: Upheaval
Cho.description: After 1 second, pull enemies towards Cho'gall, Slowing them by 25% for 3 seconds and dealing 175 (+4% per level) damage.

Cho.title: Surging Dash
Cho.description: While Channeling Surging Fist, Cho heals for 150 (+4% per level) Health per second.

Cho.title: Twilight Veil
Cho.description: Activate to increase the Armor bonus of Ogre Hide to 75 for 4 seconds. If cast while Ogre Rage is active, it instantly swaps to Ogre Hide.

Cho.title: Molten Block
Cho.description: Activate to enter Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds, damaging nearby enemies for 92 (+4% per level) damage per second.

Cho.title: Frenzied Fists
Cho.description: Gain 75% Attack Speed for 5 seconds after using Surging Fist.

Cho.title: Runic Feedback
Cho.description: Gall's Runic Blast reduces Cho's Rune Bomb cooldown by 1 second per enemy hit, and 2 seconds for each Hero hit.

Cho.title: Runed Gauntlet
Cho.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Cho and Gall's Heroic Abilities by 6%.

Cho.title: C'Thun's Gift
Cho.description: Cho's Basic Attack becomes ranged and Slows targets by 20% for 2 seconds.

Cho.title: Favor of the Old Gods
Cho.description: Upheaval Roots enemy Heroes for 2 seconds.

Cho.title: Fuel for the Flame
Cho.description: Basic Attacks against enemies cause them to explode, dealing 21 (+4% per level) damage to them and 45 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  This damage is doubled against enemy Heroes.

Cho.title: Hour of Twilight
Cho.description: Decreases Cho'gall's death timer by 50%.

Chromie.title: Once Again the First Time
Chromie.description: Quest: Hit 40 Heroes with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes.  Reward: Increase the maximum number of active Echoes to 2, and increase Echo damage to 45%.

Chromie.title: Deep Breathing
Chromie.description: Quest: Every time Dragon's Breath hits a Hero increase its damage by 1%, up to 20%.  Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Dragon's Breath by 4 seconds and its Mana cost from 65 to 40.

Chromie.title: Timewalker's Pursuit
Chromie.description: Gain 10% Spell Power and reduce the arming time of Time Traps by 0.75 seconds. Activate to reveal the targeted area for 4 seconds. Enemies seen are revealed for 4 seconds.

Chromie.title: Chronic Conditions
Chromie.description: After its Time Stop ends, enemies affected by Time Trap are Slowed by 30% for 3 seconds and allies gain 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

Chromie.title: Time Troubles
Chromie.description: After its Time Stop ends, enemies affected by Time Trap lose 15 Armor for 3 seconds and allies gain 30 Armor for 3 seconds.

Chromie.title: Andorhal Anomaly
Chromie.description: Increase the charges and maximum active Time Traps to 3, and reduce its cooldown by 8 seconds.

Chromie.title: Bronze Talons
Chromie.description: Hitting a Hero with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes grants 50% additional Basic Attack damage for 5 seconds.

Chromie.title: Mobius Loop
Chromie.description: Dragon's Breath deals 30% bonus damage to enemies hit by its center.  Enemy Heroes hit by its center are Slowed by 60% for 0.75 seconds.

Chromie.title: A Proper Greeting
Chromie.description: Damaging a Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemy Hero grants 20% additional damage for 3 seconds.

Chromie.title: Slowing Sands
Chromie.description: Summon a sand vortex that Slows enemies by 10% every 0.25 seconds, up to 70%.

Chromie.title: Temporal Loop
Chromie.description: Choose an enemy Hero. After 3 seconds, they are teleported back to the location where Temporal Loop was cast on them.  Basic Abilities recharge 500% faster for 3 seconds after casting Temporal Loop.

Chromie.title: Gnome Speed Ahead!
Chromie.description: After casting Sand Blast, Chromie gains 20% Movement Speed and 200% increased Health Regeneration for 3 seconds.

Chromie.title: Here and There
Chromie.description: Activate to teleport to an area near an Echo, swapping it with Chromie's previous location.

Chromie.title: Time Out
Chromie.description: Activate to place Chromie in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for up to 5 seconds. Can be reactivated to end the effect early.

Chromie.title: Shifting Sands
Chromie.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Chromie's primary Sand Blast grants 5% Spell Power for 8 seconds, up to a maximum of 50%. The duration is refreshed whenever an enemy is damaged by the primary Sand Blast.

Chromie.title: Fast Forward
Chromie.description: If Chromie's primary Sand Blast travels at least 50% of its base distance and hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced to 0.5 seconds and it refunds 10 Mana.

Chromie.title: Quantum Overdrive
Chromie.description: Activate to increase Spell Power by 30% for 8 seconds. Hitting an enemy Hero with Sand Blast reduces this cooldown by 3 seconds.

Chromie.title: Unravelling
Chromie.description: Every 0.25 seconds, enemy Heroes Slowed by Slowing Sands have their Spell Armor reduced by 10 up to 50. Slowing Sands persists for 5 seconds after it is cancelled.

Chromie.title: Stuck in a Loop
Chromie.description: Temporal Loop teleports the target a second time after the first, and Basic Abilities continue recharging for an additional 3 seconds. Increase the cooldown recharge rate from 500% to 700%.

Chromie.title: Piercing Sands
Chromie.description: Sand Blasts cast from Chromie and her Echoes now pierce all enemies hit.

Chromie.title: Blessing of the Bronze
Chromie.description: Activate to cause Chromie and all allied Heroes to gain 20% Movement Speed and their Basic Abilities recharge 35% faster for 8 seconds.  Hitting an enemy Hero with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes reduces the cooldown of Blessing of the Bronze by 1 second.

D.Va.title: Full Metal
D.Va.description: D.Va's Mech gains 10% increased Health and its Fusion Cannons heal for 16% of the damage dealt to enemies in its bonus area.

D.Va.title: Pro Moves
D.Va.description: D.Va's Mech gains 2% Movement Speed and 2 Armor every time it takes damage, stacking up to 15 times. Stacks of this effect decay every 0.5 seconds.  Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes in Pilot Mode reduce the cooldown of Call Mech by 1 additional second.

D.Va.title: Liquid Cooling
D.Va.description: Activate to gain the effects of Healing Fountain. Requires Mech Mode.  Passive: While in Mech Mode, Healing Fountain's cooldown is reduced to 50 seconds and its effects last 35% longer.

D.Va.title: Rush-down
D.Va.description: Boosters deals an additional 2% of maximum Health as damage to Heroes and heals D.Va's Mech for the damage dealt. Boosters deals 50% increased damage to non-Heroic enemies.

D.Va.title: Aggression Matrix
D.Va.description: Enemy Heroes within your Defense Matrix receive 35% less healing.  Passive: Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Defense Matrix by 0.1875 seconds.

D.Va.title: Nuclear Option
D.Va.description: Hitting your self-destructing Mech with Big Shot causes it to self-destruct 40% faster.  Passive: When Fusion Cannons deal bonus damage to an enemy Hero, gain 0.25 Self-Destruct Charge.

D.Va.title: Get On The Point!
D.Va.description: Casting Boosters grants nearby allies 20% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.  Passive: If D.Va has not taken damage in the last 3 seconds, Boosters' cooldown refreshes 100% faster.

D.Va.title: Hit The Nitrous
D.Va.description: The initial speed bonus of Boosters is increased to 300%, then decays to normal boost speed over 0.5 seconds. During this time, Boosters Stuns for 0.5 seconds.

D.Va.title: Fusion Generator
D.Va.description: Every time an enemy Hero deals damage while inside Defense Matrix, D.Va's Self-Destruct Charge increases by 1%. Max of 20% Charge gained per use.  Passive: While at full Self-Destruct charge, Fusion Cannons' bonus damage is increased to 100%.

D.Va.title: Bunny Hop
D.Va.description: D.Va's Mech becomes Unstoppable and stomps every 0.5 seconds, dealing 70 (+4% per level) damage in a large area. Every 4th consecutive hit on a Hero deals 100% more damage and Stuns them for 0.5 seconds.  Lasts for 4 seconds.  Requires Mech Mode.

D.Va.title: Micro Missiles
D.Va.description: After .375 seconds, Channel to launch a volley of 12 missiles in a target direction. Each missile impacts the first enemy in its path, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage in a small area and Slowing by 30% for 2 seconds.  Stores 2 charges with a 5 second cooldown between each use.  Requires Mech Mode.

D.Va.title: Target Locked
D.Va.description: Enemy Heroes that remain in your Defense Matrix for 1 seconds have their Armor reduced by 15 and their Movement Speed reduced by 25% for 3 seconds.

D.Va.title: Good To Go
D.Va.description: Pilot Mode: Unlocks the Torpedo Dash and Concussive Pulse abilities.  Torpedo Dash: Dash a short distance. 10 second cooldown.  Concussive Pulse: Deal 120 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a cone and knock them back. 10 second cooldown.

D.Va.title: Pew! Pew! Pew!
D.Va.description: Pilot Mode: Instead of a single shot, Big Shot fires 3 shots over 0.5 seconds. Each shot deals 75% damage.

D.Va.title: In For The Kill
D.Va.description: Casting Boosters grants a Shield equal to 10% of maximum life for 2.5 seconds. Each Enemy Hero hit by Boosters increases D.Va's Mech's Basic Attack damage by 10% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

D.Va.title: Diverting Power
D.Va.description: Defense Matrix's area grows drastically in size and each time it reduces damage dealt to Heroes D.Va's Mech is healed for 35 (+4% per level) Health.

D.Va.title: Emergency Shielding
D.Va.description: When D.Va's Mech would be destroyed, it instead gains a Shield that absorbs 280 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds.  This effect has a 30 second cooldown.

D.Va.title: Stop and Pop
D.Va.description: Increase Bunny Hop's duration by 4 seconds, and it does not decay while D.Va's Mech is stationary.

D.Va.title: Timing Attack
D.Va.description: Micro Missiles gains an additional charge. Each time Micro Missiles hits an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 0.5 seconds and charge cooldown by 0.25 seconds.

D.Va.title: Headshot!
D.Va.description: Pilot Mode: Increase Big Shot's damage by 75% and reduce its cooldown by 2 seconds.

D.Va.title: Ablative Armor
D.Va.description: 45% of Spell damage dealt to D.Va's Mech is returned as healing over 4 seconds.

Deathwing.title: Dragon Soul
Deathwing.description: Destroyer: Incinerate heals Deathwing for 75% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes.  World Breaker: Lava Burst's explosion damage heals Deathwing for 150% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes.

Deathwing.title: Molten Blood
Deathwing.description: While Deathwing has 3 or more Armor Plates, he heals for 0.6% of his maximum Health per second.

Deathwing.title: Draconic Might
Deathwing.description: Deathwing's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes heal him for 25% of the damage dealt. Upon losing an Armor Plate, Deathwing becomes Protected for 0.75 seconds.

Deathwing.title: Infernus
Deathwing.description: Increase the damage of Molten Flame against enemy Heroes by 25%.  Increase this damage bonus to 75% when Molten Flame is cast at 75 Energy or higher.

Deathwing.title: Heat Wave
Deathwing.description: Destroyer: After hitting an enemy Hero with Incinerate, Deathwing deals 12 (+4% per level) damage per second to all nearby enemies for the next 8 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.  World Breaker: Increase the explosion damage of Lava Burst by 125%.

Deathwing.title: Dragon's Ire
Deathwing.description: While Deathwing has 3 or fewer Armor Plates, his damage is increased by 25%.

Deathwing.title: Firestorm
Deathwing.description: Reduce the cooldown of Deathwing's landing Abilities by 2 seconds.  When Deathwing lands, he drops 7 meteors near the landing area, dealing 70 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit. Heroes hit by the meteors reduce Dragonflight's cooldown by 25 seconds.  Meteors prioritize landing on Heroes, otherwise they fall randomly in the area.

Deathwing.title: Death Drop
Deathwing.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Destroyer or World Breaker's landing damage reduces their Spell Armor by 15 for 6 seconds and Deathwing's Basic Ability cooldowns by 2 seconds.

Deathwing.title: Skyfall
Deathwing.description: After using Dragonflight, Deathwing can drop meteors anywhere within vision dealing 58 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the area. Has 3 charges.  If a Hero is hit, Deathwing heals for 3% of his maximum Health.

Deathwing.title: Burn Beneath My Shadow
Deathwing.description: When an enemy Fort or Keep is destroyed the cooldown of Cataclysm is reset. Cataclysm's periodic damage is increased by 80%.

Deathwing.title: Bellowing Roar
Deathwing.description: After 1 second, Deathwing unleashes a mighty roar, dealing 25 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Heroes and causing them to run in Fear for 1.5 seconds.

Deathwing.title: Wicked Inferno
Deathwing.description: Molten Flame's Energy cost per second is reduced by 10.  After using Molten Flame, Deathwing gains 15 Energy over 3 seconds.

Deathwing.title: Ruination
Deathwing.description: Destroyer: The bite from Onslaught now Slows by 60% for 1.5 seconds.  World Breaker: Reduce Earth Shatter's cooldown by 6 seconds and its Energy cost by 10.

Deathwing.title: Fire and Fury
Deathwing.description: Basic Attacks against Rooted, Slowed, or Stunned enemy Heroes deal 30% additional damage and reduce the cooldowns of Deathwing's Basic Abilities by 0.5 seconds.

Deathwing.title: Conflagration
Deathwing.description: Dealing 320 (+4% per level) damage with Molten Flame to enemy Heroes within 4 seconds causes them to burn for an additional 100 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. While burning, they explode every 1 second, dealing 80 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

Deathwing.title: Gaze Onto Destruction
Deathwing.description: Hitting Heroes with Destroyer or World Breaker's landing causes their damage to be reduced by 75% and Slows them by 40% for 5 seconds.

Deathwing.title: Elementium Plating
Deathwing.description: Activate to gain a Shield equal to 30% of Deathwing's missing Health for 8 seconds. While the Shield holds, Deathwing regenerates 2% of his maximum Health per second.  When the Shield expires or is destroyed, Deathwing regains Armor Plates appropriate for his new Health.  The Shield and effect end immediately if Deathwing uses Dragonflight.

Deathwing.title: Stood in the Fire
Deathwing.description: Enemy Heroes are Slowed by 40% while standing in scorched ground, and its duration is increased by 50%.

Deathwing.title: Arrival of a God
Deathwing.description: Destroyer or World Breaker's landing damage is increased by 400%.  Deathwing also gains the benefits of all of his level 7 talents.

Deathwing.title: Destroyer's Rampage
Deathwing.description: For the next 6 seconds after landing in Destroyer form, Deathwing's damage is increased by 40% and his Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 50% faster.  Damaging Heroes refreshes this effect and switching to World Breaker form removes the effect.

Deckard.title: Scroll of Identify
Deckard.description: Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with Scroll of Sealing permanently increases its damage by 2.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Scroll of Sealing reveals and reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 10 for 4 seconds.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, this talent's Armor reduction effect is increased to 15 and its duration to 6 seconds.

Deckard.title: Field Study
Deckard.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Scroll of Sealing grants 20% Spell Power for 16 seconds, up to 40%.

Deckard.title: Sapphire
Deckard.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and its slow by 30%.  Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

Deckard.title: Potion of Shielding
Deckard.description: Whenever an ally is healed by a Healing Potion, they gain a 140 (+4% per level) Shield for 6 seconds.

Deckard.title: Rejuvenation Potion
Deckard.description: Healing Potions restore 15 Mana and heal for an additional 114 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds.

Deckard.title: Ruby
Deckard.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100%  and it spawns 3 Lesser Healing Potions from each enemy Hero hit, healing allied Heroes for 250 (+4% per level) when picked up. Lesser Healing Potions last for 10 seconds.  Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

Deckard.title: Cube Mastery
Deckard.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Scroll of Sealing from 40 to 25.  Each enemy Hero hit by Horadric Cube reduces the cooldown of Scroll of Sealing by 4 seconds.

Deckard.title: Kanai's Cube
Deckard.description: Horadric Cube reduces Hero damage dealt by 30% for 4 seconds.

Deckard.title: Emerald
Deckard.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and have it reduce the healing received of enemy Heroes by 75% for 4 seconds.  Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

Deckard.title: Stay Awhile and Listen
Deckard.description: After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after.  Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

Deckard.title: Lorenado
Deckard.description: Vector Targeting After 1 second, create a twirling tome tornado that travels towards the targeted direction, continually knocking away enemies that come into contact with it. Deals 20 (+4% per level) damage to Heroes hit.

Deckard.title: Super Healing Potion
Deckard.description: If a Healing Potion isn't picked up for at least 2 seconds, it heals for 100% more.  Passive: Healing Potion heals for 25% more when the target is under 50% health.

Deckard.title: Potion of Revival
Deckard.description: When a Healing Potion is picked up, it also heals all nearby allied Heroes for 75% of the healing amount.

Deckard.title: Ancient Blessings
Deckard.description: Activate Fortitude of the Faithful to empower nearby allied Hero Basic Attacks for 8 seconds, causing them to deal an additional 62 (+4% per level) damage in an area and heal for 90 (+4% per level) for each Hero hit. This effect can only occur once per second.

Deckard.title: Scroll of Stone Curse
Deckard.description: Scroll of Sealing deals 200% more damage when hitting at least 2 Heroes.

Deckard.title: Safety in Numbers
Deckard.description: If at least 2 allied Heroes are nearby, Fortitude of the Faithful grants an additional 10 Armor, 50% Mana Regeneration per second, and causes Deckard's Basic Abilities to recharge an additional 50% faster.

Deckard.title: Horadric Staff
Deckard.description: Every 5 seconds, Deckard's next Basic Attack Stuns Heroes for 0.75 seconds.

Deckard.title: Respect the Elderly
Deckard.description: Stay Awhile and Listen Silences and Blinds enemies for 3 seconds upon waking up from Sleep.

Deckard.title: Morenados!
Deckard.description: Lorenado gains an additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds every time an enemy Hero is knocked back. This effect can only occur once per 0.5 seconds.

Deckard.title: Bottomless Flask
Deckard.description: After use, Healing Potions recharge after 8 seconds.

Deckard.title: Perfect Gems
Deckard.description: Reduce the cooldown of all Gems to 5 seconds and the cooldown of Horadric Cube by 6 seconds.

Dehaka.title: Enduring Swarm
Dehaka.description: Dark Swarm's duration is increased by 0.5 seconds and grants 50 Spell Armor while active.

Dehaka.title: Tissue Regeneration
Dehaka.description: Regeneration Globes grant 10 Essence.  Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases Health Regeneration by 4, up to 40, and maximum Essence by 1, up to 10.

Dehaka.title: Enhanced Agility
Dehaka.description: Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus now lasts for 5 seconds after leaving a bush.  Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases the Movement Speed bonus of Brushstalker by 2%, up to 20%.

Dehaka.title: Lurker Strain
Dehaka.description: Emerging from Burrow grants Dehaka Stealth for 3 seconds and knocks nearby enemies back, dealing 125 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing them by 30% for 3 seconds.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Burrow by 3 seconds.

Dehaka.title: One-Who-Collects
Dehaka.description: Increases Essence collected from Minions by 50%. Dark Swarm deals 40% more damage to Mercenaries.

Dehaka.title: Hero Stalker
Dehaka.description: Increases Essence gained from Takedowns by 100%, and gain 1 Essence each time an enemy Hero is hit by Dark Swarm.

Dehaka.title: Feeding Frenzy
Dehaka.description: Basic Attacks reduce Drag's cooldown by 1.5 seconds.  Passive: Increase Drag's duration by 0.5 seconds.

Dehaka.title: Paralyzing Enzymes
Dehaka.description: Drag Slows enemies by 40% for 2 seconds after it ends.  Gambit: When Drag ends, deal an additional 280 (+4% per level) damage to the target over 2 seconds. Every death reduces this damage by 40 (+4% per level), up to 5 times.

Dehaka.title: Symbiosis
Dehaka.description: Every time Dark Swarm damages an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 0.4 seconds.

Dehaka.title: Isolation
Dehaka.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.
