Dehaka.title: Adaptation
Dehaka.description: After 4 seconds, heal for 100% of the damage Dehaka took over this period.

Dehaka.title: Ferocious Stalker
Dehaka.description: Dark Swarm Slows enemy Heroes by 15% for 0.75 seconds and deals 60% more damage while Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus is active.

Dehaka.title: Primal Swarm
Dehaka.description: Dark Swarm causes enemies hit to lose 10 Armor for 0.75 seconds, causing them to take 10% extra damage.

Dehaka.title: Primal Rage
Dehaka.description: Gain 1.25% increased Attack Damage per Essence stored.

Dehaka.title: Elongated Tongue
Dehaka.description: Increase Drag range by 20%.

Dehaka.title: Tunneling Claws
Dehaka.description: Increase movement speed while Burrowing to 125%.

Dehaka.title: Pack Leader
Dehaka.description: Dehaka gains 20 Armor and 15% increased Attack Speed while in a bush and for 5 seconds after leaving.

Dehaka.title: Contagion
Dehaka.description: Isolation hits all Heroes near the first target.

Dehaka.title: Change Is Survival
Dehaka.description: Increases Adaptation healing to 200% of the damage received and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.

Dehaka.title: Essence Claws
Dehaka.description: Dehaka's Basic Attacks slow the target by 20% for 1 second. If the target is a Hero, Dehaka gains 5 Essence.

Dehaka.title: Apex Predator
Dehaka.description: Reduces Brushstalker's cooldown by 50 seconds and the cast time by 0.5 seconds.

Diablo.title: Feast on Fear
Diablo.description: Stunning an enemy Hero with Shadow Charge or Overpower heals Diablo for 10% of his maximum Health over 3 seconds.

Diablo.title: Devil's Due
Diablo.description: Black Soulstone increases the effects of Regen Globes and Healing Fountains by 2.25% per Soul.

Diablo.title: Soul Shield
Diablo.description: Activate to gain 25 plus 50% of Diablo's current Souls as Spell Armor for 4 seconds. Every time Diablo damages an enemy Hero, reduce this cooldown by 1 second.

Diablo.title: Sacrificial Soul
Diablo.description: Stunning a Hero with Shadow Charge grants 10 Souls and 20 Armor for 3 seconds. While at 100 Souls, increase this Armor to 40.

Diablo.title: Souls to the Flame
Diablo.description: Fire Stomp grants 1 Soul every 3 times it damages an enemy Hero, and heals for an additional 1.3% of its damage dealt per Soul.

Diablo.title: Life Leech
Diablo.description: Diablo gains 1 Soul and heals for 1.75% of his maximum Health when Basic Attacking an enemy Hero. While at 100 Souls, increase this healing to 3.5% of his maximum Health.

Diablo.title: Eternal Flames
Diablo.description: Reduce the cooldown of Fire Stomp by 1 second. When Diablo Stuns an enemy Hero with Shadow Charge or Overpower, reset the cooldown of Fire Stomp and restore 45 Mana.

Diablo.title: Malevolence
Diablo.description: Basic Abilities cause Diablo's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds to deal an additional 100 (+4% per level) Spell Damage. Stores up to 2 charges.

Diablo.title: Diabolical Momentum
Diablo.description: When Diablo's Basic Attacks damage enemies, reduce the cooldown of Shadow Charge and Overpower by 1.5 seconds.

Diablo.title: Apocalypse
Diablo.description: Create a demonic rune under each enemy Hero on the battleground. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.75 seconds.

Diablo.title: Lightning Breath
Diablo.description: After 0.5 seconds, become Unstoppable and Channel for up to 4 seconds, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies in front of Diablo. Enemies affected are Slowed by 4% for 2 seconds, up to 40%.  Lightning Breath's direction changes with your mouse cursor position.

Diablo.title: Devastating Charge
Diablo.description: Increase Shadow Charge's terrain collision damage by 50%.  Quest: Hit an enemy Hero against terrain 5 times.  Reward: Hitting enemy Heroes against terrain reduces their Armor by 20 for 4 seconds.

Diablo.title: Hellfire
Diablo.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Fire Stomp grants 3% Spell Power for 10 seconds, up to 30%.  While at maximum stacks, Diablo deals 33 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

Diablo.title: Cruelty
Diablo.description: Stunning an enemy Hero with Shadow Charge or Overpower increases Diablo's Attack Speed by 50% for 7 seconds, up to 100%.

Diablo.title: Domination
Diablo.description: Casting Overpower resets the cooldown of Shadow Charge.

Diablo.title: Debilitating Flames
Diablo.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Fire Stomp are Slowed by 6% for 4 seconds, up to 60%. Heroes Slowed by 24% or more by Debilitating Flames deal 50% less damage.

Diablo.title: Overpowering Nightmare
Diablo.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Overpower, with a 2 second cooldown between uses.

Diablo.title: Dying Breath
Diablo.description: Apocalypse's cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds for every enemy Hero hit (to a minimum of 5 seconds) and is cast for free when Diablo dies.

Diablo.title: Hellstorm
Diablo.description: Lightning Breath lasts 200% longer.

Diablo.title: Lord of Terror
Diablo.description: Activate to steal 10% of the maximum Health of nearby enemy Heroes and gain 5 Souls per Hero hit.

Diablo.title: Hellgate
Diablo.description: Teleport and place a demonic rune at target location. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 (+4% per level) damage and stunning enemies for 1.75 seconds.

E.T.C..title: Guitar Hero
E.T.C..description: While Guitar Solo is active, E.T.C. heals for 60% of his damage dealt by Basic Attacks.  Basic Attacks increase the duration of Guitar Solo by 0.5 seconds.

E.T.C..title: Prog Rock
E.T.C..description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe permanently increases the healing per second of Guitar Solo by 5, to a maximum of 100  Reward: After gathering 20 Regeneration Globes, Guitar Solo also heals nearby allied Heroes for 50 (+4% per level) Health every second while it is active.

E.T.C..title: Block Party
E.T.C..description: Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes a stack of Block, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next Hero Basic Attack for 8 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Maximum 2 stacks of Block.

E.T.C..title: Crowd Surfer
E.T.C..description: Allows Powerslide to travel over walls and terrain. If no enemies are hit, reduce the cooldown by 7 seconds and refund the Mana cost.

E.T.C..title: Loud Speakers
E.T.C..description: Increases Face Melt range and knockback by 50%.

E.T.C..title: Speed Metal
E.T.C..description: Using a Basic or Heroic ability also gives nearby allied Heroes 20% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.

E.T.C..title: Pinball Wizard
E.T.C..description: Face Melt does 300% more damage to enemies recently affected by Powerslide.

E.T.C..title: Hammer-on
E.T.C..description: While Guitar Solo is active your Basic Attacks deal 35% more damage.

E.T.C..title: Echo Pedal
E.T.C..description: Using a Basic or Heroic Ability releases two pulses of 18 (+4% per level) damage.  This deals 200% bonus damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters. The first occurs instantly, the second occurs 2 seconds later.

E.T.C..title: Mosh Pit
E.T.C..description: After 0.75 seconds, channel to stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

E.T.C..title: Stage Dive
E.T.C..description: Leap to target location, landing after 2.75 seconds, dealing 330 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the area, and slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.

E.T.C..title: Mic Check
E.T.C..description: Hitting at least 2 targets with Face Melt reduces its cooldown by 6 seconds.

E.T.C..title: Encore
E.T.C..description: Face Melt leaves an Amp behind, which will knock enemies away again 2 seconds later.  Passive: Each enemy Hero hit by Face Melt or the Amp reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 5%.

E.T.C..title: Face Smelt
E.T.C..description: Face Melt slows enemies by 50% fading over 2 seconds.

E.T.C..title: Show Stopper
E.T.C..description: After using Powerslide, gain 35 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing all damage taken by 35%.

E.T.C..title: Aggressive Shredding
E.T.C..description: E.T.C.'s Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Guitar Solo by 0.75 seconds.

E.T.C..title: Imposing Presence
E.T.C..description: Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

E.T.C..title: Tour Bus
E.T.C..description: Channeling Mosh Pit refreshes Powerslide's cooldown, and it can be cast to increase Mosh Pit's duration by 2 seconds.

E.T.C..title: Crowd Pleaser
E.T.C..description: Stage Dive's impact area is 50% bigger, and its Slow is increased by 30%.

E.T.C..title: Death Metal
E.T.C..description: Upon dying, a ghost uses Mosh Pit at E.T.C's location.

E.T.C..title: Storm Shield
E.T.C..description: Activate to give all nearby allied Heroes a Shield for 20% of their max Health for 3 seconds.

E.T.C..title: Bolt of the Storm
E.T.C..description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

Falstad.title: Gathering Storm
Falstad.description: Quest: Every time Hammerang hits a Hero increase its damage by 0.5% and refund 6 Mana.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes with Hammerang, increase its damage by 15%.

Falstad.title: Dishonorable Discharge
Falstad.description: Reduce Lightning Rod's cooldown by 2 seconds.  Quest: After 3 Lightning Rod strikes, subsequent strikes on enemy Heroes increases its damage by 1%, up to 75%.  Reward: After 30 subsequent strikes, further reduce Lightning Rod's cooldown by 2 seconds.  Reward: After 75 subsequent strikes, Takedowns reset Lightning Rod's cooldown.

Falstad.title: Frequent Flyer
Falstad.description: Activate Frequent Flyer to gain 40% Attack Speed and Tailwind for 4 seconds.  Quest: Minion kills grant 0.2 Basic Attack Damage. Hero Takedowns grant 0.5 Basic Attack Damage.

Falstad.title: Static Shield
Falstad.description: Lightning Rod strikes grant a Shield equal to 4% of Falstad's maximum Health, up to 28%, for 4 seconds.

Falstad.title: Updraft
Falstad.description: Increases Barrel Roll's range by 40% and Shield amount by 70%, and its Shield now lasts indefinitely.

Falstad.title: Hammer Gains
Falstad.description: Basic Attacks heal for 20% of the damage dealt to the primary target.

Falstad.title: Secret Weapon
Falstad.description: Increases Hammerang's range by 30% and Basic Attacks deal 75% bonus damage while Hammerang is in flight.

Falstad.title: BOOMerang
Falstad.description: Hammerang's explosion deals 100% additional damage, and hitting enemy Heroes reduces their Spell Armor by 15 for 3 seconds.

Falstad.title: Charged Up
Falstad.description: Increases the number of Lightning Rod strikes by 2 and its range by 25%.

Falstad.title: Hinterland Blast
Falstad.description: After 1 second, deal 475 (+4.75% per level) damage to enemies within a long line. The cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds for every enemy Hero hit.

Falstad.title: Mighty Gust
Falstad.description: Push enemies away, and slow their Movement Speed by 40% decaying over 4 seconds.

Falstad.title: Thunderstrikes
Falstad.description: Lightning Rod deals 25% more damage each subsequent strike.

Falstad.title: Flow Rider
Falstad.description: While Tailwind is active, Falstad's Basic Abilities recharge 100% faster.

Falstad.title: Sustained Winds
Falstad.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1.5% of the Hero's maximum Health, increased to 2% while Tailwind is active.

Falstad.title: Crippling Hammer
Falstad.description: Increase Hammerang's Slow from 25% to 50%, and Hammerang's explosion also Slows.

Falstad.title: Aerie Gusts
Falstad.description: Reduces the activation time for Tailwind from 5 to 3 seconds, and increases the Movement Speed bonus from 15% to 25%.

Falstad.title: Afterburner
Falstad.description: Barrel Roll increases Movement Speed by 60%, decaying over 3 seconds.

Falstad.title: Call of the Wildhammer
Falstad.description: Hinterland Blast has double the range and deals 25% more damage.

Falstad.title: Wind Tunnel
Falstad.description: Mighty Gust creates a wind tunnel for 4 seconds. Enemies caught in the tunnel will periodically be pushed back.

Falstad.title: Nexus Frenzy
Falstad.description: Increases Attack Speed by 20% and Attack Range by 1.1.

Falstad.title: Epic Mount
Falstad.description: Reduce the cooldown of Flight by 50 seconds, reduce the cast time before flying to 0.5 seconds, and increase the speed by 50%.

Fenix.title: Advanced Targeting
Fenix.description: Quest: Hitting enemy Heroes with Plasma Cutter permanently increases Fenix's Basic Attack damage by 0.5, up to 60.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, Plasma Cutter circles an additional time.

Fenix.title: Arsenal Synergy
Fenix.description: After hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks 3 times while Repeater Cannon is active, the next Basic Attack with Phase Bomb deals 150% more damage and splashes in a 50% larger area.

Fenix.title: Mobile Offense
Fenix.description: After moving, Fenix's next Basic Attack deals 35% more damage to Heroes.

Fenix.title: Target Acquired
Fenix.description: Basic Attacks against Slowed Heroes with Repeater Cannon active grant 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, up to 40%.

Fenix.title: Inhibiting Energy
Fenix.description: Every 10 seconds, Fenix's next Basic Attack with Phase Bomb active Slows all enemies hit by 60%, decaying in strength over 1.5 seconds.

Fenix.title: Emergency Protocol
Fenix.description: While Fenix has shields from Shield Capacitor, he gains 10% Movement Speed.  This bonus is increased to 15% when Fenix loses shields from Shield Capacitor.

Fenix.title: Combat Advantage
Fenix.description: Plasma Cutter deals 35% more damage to Slowed targets.

Fenix.title: Warp Warfare
Fenix.description: After arriving with Warp, gain 175% Attack Speed for 4 seconds while in Repeater Cannon mode. Hero Takedowns reset Warp's cooldown.

Fenix.title: Divert Power: Weapons
Fenix.description: Activate to gain 40% Basic Attack damage for 5 seconds. Basic Attacking a Hero refreshes this duration. Once Divert Power: Weapons ends, drain all of Shield Capacitor's Shields.

Fenix.title: Purification Salvo
Fenix.description: Channel for 1.5 seconds, sweeping a laser in front of Fenix that locks onto enemy Heroes. Once Channeling finishes, fire 5 missiles at each locked Hero, dealing 79 (+4% per level) damage each. Deals 50% increased damage to Slowed targets.

Fenix.title: Planet Cracker
Fenix.description: After 0.5 seconds, Channel a powerful beam that spans across the battleground for 4 seconds, dealing 112 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to non-Structure enemies hit.

Fenix.title: Adanium Shell
Fenix.description: After arriving with Warp, gain 50 Armor for 4 seconds.

Fenix.title: Dampening Field
Fenix.description: Fenix gains 30 Spell Armor while he has a Shield from Shield Capacitor.

Fenix.title: Rapid Recharge
Fenix.description: The time before Shield Capacitor begins regenerating after taking damage is reduced by 2 seconds. Whenever Fenix is healed, Shield Capacitor's Shield recharges for 60% of the healing received.

Fenix.title: Auxiliary Shields
Fenix.description: Permanently reduce Fenix's maximum Health by 30% but increase Shield Capacitor's Shield by 40%. Basic Attacks regenerate Shields equal to 10% of the damage dealt.

Fenix.title: Offensive Cadence
Fenix.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against Heroes while Repeater Cannon is active deals an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health as damage.

Fenix.title: Photonic Weaponry
Fenix.description: Fenix deals 20% more damage while he has a Shield from Shield Capacitor.

Fenix.title: Arsenal Overcharge
Fenix.description: Basic Attacks with Repeater Cannon reduce Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds. Basic Attacks with Phase Bomb active reduce Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds per Hero hit.

Fenix.title: Armageddon Beam
Fenix.description: Planet Cracker's width increases by 100% over 1.5 seconds.  Passive: Reduce Planet Cracker's cooldown by 40 seconds.

Fenix.title: Secondary Fire
Fenix.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Plasma Cutter fires a Purification Salvo missile at them after 0.5 seconds, dealing 79 (+4% per level) damage. Deals 50% increased damage to Slowed targets.

Fenix.title: Singularity Charge
Fenix.description: Repeater Cannon grants 100% more Attack Speed, and Phase Bomb grants 1.25 more range.

Fenix.title: Unconquered Spirit
Fenix.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Shield Capacitor regains 800 (+4% per level) Shields. This effect has a 120 second cooldown.

Gall.title: Keep Moving!
Gall.description: Increases the Movement Speed bonus of Shove by 10% and its duration by 2 seconds.

Gall.title: Taskmaster
Gall.description: Every time Cho is hit by a Hero Basic Attack, reduce the cooldown of Shove by 1 second.

Gall.title: We See You!
Gall.description: Eye of Kilrogg's cooldown is decreased by 25 seconds, its range is increased by 33%, and the number of Basic Attacks required to kill it is increased by 1.

Gall.title: Rising Dread
Gall.description: Each bounce of Dread Orb increases its radius by 25% and damage by 15%. Activate Dread Orb before the second bounce ends to reverse the direction of the third bounce.

Gall.title: Runic Persistence
Gall.description: Runic Blast deals an additional 180 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds in an area around the detonation point.

Gall.title: Bomb's Away
Gall.description: Quest: Damaging a Hero with Runic Blast increases its damage by 5, up to 200.  Reward: After damaging 20 Heroes, the range and speed of Cho's Rune Bomb is increased by 20%.

Gall.title: Edge of Madness
Gall.description: Every subsequent hit of Shadowflame against the same enemy Hero deals an additional 12% damage, to a maximum of 60%. These bonuses are lost if the Hero has not been hit for 7 seconds.

Gall.title: Double Trouble
Gall.description: Quest: If Shadowflame hits an enemy Hero that is afflicted by Cho's Consuming Blaze, its cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds.  Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, Shadowflame's cooldown is instead permanently reduced by 0.5 seconds.

Gall.title: Ogre Rampage
Gall.description: Increase the damage bonus of Ogre Rage by 5%. Each time Gall damages an enemy Hero this bonus increases by 1% for 4 seconds, up to an additional 10% bonus damage.

Gall.title: Shadow Bolt Volley
Gall.description: After 1 second, unleash 20 Shadow Bolts over 4 seconds, each dealing 87 (+4% per level) damage to the first target hit. The bolts fire towards your mouse.

Gall.title: Twisting Nether
Gall.description: After 1 second, nearby enemies are slowed by 50% while Gall channels, up to 5 seconds. Activate to deal 353 (+5% per level) damage.

Gall.title: Searing Shadows
Gall.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Shadowflame take an additional 2% of their maximum Health as damage.

Gall.title: Psychotic Break
Gall.description: Increase Gall's damage to enemy Heroes by 10%. Upon dying, Gall gains Ogre Rage and can use Abilities for 10 seconds.

Gall.title: Twilight Nova
Gall.description: After the first bounce of Dread Orb, 2 extra bombs bounce to the sides once.

Gall.title: Leaden Orb
Gall.description: Dread Orb Stuns enemy Heroes for 0.75 seconds.

Gall.title: Deafening Blast
Gall.description: Runic Blast Silences enemy Heroes for 1.25 seconds.

Gall.title: Shadowsnare
Gall.description: Enemy Heroes hit by your Basic Abilities are Slowed by 15% for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 2 times.

Gall.title: Shadowfury
Gall.description: Shadow Bolt Volley hits all enemies in its path.

Gall.title: Shifting Nether
Gall.description: Twisting Nether now teleports Cho to a targeted location before it begins Channeling.

Gall.title: The Will of Gall
Gall.description: Takedowns permanently increase the bonus of Ogre Rage by 2%.

Gall.title: Twilight Frenzy
Gall.description: Activate to reduce the cooldowns of Shadowflame and Dread Orb to 2 seconds for the next 6 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Warbreaker
Garrosh.description: Quest: Stun Heroes with Groundbreaker.  Reward: After Stunning 5 Heroes, Groundbreaker's Stun deals an additional 165 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds to Heroes.  Reward: After Stunning 15 Heroes, permanently reduce Groundbreaker's cooldown by 2 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Unrivaled Strength
Garrosh.description: Increase Wrecking Ball's throw range by 25% and its damage by 125%.

Garrosh.title: Body Check
Garrosh.description: Activate to deal 111 (+4% per level) damage to a target enemy and Slow them by 35% for 3 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit receive 30% reduced healing for 3 seconds.

Garrosh.title: In for the Kill
Garrosh.description: Increase Bloodthirst's damage against non-Heroes by 70%. Killing enemies with Bloodthirst resets its cooldown and refunds its Mana cost.

Garrosh.title: Thirst for Battle
Garrosh.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Bloodthirst by 2 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Indomitable
Garrosh.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Intimidation
Garrosh.description: Groundbreaker reduces the Attack Speed of Heroes hit by 30% for 4 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Oppressor
Garrosh.description: Basic Attacks and Bloodthirst against Heroes reduce the target's Spell Power by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Lok-tar Ogar!
Garrosh.description: Increase Into the Fray's Armor by 20. Hitting enemy Heroes with Into the Fray reduces its cooldown by 12 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Warlord's Challenge
Garrosh.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Decimate
Garrosh.description: Deal 50 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and Slow them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Deals 100% more damage to Heroes, and each Hero hit reduces the cooldown by 1 second.  Stores up to 3 charges.

Garrosh.title: Defensive Measures
Garrosh.description: If Groundbreaker Stuns a Hero, Garrosh gains a 350 (+4% per level) Shield for 6 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Bloodcraze
Garrosh.description: When hitting a Hero, Bloodthirst heals for an additional 15% of Garrosh's maximum Health over 3 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Double Up
Garrosh.description: Armor Up can be activated to increase its Armor bonus by 100% for 3 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Mortal Combo
Garrosh.description: Hitting a Hero with Groundbreaker's Stun and throwing them with Wrecking Ball within 3 seconds reduces Wrecking Ball's cooldown by 10 seconds, regardless of order.

Garrosh.title: Earthshaker
Garrosh.description: Wrecking Ball Stuns enemies near the impact area for 0.5 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Seasoned Soldier
Garrosh.description: Gain 5% maximum Health, increase Groundbreaker's Slow duration by 1 second, and Bloodthirst gains an additional charge.

Garrosh.title: Death Wish
Garrosh.description: Increase the duration of Warlord's Challenge by 0.5 seconds.  If an enemy Hero is killed while Taunted by Warlord's Challenge, its cooldown is reduced by 45 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Deadly Calm
Garrosh.description: Heroes hit by Decimate deal 40% less damage for 3 seconds.

Garrosh.title: Titanic Might
Garrosh.description: Wrecking Ball now throws the 2 closest enemies.

Garrosh.title: Inner Rage
Garrosh.description: Body Check gains an additional charge and its healing reduction is increased by an additional 45%.

Gazlowe.title: Rocket Boots
Gazlowe.description: Increase the cast range of Xplodium Charge by 30% and its damage by 35%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

Gazlowe.title: Big Game Hunter
Gazlowe.description: Increase maximum Scrap by 2. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes, Mercenaries, or Monsters accelerates Reduce, Reuse, Recycle Scrap regeneration by 1.5 seconds.

Gazlowe.title: One Man Wrecking Crew
Gazlowe.description: Casting Basic Abilities cause Gazlowe's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds to deal 60% more damage.  Stores up to 2 charges.

Gazlowe.title: Rock It Sock It
Gazlowe.description: Casting Rock-It! Turret grants Gazlowe a Shield that absorbs up to 200 (+4% per level) damage for 2.5 seconds.

Gazlowe.title: Hyperfocus Coils
Gazlowe.description: Heroes hit by Deth Lazor or Xplodium Charge take an additional 2% of their maximum Health in damage. Gazlowe is healed for 150% of the damage dealt.

Gazlowe.title: EZ-PZ Dimensional Ripper
Gazlowe.description: Activate to gain 40 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 40%, and reduce damage dealt by all nearby enemy Heroes and Summons by 50% for 3 seconds

Gazlowe.title: Goblin Fusion
Gazlowe.description: Generate 3 Scrap for each Hero hit by Deth Lazor.

Gazlowe.title: Overload
Gazlowe.description: Deth Lazor can now store up to 2 charges. Each enemy Hero hit by Deth Lazor reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

Gazlowe.title: Master Blaster
Gazlowe.description: Deth Lazor and Xplodium Charge Slow enemies hit by 35% for 3 seconds. Rock-It! Turret Basic Attacks against enemies Slowed in this way extend the Slow duration by 0.5 seconds.

Gazlowe.title: Robo-Goblin
Gazlowe.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.  Passive: Basic Attacks deal 90 (+4% per level) bonus damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

Gazlowe.title: Grav-O-Bomb 3000
Gazlowe.description: After a 1.5 second delay, pull enemies toward the center of an area and deal 220 (+4% per level) damage. Basic Abilities deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds after casting Grav-O-Bomb 3000.

Gazlowe.title: Positive Reinforcement
Gazlowe.description: Primary Rock-It! Turret attacks against Heroes increase Gazlowe's Attack Speed by 40% for 3 seconds.

Gazlowe.title: Superior Schematics
Gazlowe.description: Rock-It! Turrets attack up to 2 additional enemies for 60% damage and have 30% increased Basic Attack range.

Gazlowe.title: Overcharged Capacitors
Gazlowe.description: Gazlowe gains 5% Spell Power for each active Rock-It! Turret, up to a maximum of 15%. Dealing Basic Attack damage extends the duration of Rock-It! Turrets by 1.25 seconds.

Gazlowe.title: Firin' Mah Lazorz
Gazlowe.description: Firing Deth Lazor causes all of Gazlowe's Rock-It! Turrets to fire a Deth Lazor of their own that deals 125 (+4% per level) damage.

Gazlowe.title: Ark Reaktor
Gazlowe.description: Reduce the cooldown of Xplodium Charge by 2 seconds. Casting Xplodium Charge creates 3 miniature Rock-It! Turrets that last for 3 seconds.  These Turrets do not drop Scrap or benefit from other Talents.

Gazlowe.title: Overklock
Gazlowe.description: Basic Attacks grant Gazlowe 15% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.  Dealing Basic Attack damage to Heroes causes them to take an additional 2.5% of their maximum Health as damage.

Gazlowe.title: Mecha-Lord
Gazlowe.description: Basic Attacks increase Gazlowe's Armor by 10 for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 30, and deal 50% bonus damage to Stunned or Slowed enemies.

Gazlowe.title: Miniature Black Hole
Gazlowe.description: Increase Grav-O-Bomb 3000's radius by 25% and its damage by 50%. Each enemy Hero pulled reduces its cooldown by 12 seconds.

Gazlowe.title: It's Raining Scrap
Gazlowe.description: Reduce the Scrap cost of Rock-It! Turrets by 1. Regain 2 Scrap for each Scrap pickup.

Gazlowe.title: Bomb Toss
Gazlowe.description: Xplodium Charge gains a 2nd charge with a 3 second cooldown between uses and launches 2 more bombs when it detonates.

Genji.title: Swift as the Wind
Genji.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Swift Strike increases Genji's Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds.

Genji.title: Agile Dismount
Genji.description: While mounted the range of Cyber Agility is increased by 70%, its cooldown is reduced by 14 seconds, and it Slows enemy Heroes in its landing area by 30% for 2 seconds.

Genji.title: Pathfinder
Genji.description: Jumping over terrain with Cyber Agility increases Movement Speed by 25%, and grants Stealth, for 4 seconds.

Genji.title: Shuriken Mastery
Genji.description: Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Shuriken.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, Shuriken damage is increased by 25.  Reward: After hitting 60 Heroes, Cyber Agility now refunds 3 charges of Shuriken.

Genji.title: Strike At The Heart
Genji.description: Enemies hit by the end of Swift Strike take an additional 134 (+4% per level) damage after 1 second.

Genji.title: Dragon Claw
Genji.description: After Genji blocks 330 (+4% per level) damage with Deflect, activate to release a Dragon Claw, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

Genji.title: Augmented Guard
Genji.description: When Deflect ends, Genji gains a Shield equal to 100% of the damage blocked for 4 seconds.

Genji.title: Perfect Defense
Genji.description: Deflected damage reduces the cooldown of Deflect by 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 seconds.

Genji.title: Cyber Shield
Genji.description: Using Cyber Agility grants 50 Spell Armor for 4 seconds.  Passive: Genji dodges 1 Heroic Basic Attack every 5 seconds.

Genji.title: Dragonblade
Genji.description: Unleash the Dragonblade for 8 seconds. While active, Dragonblade can be reactivated to lunge forward and slash in a huge arc, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage.

Genji.title: X-Strike
Genji.description: Perform two slashes dealing 145 (+4% per level) damage. The slashes detonate after 1.25 seconds causing an additional 290 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in their area.

Genji.title: Shingan
Genji.description: Hitting an enemy with all 3 Shuriken deals 115 (+4% per level) bonus damage.

Genji.title: Flow Like Water
Genji.description: Each enemy Hero hit with Swift Strike reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

Genji.title: Way Of The Shimada
Genji.description: Increase Genji's Basic Attack range by 1.  Each time Genji hits an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack, increase his Basic Attack damage by 1% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 15%.

Genji.title: Reflect
Genji.description: Deflect also deals an additional 33% of the damage blocked.

Genji.title: Final Cut
Genji.description: After 1 second, Swift Strike deals an additional 125 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in the area.

Genji.title: Steady Blade
Genji.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Swift Strike increases the damage of the next Swift Strike by 30%. This bonus stacks up to 3 times.

Genji.title: The Dragon Becomes Me
Genji.description: Each time Dragonblade hits an enemy Hero, the duration of Dragonblade is increased by 0.5 seconds. If a Hero is killed within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Dragonblade, Swift Strike's cooldown is reset.

Genji.title: Living Weapon
Genji.description: Each enemy Hero hit by X-Strike reduces its cooldown by 10 seconds.

Genji.title: Sharpened Stars
Genji.description: Shuriken now pierce all enemies hit. Swift Strike's refund grants 1 charge of Shuriken.

Genji.title: Zanshin
Genji.description: Quest: Block 6500 damage with Deflect, including damage blocked so far.  Reward: Deflect hits all nearby enemy Heroes.

Greymane.title: Wolfheart
Greymane.description: Increase the cooldown reduction from Basic Attacks during Inner Beast from 0.5 to 1.2 seconds.

Greymane.title: Perfect Aim
Greymane.description: Increases Gilnean Cocktail's range by 30% and refunds 45 Mana if it hits an enemy Hero.

Greymane.title: Viciousness
Greymane.description: Increases Inner Beast's duration to 4 seconds, and causes Ability damage to also refresh its duration.

Greymane.title: Thick Skin
Greymane.description: Using Darkflight grants 50 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks while in Worgen Form, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

Greymane.title: Eyes in the Dark
Greymane.description: Disengage grants Stealth for 3 seconds.

Greymane.title: Insatiable
Greymane.description: Inner Beast causes Basic Attacks to restore 10 Mana, and reduce the cooldown of Healing Fountain by 0.5 seconds.

Greymane.title: Quicksilver Bullets
Greymane.description: Increases Greymane's Human Basic Attack range by 1.1.

Greymane.title: Incendiary Elixir
Greymane.description: Quest: Reduce the cooldown of Gilnean Cocktail by 2 seconds. Every time Greymane hits an enemy Hero with the explosion damage from Gilnean Cocktail, increase its explosion damage by 25, up to 375.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, the cooldown is reduced by an additional 3 seconds.

Greymane.title: Wizened Duelist
Greymane.description: Quest: Every 6 Human Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Basic Attack damage by 1%, up to 30%. Worgen Basic Attacks grant credit for 3 Basic Attacks. Half of this bonus is lost upon death.

Greymane.title: Go for the Throat
Greymane.description: Leap at an enemy Hero and shapeshift into a Worgen, slashing for 355 (+4% per level) damage. If this kills them, the Ability can be used a second time within 10 seconds for free.

Greymane.title: Cursed Bullet
Greymane.description: Greymane shapeshifts into a Human and fires a bullet that hits the first enemy Hero in its path, dealing 35% of their current Health in damage.  Does not affect Vehicles.

Greymane.title: Running Wild
Greymane.description: Increases Darkflight and Disengage's range by 35%, and reduce their cooldowns by 1 second.

Greymane.title: Unfettered Assault
Greymane.description: Increases Razor Swipe's lunge distance by 60%, and Worgen Basic Attacks reduce Razor Swipe's cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

Greymane.title: On the Prowl
Greymane.description: Inner Beast increases Movement Speed by 30% once it has been active for 3 seconds.

Greymane.title: Eager Wolf
Greymane.description: Increases the Attack Speed bonus of Inner Beast by an additional 40% after it has been active for 4 seconds.

Greymane.title: Executioner
Greymane.description: Attacking a Hero that is slowed, rooted, or stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

Greymane.title: Alpha Killer
Greymane.description: Worgen Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 3% of the Hero's maximum Health.

Greymane.title: Unleashed
Greymane.description: Passive: Go For The Throat's damage is increased by 25%.  If Go for the Throat kills its target, refund its Mana cost and reset the cooldowns of Greymane's Abilities.

Greymane.title: Gilnean Roulette
Greymane.description: Cursed Bullet's damage is reduced to 30% of current health but its cooldown is reduced by 24 seconds.

Greymane.title: Hunter's Blunderbuss
Greymane.description: Human Basic Attacks splash for 100% damage behind the target.

Greymane.title: Tooth and Claw
Greymane.description: Worgen Basic Attacks cleave for 100% damage. Increase Razor Swipe's damage by 100%.

Gul'dan.title: Pursuit of Flame
Gul'dan.description: Quest: Hit 30 enemy Heroes with Fel Flame.  Reward: Fel Flame's radius is increased by 10%.

Gul'dan.title: Chaotic Energy
Gul'dan.description: Increases the cast range of Drain Life by 25% and the healing provided by Regen Globes by 50%.  Quest: Gather 15 Regen Globes.  Reward: Basic Ability Mana costs are permanently reduced by 20.

Gul'dan.title: Echoed Corruption
Gul'dan.description: Quest: Hit 40 enemy Heroes with Corruption.  Reward: After the third strike, Corruption strikes 3 times in the opposite direction.

Gul'dan.title: Health Funnel
Gul'dan.description: Drain Life's cooldown recharges 100% faster while it is channeling. If an enemy dies while under the effect of Drain Life, the cooldown is instantly refreshed.

Gul'dan.title: Improved Life Tap
Gul'dan.description: Increase the Mana restored by Life Tap to 40%.

Gul'dan.title: Consume Soul
Gul'dan.description: Instantly kill an enemy Minion and heal for 365 (+4% per level) Health.  Stores up to 3 charges.

Gul'dan.title: Bound by Shadow
Gul'dan.description: Each enemy Hero hit with Fel Flame reduces the cooldown of Corruption by 1.75 seconds.

Gul'dan.title: Curse of Exhaustion
Gul'dan.description: Drain Life deals 50% more damage and Slows the target's Movement Speed by 40%.

Gul'dan.title: Hunger for Power
Gul'dan.description: Increases Spell Power by 15% but reduces healing received from allies by 25%.

Gul'dan.title: Horrify
Gul'dan.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 120 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in an area and Fear them for 2 seconds. While Feared, Heroes are Silenced and are forced to run away from Horrify's center.

Gul'dan.title: Rain of Destruction
Gul'dan.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a rain of meteors in an area for 7 seconds. Each meteor deals 165 (+4% per level) damage in a small area.

Gul'dan.title: Fel Armor
Gul'dan.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Fel Flame grants 50 Spell Armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 50%.

Gul'dan.title: Harvest Life
Gul'dan.description: Drain Life heals for 75% more Health when used on Heroes.

Gul'dan.title: Dark Bargain
Gul'dan.description: Gul'dan's maximum Health is permanently increased by 40% but his respawn time is increased by 10 seconds.

Gul'dan.title: Healthstone
Gul'dan.description: Activate to heal for 25% of Gul'dan's maximum Health.

Gul'dan.title: Rampant Hellfire
Gul'dan.description: Fel Flame's damage is increased by 12% for 5 seconds when hitting an enemy Hero. This can stack up to 5 times.

Gul'dan.title: Ruinous Affliction
Gul'dan.description: Corruption deals an additional 78 (+4% per level) damage on impact. If the enemy is hit by all three strikes, the third strike deals 268 (+4% per level) damage.

Gul'dan.title: Darkness Within
Gul'dan.description: Dealing 600 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes causes the next cast of Life Tap to cost no Health and grant Gul'dan 25% Spell Power for 5 seconds.

Gul'dan.title: Haunt
Gul'dan.description: Increases the duration of Horrify by 1 second, and while Feared, enemies lose 20 Armor, causing them to take 20% increased damage.

Gul'dan.title: Deep Impact
Gul'dan.description: Rain of Destruction slows enemies Movement Speed by 90% for 0.5 seconds.

Gul'dan.title: Demonic Circle
Gul'dan.description: Summon a Demonic Circle at Gul'dan's location. Activate to teleport Gul'dan to the Demonic Circle.

Hanzo.title: Target Practice
Hanzo.description: Quest: Hit every enemy Hero with Storm Bow.  Reward: After hitting every enemy Hero once with Storm Bow, its range is increased by 30%.  Reward: After hitting every enemy Hero 3 times with Storm Bow, its damage is increased by 100.

Hanzo.title: Simple Geometry
Hanzo.description: Quest: Hit a Hero with multiple arrows from the same Scatter Arrow cast 20 times. Each arrow hit after the second grants additional progress.  Reward: Upon hitting terrain for the first time, Scatter Arrow creates 2 additional arrows.

Hanzo.title: Redemption
Hanzo.description: Quest: Every 2 Basic Attacks against the same Hero within 10 seconds grants 1 Redemption, stacking up to 12. Dying decreases Redemption by 3, and Redemption can be lost even at maximum stacks.  Reward: At 12 Redemption, gain 50% Attack Speed.

Hanzo.title: Explosive Arrows
Hanzo.description: Upon hitting a Minion or Monster, Storm Bow deals 60% of its damage to enemies around its target.

Hanzo.title: Serrated Arrows
Hanzo.description: Scatter Arrow deals 100% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

Hanzo.title: Ignore All Distractions
Hanzo.description: Basic Attacks instantly kill Minions and increase Hanzo's Basic Attack range by 2 for 3 seconds.

Hanzo.title: The Dragon Hungers
Hanzo.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 5% Spell Power for 12 seconds, stacking up to 20%.

Hanzo.title: Never Outmatched
Hanzo.description: Reduce Scatter Arrow's Mana cost from 50 to 30. Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Scatter Arrow by 3 seconds.

Hanzo.title: Sharpened Arrowheads
Hanzo.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow or Basic Attacks reduces their Armor by 3 for 3 seconds, up to a maximum reduction of 20 Armor.

Hanzo.title: Dragonstrike
Hanzo.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a pair of Spirit Dragons which travel forward, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemy Heroes in its area.  Enemies in the center take 75% increased damage.

Hanzo.title: Dragon's Arrow
Hanzo.description: Fire a missile that travels across the battleground. Explodes upon hitting an enemy Hero, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  After traveling a medium distance, the damage is increased to 260 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 1.25 seconds.  After traveling a long distance, the damage is increased to 390 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 2 seconds.

Hanzo.title: Fleet of Foot
Hanzo.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 10% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 30%.

Hanzo.title: Ninja Assassin
Hanzo.description: Hitting Heroes with Storm Bow lowers Natural Agility's cooldown by 10 seconds. Additionally, Hero Takedowns reset Natural Agility's cooldown.

Hanzo.title: Mounted Archery
Hanzo.description: Reduce the cooldown of Summon Mount by 2 seconds.  Upon mounting, gain 25% additional Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Using Natural Agility instantly mounts.

Hanzo.title: Flawless Technique
Hanzo.description: Hitting Heroes with Storm Bow increases the damage of Hanzo's next Basic Attack within 5 seconds by 40%. Basic Attacks against Heroes increase the damage of Hanzo's next Storm Bow within 5 seconds by 40%.

Hanzo.title: Piercing Arrows
Hanzo.description: Storm Bow and Scatter Arrow pierce, hitting an additional enemy. Additionally, Scatter Arrow can pierce through 1 enemy each time it ricochets.

Hanzo.title: Giant Slayer
Hanzo.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Scatter Arrow and Basic Attacks take a bonus 2% of their maximum Health as damage.

Hanzo.title: The Dragon Awakens
Hanzo.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow, Scatter Arrow, or Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Dragonstrike by 4 seconds.

Hanzo.title: Play of the Game
Hanzo.description: While in flight or for up to 2 seconds after impacting a target, Dragon's Arrow can be reactivated to teleport to its location and jump backwards. If used after impact, Hanzo shoots arrows that deal 132 (+4% per level) damage to each target hit by the impact.  Hanzo is Unstoppable during Play of the Game.

Hanzo.title: Bullseye
Hanzo.description: Increase Sonic Arrow's speed and center radius by 100%. Additionally, Heroes hit by Sonic Arrow's center are Stunned for 1 second.

Hanzo.title: Perfect Agility
Hanzo.description: Natural Agility gains a 2nd charge and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

Hogger.title: Journeyman Cooking
Hogger.description: Each Hero hit by Ez-Thro Dynamite heals you for 8% of maximum Health.  Quest: Hitting Heroes with Ez-Thro Dynamite permanently increases your maximum Health by 10, to a maximum of 750 bonus Health.

Hogger.title: Bones to Gnaw
Hogger.description: Loot Hoard creates a chunk of Meat when it lands. While under the effects of Meat, gain 10 Armor.

Hogger.title: On The Prowl
Hogger.description: Activate to gain 30 Rage over 8 seconds.  Passive: You heal for 8 (+4% per level) Health every second, increased by 2% per point of Rage.

Hogger.title: Brute Force
Hogger.description: Increase the range of Loot Hoard by 20% and its damage by 50%.  Quest: Hitting Heroes with Staggering Blow permanently increases Basic Attack damage by 2, to a maximum of 150 bonus damage. Enemy Heroes that hit terrain grant an additional 8 damage.

Hogger.title: Aggro Range
Hogger.description: Increase Hogg Wild's radius by 20% and each enemy hit generates 0.5 Rage, increased to 2 against Heroes.

Hogger.title: Hogger's Joggers
Hogger.description: While above 30 Rage, gain 10% increased Movement Speed and healing received.  When at or above 50 Rage, increase these bonuses to 15%.

Hogger.title: Dense Blasting Powder
Hogger.description: Instant detonations of Ez-Thro Dynamite creates an additional dynamite behind the Hero hit.  Hitting the bundle of Ez-Thro Dynamite with Staggering Blow breaks it into three sticks and launches them forward in an arc.

Hogger.title: Garbage Fire
Hogger.description: Reduce the cooldown of Loot Hoard by 2 seconds.  Every 0.5 seconds, enemies in a large area around Loot Hoard take 23 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 20%.

Hogger.title: Seeing Red
Hogger.description: While above 50 Rage, gain 35% Attack Speed and the cooldowns of Staggering Blow and Hogg Wild refresh 30% faster.

Hogger.title: Hoardapult
Hogger.description: Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing 100 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds.  Hoardapult's Loot Hoard lasts for up to 20 seconds, decaying rapidly while not nearby. Every 10 seconds Hogger can take a chunk of Meat from the Loot Hoard.

Hogger.title: Shockwave
Hogger.description: After 0.5 seconds, slam the ground, sending out a shockwave that travels in a long line. Enemies hit by the initial slam take 335 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Enemies only hit by the shockwave take 230 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.75 seconds.

Hogger.title: Dust Devil
Hogger.description: Gain 20 Armor while Hogg Wild is active and for 3 seconds after. When at or above 50 Rage, increase this Armor to 40.

Hogger.title: Pummel
Hogger.description: Enemies hit by Hogg Wild are Slowed by 10% for 2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.  Heroes hit have their Spell Power reduced by 50% for 2 seconds.

Hogger.title: Bloodthirst
Hogger.description: Damaging Heroes with Basic Attacks, Staggering Blow, or Hogg Wild heals you for 33% of the damage dealt.

Hogger.title: Headbanger
Hogger.description: Enemy Heroes Stunned by Staggering Blow take an additional 8% of their maximum Health as damage and are Stunned for an additional 0.5 seconds.

Hogger.title: Kablooie!
Hogger.description: Instant Ez-Thro Dynamite detonations deal 50% more damage, reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds, and increase its Slow amount to 50%.  Passive: Increase Ez-Thro Dynamite's range by 25%.

Hogger.title: Furzerker
Hogger.description: Hitting Heroes with Staggering Blow or Ez-Thro Dynamite increases the damage of the next Basic Attack within 8 seconds by 50%, stacking up to 2 times.  When Hogg Wild ends, gain 30% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

Hogger.title: Secret Stash
Hogger.description: Every 2 seconds, Hoardapults' Loot Hoard randomly launches Ez-Thro Dynamite, prioritizing nearby enemy Heroes.  Every 5 seconds, it also launches a chunk of Meat towards Hogger.

Hogger.title: Power Spike
Hogger.description: Hitting Heroes with Shockwave reduces their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds and grants 20 Rage.  Passive: Rage's cooldown reduction affects Shockwave's cooldown.

Hogger.title: No Control
Hogger.description: Activate to cast an untalented Hogg Wild and begin chasing an enemy Hero. After reaching the Hero, bounce to a random nearby enemy Hero. Lasts up to 5 seconds, rapidly decaying if there are no other enemy Heroes nearby.  Cannot be cancelled.

Hogger.title: Anger Management
Hogger.description: Increase maximum Rage by 50, raising the maximum bonuses for its cooldown refresh rate to 75% and Hogg Wild's Hero damage to 75%.  Passive: Basic Attacks grant 5 additional Rage.

Illidan.title: Immolation
Illidan.description: After using Sweeping Strike, burn nearby enemies for 22 (+4% per level) damage a second for 4 seconds.

Illidan.title: Battered Assault
Illidan.description: Increase Sweeping Strike's Basic Attack damage bonus duration from 3 to 5 seconds. If Sweeping Strike hits 2 Heroes its damage bonus is increased from 35% to 125%.

Illidan.title: Unending Hatred
Illidan.description: Quest: Minion kills grant 0.2 Basic Attack Damage. Hero Takedowns grant 1 Basic Attack Damage.  Reward: After gaining 20 increased Basic Attack Damage, receive an additional 20 Basic Attack Damage.

Illidan.title: Reflexive Block
Illidan.description: Using Dive grants 75 Physical Armor against the next 3 Hero Basic Attacks for 4 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

Illidan.title: Thirsting Blade
Illidan.description: Betrayer's Thirst's healing from Basic Attacks is increased from 30% to 50% while Sweeping Strike's damage bonus is active.

Illidan.title: Hunter's Onslaught
Illidan.description: Basic Abilities heal for 35% of the damage they deal. This bonus is doubled versus Heroes.

Illidan.title: Rapid Chase
Illidan.description: Dive grants 20% Movement Speed for 3 seconds. If the target is an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

Illidan.title: Friend or Foe
Illidan.description: Increases the range of Dive by 20% and allows it to be used to dive to allied Heroes.

Illidan.title: Unbound
Illidan.description: Sweeping Strike can go over walls and terrain.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes with Sweeping Strike, gain a second charge.

Illidan.title: Metamorphosis
Illidan.description: Transform into Demon Form at the target location, dealing 46 (+4% per level) damage in the area. Temporarily increases maximum Health by 220 (+4% per level) for each Hero hit by the initial impact. Lasts for 18 seconds.

Illidan.title: The Hunt
Illidan.description: Charge to target unit, dealing 251 (+4% per level) damage on impact and stunning for 1 second.

Illidan.title: Nimble Defender
Illidan.description: If Sweeping Strike hits an enemy Hero, gain 25 Armor for 2 seconds, reducing damage taken by 25%.

Illidan.title: Elusive Strike
Illidan.description: Sweeping Strike reduces the cooldown of Evasion by 3 seconds every time it damages an enemy Hero.

Illidan.title: Sixth Sense
Illidan.description: While active, Evasion grants Illidan 75 Spell Armor against the next 2 sources of Spell Damage, reducing their damage by 75%.

Illidan.title: Marked for Death
Illidan.description: Dive deals an extra 180 (+4% per level) damage if used consecutively on a target within 10 seconds.

Illidan.title: Fiery Brand
Illidan.description: Every 3rd attack against the same Hero deals an additional 7% of their maximum Health as damage.

Illidan.title: Blades of Azzinoth
Illidan.description: Hitting 5 Heroes with Sweeping Strike allows Blades of Azzinoth to be activated, increasing Basic Attack damage by 75% for 8 seconds.

Illidan.title: Demonic Form
Illidan.description: Permanently remain in Demonic Form. Metamorphosis also increases Attack Speed by 20% and reduces the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows by 50%. Illidan can now mount in Demonic Form.

Illidan.title: Nowhere to Hide
Illidan.description: The Hunt gains unlimited range. Illidan passively reveals enemy Heroes below 25% Health anywhere on the Battleground.

Illidan.title: Nexus Blades
Illidan.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

Illidan.title: Bolt of the Storm
Illidan.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

Imperius.title: Impaling Light
Imperius.description: Celestial Charge's final damage is increased by 75% and its cooldown is reduced by 1.25 seconds for each Valorous Brand on the target when the Stun completes.

Imperius.title: Consuming Flame
Imperius.description: Increase the center damage of Solarion's Fire by an additional 125% and its Slow amount by 15%. The first enemy Hero hit with Solarion's Fire restores 30 Mana.

Imperius.title: Burn The Impure
Imperius.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark deals bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

Imperius.title: Sovereign Armor
Imperius.description: Molten Armor grants 20 Armor for 1.5 seconds. Damaging an enemy Hero with Molten Armor increases the duration of the Armor by 0.5 seconds.

Imperius.title: Battle Hunger
Imperius.description: Increase the healing of Valorous Brand by 80%.

Imperius.title: Press Forward
Imperius.description: Gain 10 Armor while being healed by a Regeneration Globe.  Damaging an enemy Hero sets the duration of an active Regeneration Globe on Imperius to 8 seconds (unless it is already higher).

Imperius.title: Flash of Anger
Imperius.description: Consuming a mark from Celestial Charge deals 150 (+4% per level) damage to the target and nearby enemies and grants Imperius a 250 (+4% per level) point Shield for 4 seconds.

Imperius.title: Blaze of Glory
Imperius.description: Solarion's Fire leaves a line of scorched earth along its center that explodes after 2 seconds for 205 (+4% per level) damage, dealing bonus damage with Valorous Brand marks.

Imperius.title: Holy Fervor
Imperius.description: Activate to cause the next 4 Basic Attacks within 10 seconds to cleave for 30% additional damage.  Passive: Casting Molten Armor grants Holy Fervor for 2 Basic Attacks.

Imperius.title: Angelic Armaments
Imperius.description: Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds.  If the Shield lasts the full duration, this ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.

Imperius.title: Wrath of the Angiris
Imperius.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge in the target direction, lifting the first enemy Hero hit into the Heavens. While in the air, Imperius can steer the landing location by moving.  After 2 seconds, slam the target into the ground, dealing 375 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1 second.

Imperius.title: Pathetic Mortals
Imperius.description: Stunning enemy Heroes with Celestial Charge reduces their Movement Speed by 25% and their damage by 50% for 4 seconds.

Imperius.title: Divine Rage
Imperius.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark reduces the cooldown of Molten Armor by 1 second.

Imperius.title: Heat of Battle
Imperius.description: Increase Molten Armor's healing against Heroes by 2% for every 1% Health Imperius is missing.

Imperius.title: Celestial Swiftness
Imperius.description: Gain 20% Movement Speed for 5 seconds after casting Celestial Charge. Gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds for each Hero stunned with Celestial Charge.

Imperius.title: Melting Touch
Imperius.description: Consuming a Molten Armor mark reduces the target's Armor by 25 for 4 seconds.

Imperius.title: Valorous Pursuit
Imperius.description: Activate to teleport to an enemy that has been marked by Valorous Brand and gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds.

Imperius.title: Heavenly Host
Imperius.description: Nearby allied Heroes gain 600 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds.  If the Shield lasts the full duration, fire a sword at the nearest enemy Hero, dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage.

Imperius.title: Unrelenting Descent
Imperius.description: Descending from the Heavens restores 30% of Imperius' maximum Health and Mana. Consuming a Valorous Brand reduces the cooldown of Wrath of the Angiris by 10 seconds.

Imperius.title: Brand of Solarion
Imperius.description: Reduce the duration of Valorous Brand to 5 seconds, but it is no longer consumed when triggered.

Imperius.title: Impervious
Imperius.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 75 Spell Armor for 3 seconds. Hitting Heroes with the center of Solarion's Fire reduces this cooldown by 5 seconds.

Jaina.title: Winter's Reach
Jaina.description: Increase the range and travel speed of Frostbolt by 30%.

Jaina.title: Lingering Chill
Jaina.description: Increase the duration of Chill from 4 seconds to 6 seconds.

Jaina.title: Fingers of Frost
Jaina.description: Quest: Gather Regeneration Globes to increase Jaina's Mana regeneration by 0.1 per second, up to 2 per second.  Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, the damage bonus from Frostbite is increased by 10%.

Jaina.title: Frost Shards
Jaina.description: Frostbolt will now pierce the first two targets.

Jaina.title: Arcane Intellect
Jaina.description: Dealing damage to a Chilled target returns Mana to Jaina. Basic Attacks return 5 Mana and Abilities return 20.  Passive: While above 75% Mana, Jaina gains 10% Spell Power.

Jaina.title: Frost Armor
Jaina.description: Enemies that attack Jaina are Chilled. Additionally, every 10 seconds, Jaina gains 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

Jaina.title: Ice Lance
Jaina.description: Hitting a Chilled target with Frostbolt reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds and restores 10 Mana.

Jaina.title: Ice Floes
Jaina.description: Increase the width of Cone of Cold by 100% and cause each Hero hit to reduce its cooldown by 2 seconds, doubled against chilled Heroes, up to a maximum of 8 seconds per use.

Jaina.title: Icefury Wand
Jaina.description: Basic Attacks against Chilled enemies deal 50% more damage and lower the cooldown of Blizzard by 1.25 seconds.  Doubled against enemy Heroes.

Jaina.title: Ring of Frost
Jaina.description: After a 1.5 second delay, create a Ring of Frost in an area that deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Roots enemies for 3 seconds. The ring persists for 3 seconds afterward, Chilling any enemies who touch it.

Jaina.title: Summon Water Elemental
Jaina.description: Summon a Water Elemental at target location. The Water Elemental's Basic Attacks deal 62 (+4% per level) damage, splash for 25% damage and Chill. The Ability can be reactivated to retarget the Water Elemental.  Lasts 20 seconds.

Jaina.title: Storm Front
Jaina.description: Increase the cast range of Blizzard by 75% and its radius by 30%.

Jaina.title: Ice Barrier
Jaina.description: Gain a Shield for 25% of Ability damage dealt to Chilled targets. The shield lasts 4 seconds.

Jaina.title: Icy Veins
Jaina.description: Activate to make Jaina's Basic Abilities' cooldowns recharge 200% faster and reduce their Mana cost by 50% for 5 seconds.

Jaina.title: Snowstorm
Jaina.description: The damage of the second wave of Blizzard is increased by 50%. The damage of the third wave is increased by 100%.

Jaina.title: Northern Exposure
Jaina.description: Enemies damaged by Cone of Cold have their Armor lowered by 25 for 2 seconds, increasing their damage taken by 25%.

Jaina.title: Numbing Blast
Jaina.description: Cone of Cold Roots Chilled targets for 1 second.

Jaina.title: Cold Snap
Jaina.description: The center area of Ring of Frost deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Roots enemies after the outer ring expires. Each enemy Hero hit reduces its cooldown by 15 seconds.

Jaina.title: Wintermute
Jaina.description: Increases the cast range of Water Elemental by 50%, and the Water Elemental will now mimic Jaina's Basic Abilities for 50% damage.

Jaina.title: Ice Blink
Jaina.description: Activate to teleport a short distance and Chill all nearby enemies.

Jaina.title: Deep Chill
Jaina.description: Frostbite's Chill can now stack a second time, slowing targets up to 40%.

Johanna.title: Zealous Glare
Johanna.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 75% more damage.

Johanna.title: Divine Fortress
Johanna.description: Basic Attacks grant 10 Physical Armor for 4 seconds, stacking up to 40.  Gambit: Gain 20% bonus maximum Health. Every death reduces this bonus by 5%.

Johanna.title: Laws of Hope
Johanna.description: Activate to heal 20% of Johanna's max Health over 5 seconds.  Quest: Every 10 Regeneration Globes gathered increases this heal amount by 5% of Johanna's max Health.

Johanna.title: Subdue
Johanna.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish increases the Slow to 80% and the Slow amount does not decay.  Quest: Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish.  Reward: Punish always Slows by 80%.

Johanna.title: Eternal Retaliation
Johanna.description: Mark enemies hit by Condemn for 10 seconds. Johanna's next Basic Attack against them removes the mark, lowering the cooldown of Condemn by 1 second, refunding 10 Mana, and killing Minions.

Johanna.title: Hold Your Ground
Johanna.description: Increases Iron Skin's Shield by 40% and its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

Johanna.title: Sins Exposed
Johanna.description: Punish reduces healing received by 35% for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks against them refresh this duration.

Johanna.title: Conviction
Johanna.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

Johanna.title: Steed Charge
Johanna.description: Activate to instantly Mount for 3 seconds, unhindered by damage.  Passive: Increase the duration of Iron Skin by 2 second.

Johanna.title: Falling Sword
Johanna.description: Johanna leaps into the air for 2 seconds and she can steer the landing location by moving. While in the air, allies below Johanna are Unstoppable. Upon landing enemies hit take 225 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.25 seconds.

Johanna.title: Blessed Shield
Johanna.description: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

Johanna.title: Roar
Johanna.description: Increase Punish's damage by 50%. This bonus is increased to 150% whenever Punish hits 2 or more Heroes.

Johanna.title: Holy Fury
Johanna.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Each Hero hit by Condemn increases this damage by 40% for 5 seconds.

Johanna.title: Blessed Hammer
Johanna.description: Activate to create 2 hammers that spiral outward from Johanna, dealing 74 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit. Damaging enemies with Basic Abilities reduce the cooldown of this Ability by 2 seconds.  Passive: Every 3rd Basic Attack against enemy Heroes releases a hammer.

Johanna.title: Shrinking Vacuum
Johanna.description: Condemn reduces enemy Heroes damage by 25% and Slows by 25% for 2 seconds.

Johanna.title: Holy Renewal
Johanna.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Shield Glare reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds and heals for 5% of Johanna's maximum Health.

Johanna.title: Blessed Momentum
Johanna.description: Basic Attacks grant 10% increased Attack Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 40%. They also reduce Johanna's Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

Johanna.title: Heaven's Fury
Johanna.description: Falling Sword rains down holy bolts, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemies, healing allied Heroes for 68 (+4% per level), and reducing its cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

Johanna.title: Radiating Faith
Johanna.description: Increase the number of enemies hit by Blessed Shield by 2. Its Stun duration is increased to 1.75 seconds and all targets hit are Stunned for the maximum duration.

Johanna.title: Indestructible
Johanna.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Johanna gains a Shield equal to her maximum Health for 4 seconds. This effect has a 120 second cooldown.

Johanna.title: Blinded By The Light
Johanna.description: Activate to grant nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 25% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.  Hitting Heroes with Shield Glare reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 8 seconds.

Junkrat.title: Tricky Shuffles
Junkrat.description: While Frag Launcher has no charges left, Junkrat gains 10% Movement Speed and his Basic Attacks deal 15% bonus damage.

Junkrat.title: Extra-Wound Timers
Junkrat.description: The final grenade launched from Frag Launcher deals 120% bonus damage, and Frag Launcher grenades last an additional 2 seconds before automatically detonating.

Junkrat.title: Blow 'Em Up!
Junkrat.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Concussion Mine or Steel Trap causes Junkrat to deal 25% more damage with Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities for 6 seconds.

Junkrat.title: Taste For Explosions
Junkrat.description: Quest: Hitting a Hero with Frag Launcher increases its damage by 0.2%, up to 40%.

Junkrat.title: BOOM POW
Junkrat.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Concussion Mine reduces its cooldown by 10 seconds.

Junkrat.title: Chattering Teeth
Junkrat.description: Steel Traps will slowly chase nearby enemy Heroes.

Junkrat.title: Bogged Down
Junkrat.description: Enemies launched by Concussion Mine are Slowed by 40% for 2.5 seconds upon landing.

Junkrat.title: Sticky Wicket
Junkrat.description: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Steel Trap are Silenced for 2 seconds.

Junkrat.title: Dirty Trickster
Junkrat.description: Increase the explosion radius of Total Mayhem by 20%.  When Junkrat is Stunned, Rooted, or damaged by an enemy Hero while below 50% Health, he uses Total Mayhem, dropping 5 grenades at his feet that explode.   This effect has a 12 second cooldown.

Junkrat.title: RIP-Tire
Junkrat.description: Create a motorized bomb with 530 (+4% per level) Health that lasts 15 seconds. While active, Junkrat is immobile but gains control of RIP-Tire's movement.  RIP-Tire can be reactivated to detonate immediately, knocking nearby enemies back and dealing 720 (+4% per level) damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445 (+4% per level) to enemies on the edge.

Junkrat.title: Rocket Ride
Junkrat.description: After 1.25 seconds, Junkrat launches into the air. While in the air, he can steer the landing location by moving.  After 3.75 seconds, Junkrat lands, dealing 935 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and activating Total Mayhem. 5 seconds after landing, Junkrat reappears at the Hall of Storms and gains 150% additional Movement Speed until dismounted.

Junkrat.title: Bombs Away
Junkrat.description: Increase Junkrat's Basic Attack range by 1.  Frag Launcher grenades fired within 0.5 seconds of using a Basic Attack deal 30% bonus damage.

Junkrat.title: Ripper Air
Junkrat.description: Junkrat is knocked back 50% farther by Concussion Mine. Additionally, Concussion Mine's cooldown is reduced by 12 seconds if only Junkrat is hit.

Junkrat.title: Gotta Trap 'Em All!
Junkrat.description: Reduce Steel Trap's cooldown by 5 seconds and increase the maximum number of active traps to 2.

Junkrat.title: Big As
Junkrat.description: Steel Trap now only hits Heroes, and Heroes hit have their Armor reduced by 15 for 3 seconds. Increases Steel Trap's radius and damage by 50%.

Junkrat.title: Burst Fire
Junkrat.description: Frag Launcher fires all of its charges in a continuous burst, its cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds, but it loses 1 maximum charge.

Junkrat.title: Endless Nades
Junkrat.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Frag Launcher reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

Junkrat.title: Spread Volley
Junkrat.description: Activate to make Frag Launcher fire 2 additional grenades in a spread. Works for up to 4 total charges, or until Frag Launcher runs out of charges.

Junkrat.title: Extra Oomph
Junkrat.description: Increase RIP-Tire's knockback distance by 50%, and its cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds for each enemy Hero hit.

Junkrat.title: Puckish Scamp
Junkrat.description: Junkrat also gains the Ability RIP-Tire. Each time he uses his Heroic, it swaps to the alternate ability.  Passive: Reduce both Heroic cooldowns by 20 seconds.

Junkrat.title: Cannonball!
Junkrat.description: Increase the radius and explosion radius of grenades from Basic Attacks and Frag Launcher by 50%.

Junkrat.title: I Hate Waiting!
Junkrat.description: Junkrat always rides his Rocket Ride Mount, which grants 150% increased Movement Speed, but his Mount cooldown is increased to 8 seconds.

Kael'thas.title: Convection
Kael'thas.description: Quest: Damaging an enemy Hero with Flamestrike increase its damage by 5, up to 100. This bonus is lost on death.  Reward: After hitting 20 enemy Heroes, increase Flamestrike damage by an additional 100 and no longer lose any bonuses on death.

Kael'thas.title: Fel Infusion
Kael'thas.description: Increases Kael'thas's Spell Power by 4%. Kael'thas heals for 94 (+4% per level) Health when activating Verdant Spheres.

Kael'thas.title: Mana Addict
Kael'thas.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Kael'thas's maximum Mana by 15.  Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, Kael'thas can activate Arcane Barrier to gain a Shield equal to 100% of his maximum Mana for 4 seconds. 45 second cooldown.

Kael'thas.title: Nether Wind
Kael'thas.description: Increases Gravity Lapse's range by 30%. When Gravity Lapse hits an enemy Hero, refund 80 Mana.

Kael'thas.title: Energy Roil
Kael'thas.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Gravity Lapse by 70.  If Gravity Lapse hits a Hero, reduce its cooldown by 8 seconds.

Kael'thas.title: Mana Tap
Kael'thas.description: Activating Verdant Spheres restores 5% of Kael'thas's maximum Mana.

Kael'thas.title: Burned Flesh
Kael'thas.description: When Flamestrike damages 2 or more Heroes, they take additional damage equal to 8% of their maximum Health.

Kael'thas.title: Sun King's Fury
Kael'thas.description: Living Bombs that spread to enemy Heroes deal 35% more damage.

Kael'thas.title: Sunfire Enchantment
Kael'thas.description: Activating Verdant Spheres causes Kael'thas's next 2 Basic Attacks to instead deal 115 (+4% per level) Spell Damage.  If both of these Attacks hit enemy Heroes, gain 15% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

Kael'thas.title: Phoenix
Kael'thas.description: Launch a Phoenix to an area, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage to enemies along the way. The Phoenix persists for 7 seconds, attacking enemies for 84 (+4% per level) damage and splashing for 42 (+4% per level) damage.

Kael'thas.title: Pyroblast
Kael'thas.description: After 1.5 seconds, cast a slow-moving fireball that deals 810 (+5% per level) damage to an enemy Hero and 405 (+5% per level) damage to enemies nearby.

Kael'thas.title: Pyromaniac
Kael'thas.description: Each time Living Bomb deals periodic damage, Kael'thas's Basic Ability cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds.

Kael'thas.title: Backdraft
Kael'thas.description: Living Bomb's explosion slows enemy Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.

Kael'thas.title: Fission Bomb
Kael'thas.description: Increases Living Bomb's explosion radius by 20%.

Kael'thas.title: Fury of the Sunwell
Kael'thas.description: Flamestrike will explode a second time 1.5 seconds later.

Kael'thas.title: Ignite
Kael'thas.description: Flamestrikes apply Living Bomb to the enemy Hero closest to its center who is not currently affected by Living Bomb.

Kael'thas.title: Twin Spheres
Kael'thas.description: Verdant Spheres gains a second charge.  Passive: Kael'thas benefits from all of his level 7 talents.

Kael'thas.title: Rebirth
Kael'thas.description: Increases Phoenix duration by 100%. While alive, the Phoenix may be ordered to move to a different location.

Kael'thas.title: Presence Of Mind
Kael'thas.description: Increases Pyroblast's explosion radius by 50%. Heroes that are hit by Flamestrike or have Living Bomb spread to them reduce the cooldown of Pyroblast by 10 seconds.

Kael'thas.title: Master of Flames
Kael'thas.description: Living Bomb's spread from explosions can now also spread Living Bomb.

Kael'thas.title: Flamethrower
Kael'thas.description: Increases the cast range of Flamestrike by 40%. If Flamestrike hits 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

Kel'Thuzad.title: The Plaguelands
Kel'Thuzad.description: Increase Death and Decay's duration by 1 second. After gaining 30 Blight, increase the radius of Death and Decay's pool by 30%.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Blighted Frost
Kel'Thuzad.description: Frost Nova deals 75% more damage to enemies in the center. After gaining 30 Blight, increase Frost Nova's Root duration by 0.5 seconds.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Barbed Chains
Kel'Thuzad.description: Increase Chains of Kel'Thuzad damage by 125%. After gaining 30 Blight, Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces the Armor of pulled Heroes by 10 for 4 seconds.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Strip Shields
Kel'Thuzad.description: Pulling a Hero with Chains of Kel'Thuzad grants Kel'Thuzad a permanent 128 (+4% per level) Shield, stacking up to 2 times.  Additionally, Chains of Kel'Thuzad deals up to 270 (+2.5% per level) bonus damage to Heroes' Shields.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad
Kel'Thuzad.description: Quest: Collect 12 Regeneration Globes to charge Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery.  Reward: Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery can be activated while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms, but must be charged again.  Passive: Kel'Thuzad heals for 10% of all Spell Damage dealt while the Phylactery is charged.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Armor of the Archlich
Kel'Thuzad.description: Activate to gain 50 Physical Armor for 4 seconds. Upon activation, nearby enemies take 45 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 35% for 4 seconds.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Accelerated Decay
Kel'Thuzad.description: Each time a Hero is hit by Death and Decay's pool, they take 25% more periodic damage from Death and Decay for the next 4 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Chilling Touch
Kel'Thuzad.description: Every 8 seconds, Kel'Thuzad's next Basic Attack hits all enemies in the area for 80%  additional damage, deals Spell damage instead of Physical, and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Ice Cold
Kel'Thuzad.description: Reduce the cooldown of Glacial Spike by 10 seconds and increase its damage by 400%.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Frost Blast
Kel'Thuzad.description: Launch a meteor of ice at an enemy Hero. Upon impact, the meteor deals 115 (+2.5% per level) damage to its target and 275 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemies in the area. All enemies hit by Frost Blast are Rooted for 2 seconds.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Shadow Fissure
Kel'Thuzad.description: Create a fissure anywhere on the Battleground that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 320 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in its area. If an enemy Hero is hit, set its cooldown to 1.5 seconds.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Icy Grasp
Kel'Thuzad.description: Increase Frost Nova's Slow by 20%. Each time Kel'Thuzad damages enemies Slowed by Frost Nova, reduce the cooldown of Frost Nova by 0.75 seconds.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Chains of Ice
Kel'Thuzad.description: After Chains of Kel'Thuzad's Stun expires, the enemy is also Slowed by 60% for 1 second.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Chain-Link
Kel'Thuzad.description: Pulling a Hero with Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces its cooldown by 5 seconds and refunds its Mana cost.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Arcane Echoes
Kel'Thuzad.description: Whenever Kel'Thuzad hits an enemy Hero with Death and Decay's explosion, its cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Hungering Cold
Kel'Thuzad.description: Enemies that are Rooted take an additional 55 (+2.5% per level) damage each time they are damaged by Kel'Thuzad.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Power of Icecrown
Kel'Thuzad.description: Stunning, Rooting, or Slowing a Hero grants 6% Spell Power for 10 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Deathchill
Kel'Thuzad.description: When Frost Blast's Root expires, enemies are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds. Heroes killed while under the effects of Frost Blast instantly release another Frost Blast explosion.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Might of the Scourge
Kel'Thuzad.description: If a Hero is hit with Shadow Fissure, a second one is cast below them 1 second later.  This second cast will not duplicate itself.

Kel'Thuzad.title: Shifting Malice
Kel'Thuzad.description: Activate to dash forward, dealing 150 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemies in the path. Takedowns reset the cooldown of Shifting Malice.

Kel'Thuzad.title: The Damned Return
Kel'Thuzad.description: Activate to create a Shade of Naxxramas that lasts 15 seconds and mimics Kel'Thuzad's casts of Death and Decay.

Kerrigan.title: Siphoning Impact
Kerrigan.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Ravage grants 100 (+4% per level) points of Assimilation Shields.

Kerrigan.title: Assimilation Mastery
Kerrigan.description: Regeneration Globe healing grants 50 (+4% per level) points of Assimilation Shields per second while active. While Assimilation is active, Kerrigan's Health and Mana regeneration is increased by 150%.

Kerrigan.title: Fury of the Swarm
Kerrigan.description: Gain 10% more Assimilation Shields from Basic Attacks. After casting Ravage, Kerrigan's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds splashes for 100% damage around the target.

Kerrigan.title: Sharpened Blades
Kerrigan.description: Quest: Minions and Heroes that die within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Ravage increase its damage up to a maximum of 75.  Minions grant 1 increased damage and Heroes grant 5 increased damage.  Reward: After reaching a 75 damage increase, Ravage gains 50 additional damage.

Kerrigan.title: Kinetic Fulmination
Kerrigan.description: Damaging an enemy increases the damage of Kerrigan's next Impaling Blades within 10 seconds by 10%, up to 100%.

Kerrigan.title: Psionic Pulse
Kerrigan.description: Primal Grasp explodes a second time 2 seconds after its first explosion.

Kerrigan.title: Queen of Blades
Kerrigan.description: Reduce the cooldown of Ravage by 3 seconds and increase its damage to Minions and Mercenaries by 100%.

Kerrigan.title: Boundless Fury
Kerrigan.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Ravage grants a charge of Ravage. Can only occur once every 10 seconds per Hero.

Kerrigan.title: Bladed Momentum
Kerrigan.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Kerrigan's Basic Abilities by 0.6 seconds.

Kerrigan.title: Maelstrom
Kerrigan.description: Deals 74 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Lasts for 7 seconds.

Kerrigan.title: Summon Ultralisk
Kerrigan.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon an Ultralisk that rushes forward upon spawning, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  The Ultralisk's Basic Attacks deal 50% of their damage in an area around their target. Reactivate to retarget the Ultralisk.

Kerrigan.title: Psionic Barrier
Kerrigan.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Primal Grasp grants 20 Spell Armor and 4% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 20% Movement Speed.

Kerrigan.title: Volatile Power
Kerrigan.description: Increase the amount of Assimilation Shields granted from damage dealt by 10%, but reduce duration of Assimilation by 3 seconds.

Kerrigan.title: Chrysalis
Kerrigan.description: Activate to place Kerrigan in a Chrysalis with 750 (+4% per level) Health for 5 seconds. While inside, Kerrigan regenerates 5% of her maximum Health per second.  Enemies can destroy the Chrysalis to end its effects early.

Kerrigan.title: Mounting Potency
Kerrigan.description: Ravage grants 5% Spell Power for 5 seconds, up to 40%.

Kerrigan.title: Painful Spikes
Kerrigan.description: Enemies hit by Impaling Blades take an additional 70 (+4% per level) damage the next 6 times Kerrigan damages them within 5 seconds.

Kerrigan.title: Unbridled Energy
Kerrigan.description: Damaging a Hero with a Heroic Ability grants 35% Spell Power for 4 seconds.

Kerrigan.title: Omegastorm
Kerrigan.description: Maelstrom's duration is increased by 0.25 seconds every time it damages a Hero.

Kerrigan.title: Torrasque
Kerrigan.description: Increase the Health and Basic Attack damage of the Ultralisk by 20%.  The Ultralisk morphs into an egg when it dies. If the egg isn't killed within 4 seconds, a new Ultralisk is born.

Kerrigan.title: Assimilation Blades
Kerrigan.description: Damaging an enemy increases Basic Attack damage by 2% for 5 seconds, up to 40%.

Kerrigan.title: Psionic Shift
Kerrigan.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Generates 300% increased Assimilation Shields from the damage dealt.

Kharazim.title: Transcendence
Kharazim.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack heals the lowest nearby allied Hero for 104 (+4% per level) and gives 25% increased Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

Kharazim.title: Iron Fists
Kharazim.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack deals 110% bonus damage and gives 25% increased Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

Kharazim.title: Insight
Kharazim.description: Quest: Every 3rd Basic Attack restores 14 (+4% per level) Mana, grants a stack of Insight, and gives 25% increased Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.  Reward: Upon getting 100 stacks of Insight, every 3rd attack also reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 1.75 seconds.

Kharazim.title: Spirit Ally
Kharazim.description: Place a Spirit Ally that heals allied Heroes in a large area around it for 2% of their maximum Health every second. Has 150 (+4% per level) Health and lasts 10 seconds. Kharazim can Radiant Dash to Spirit Allies.

Kharazim.title: Earth Ally
