Kharazim.description: Place an Earth Ally that grants nearby allied Heroes 50 Physical Armor against Heroic Basic Attacks, reducing damage taken by 50%. Has 400 (+4% per level) Health and lasts 10 seconds.  Kharazim can Radiant Dash to Earth Allies.

Kharazim.title: Air Ally
Kharazim.description: Place an Air Ally that gives allied Heroes 15% Spell Power, grants vision, and reveals a large area around it. Has 200 (+4% per level) Health and lasts 10 seconds. Kharazim can Radiant Dash to Air Allies.

Kharazim.title: Blinding Speed
Kharazim.description: Decreases Radiant Dash's cooldown by 2 seconds and increases the maximum number of charges by 1.

Kharazim.title: Heavenly Zeal
Kharazim.description: Increases Breath of Heaven's Movement Speed bonus to 30%.  Radiant Dashing to an ally increases the healing they receive from Breath of Heaven by 50% for 3.5 seconds.

Kharazim.title: Blazing Fists
Kharazim.description: Increase the duration of Deadly Reach by 100%.  Every 3rd Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Deadly Reach by 0.75 seconds.

Kharazim.title: Divine Palm
Kharazim.description: Protect an allied Hero from death, causing them to be healed for 1200 (+4% per level) if they take fatal damage in the next 3 seconds.

Kharazim.title: Seven-Sided Strike
Kharazim.description: Become Invulnerable and strike 7 times over 2 seconds. Each strike hits the highest Health nearby Hero for 7% of their maximum Health.

Kharazim.title: Quicksilver
Kharazim.description: Radiant Dashing to an ally gives Kharazim and the target 30% bonus Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

Kharazim.title: Spell Shield
Kharazim.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

Kharazim.title: Sixth Sense
Kharazim.description: While Stunned or Rooted, gain 75 Physical Armor against Hero Basic Attacks for 4 seconds, reducing their damage by 75%.

Kharazim.title: Cleansing Touch
Kharazim.description: Radiant Dashing to an ally makes them Unstoppable for 1 second.

Kharazim.title: Way of the Hundred Fists
Kharazim.description: Radiant Dashing to an enemy launches a rapid volley of 6 Basic Attacks dealing 45% damage each.

Kharazim.title: Echo of Heaven
Kharazim.description: Breath of Heaven heals 75% of its normal amount, but heals a second time 3 seconds later.

Kharazim.title: Peaceful Repose
Kharazim.description: Divine Palm's healing amount is increased by 75% and its cooldown is set to 5 seconds if the Hero does not die.

Kharazim.title: Transgression
Kharazim.description: Seven-Sided Strike hits 4 additional times.

Kharazim.title: Fists of Legend
Kharazim.description: Gain 50% of the benefit from both level 1  talents that were not chosen.

Kharazim.title: Storm Shield
Kharazim.description: Activate to give all nearby allied Heroes a Shield for 20% of their max Health for 3 seconds.

Kharazim.title: Epiphany
Kharazim.description: Activate to restore 33% of Kharazim's maximum Mana and refill 2 charges of Radiant Dash.

Leoric.title: Consume Vitality
Leoric.description: Skeletal Swing's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit heal Leoric for 4% of his maximum Health.

Leoric.title: Fealty Unto Death
Leoric.description: When a nearby friendly or enemy Minion dies, Leoric restores 1.25% of his maximum Health and 6 Mana.

Leoric.title: Ossein Renewal
Leoric.description: Activate to heal Leoric for 30% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. Regeneration Globes lower the cooldown of this Ability by 20 seconds.

Leoric.title: Ghastly Reach
Leoric.description: Increase the range of Skeletal Swing by 25%.

Leoric.title: Paralyzing Rage
Leoric.description: Increase the Slow of Skeletal Swing by 20%.

Leoric.title: Kneel, Peasants!
Leoric.description: Skeletal Swing deals 75% additional damage to Mercenaries and Monsters, and hitting them activates Skeletal Swing's cost and cooldown refund.

Leoric.title: Willing Vessel
Leoric.description: Increase the healing from Drain Hope to 25% of Leoric's maximum Health. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, Leoric instantly heals for an additional 5% of his maximum Health.

Leoric.title: Drain Momentum
Leoric.description: Drain Hope no longer reduces Leoric's Movement Speed. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, gain 30% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

Leoric.title: Hopelessness
Leoric.description: Increase the range of Drain Hope by 25%.

Leoric.title: Entomb
Leoric.description: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.

Leoric.title: March of the Black King
Leoric.description: Leoric becomes Unstoppable and walks forward, swinging his mace 3 times. Enemies hit take 250 (+4% per level) damage, and Heroes hit heal Leoric for 12% of his maximum Health.

Leoric.title: Unyielding Despair
Leoric.description: Drain Hope's cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds for every 1 second it is active. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, its cooldown is reduced by an additional 2 seconds.

Leoric.title: Ominous Wraith
Leoric.description: Increase Wraith Walk's duration by 100%. Enemy Heroes that come in contact with the wraith deal 50% less damage for 4 seconds.

Leoric.title: Spectral Leech
Leoric.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health and heal Leoric for twice that amount.

Leoric.title: Crushing Hope
Leoric.description: If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, it instantly deals an additional 15% of the target's maximum Health as damage. This damage does not heal Leoric.

Leoric.title: Royal Focus
Leoric.description: Wraith Walk increases the damage of the next Skeletal Swing within 5 seconds by 50%. Each enemy Hero hit by this Skeletal Swing reduces the cooldown of Wraith Walk by 7 seconds.

Leoric.title: Mithril Mace
Leoric.description: Increase Leoric's Attack Speed by 20%.  Repeatable Quest: Nearby enemy Minion deaths grant 0.3% permanent Attack Speed, and Takedowns grant 3% permanent Attack Speed, up to 30%.

Leoric.title: Buried Alive
Leoric.description: The duration of Entomb is lowered by 1 second, but enemies trapped inside are Silenced and take 50 (+4% per level) damage every 1 second.

Leoric.title: Death March
Leoric.description: The final swing of March of the Black King also applies Drain Hope to nearby enemy Heroes.

Leoric.title: Burning Despair
Leoric.description: Deal 40 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.  While Drain Hope is active, gain 40 Armor and the damage and area is increased by 100%.

Leoric.title: Shroud of the Dead King
Leoric.description: Activate to become Protected for 3 seconds, preventing all damage.

Li Li.title: Free Drinks
Li Li.description: Healing Brew's cooldown is reduced by 1 second and its Mana cost is refunded if it heals a Hero under 50% Health.

Li Li.title: Serpent Sidekick
Li Li.description: Cloud Serpent no longer costs Mana and while Fast Feet is active its cooldown refreshes an additional 75% faster.

Li Li.title: Eager Adventurer
Li Li.description: Increase Fast Feet's duration by 150% and increase Mana regeneration by 150% while Fast Feet is active.

Li Li.title: Wind Serpent
Li Li.description: Cloud Serpent grants its bearer 10% increased Movement Speed. Casting Blinding Wind increases this bonus to 20% for 3 seconds.  Passive: Cloud Serpent attacks 25% faster.

Li Li.title: Surging Winds
Li Li.description: If Blinding Wind hits 2 Heroes, its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds and Li Li gains 10% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

Li Li.title: Safety Sprint
Li Li.description: Activate to gain Fast Feet, 30 Armor, and 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.  Passive: While Fast Feet is active, Li Li gains 10 Armor.

Li Li.title: The Good Stuff
Li Li.description: Healing Brew heals for an additional 42 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds. While Fast Feet is active, this heal amount is increased by 100%.

Li Li.title: Mass Vortex
Li Li.description: Increase the number of enemies hit by Blinding Wind from 2 to 3. Blinding Wind deals 75% additional damage if all 3 enemies hit are Heroes.

Li Li.title: Let's Go!
Li Li.description: Activate to heal an allied Hero for 160 (+4% per level) and make them Unstoppable for 1 second. Let's Go's cooldown is affected by Fast Feet.  Cannot be used on Li Li.

Li Li.title: Jug of 1,000 Cups
Li Li.description: Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, increase the cooldown of Jug of 1,000 Cups by 2 seconds, up to 50 additional seconds, and heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 66 (+4% per level) Health.

Li Li.title: Water Dragon
Li Li.description: Li Li channels for 2 seconds, summoning a Water Dragon that hits the nearest enemy Hero within 12 range and all enemies near them, dealing 300 (+4% per level) damage and slowing their Movement Speed by 70% for 4 seconds.

Li Li.title: Lightning Serpent
Li Li.description: Cloud Serpent attacks bounce to hit 2 additional targets for 13 (+4% per level) damage and 10 (+4% per level) healing.

Li Li.title: Gale Force
Li Li.description: Increase Blinding Wind's Blind duration by 0.75 seconds. Li Li's Basic Attacks against Blinded Heroes deal 100% increased damage.

Li Li.title: Hindering Winds
Li Li.description: Increase Blinding Wind's Slow amount to 30% and its duration to 2 seconds.

Li Li.title: Two For One
Li Li.description: Increases the number of allies healed by Healing Brew to 2, but increases the cooldown by 1 second.

Li Li.title: Pick Me Up
Li Li.description: Healing Brew's healing for Heroes is increased by 33% if they are under 50% Health.

Li Li.title: Blessings Of Yu'lon
Li Li.description: Cloud Serpent grants its bearer 10% increased healing received and heals them for an additional 0.5% of their maximum Health each time it attacks.

Li Li.title: Jug of 1,000,000 Cups
Li Li.description: Jug of 1,000 Cups heals two allies at a time.

Li Li.title: Double Dragon
Li Li.description: After hitting a target with Water Dragon, another Water Dragon is summoned at the point of impact.

Li Li.title: Mistweaver
Li Li.description: Activate to heal nearby allied Heroes for 149 (+4% per level). Basic Attacks and Cloud Serpent attacks reduce the cooldown of Mistweaver by 1 second.

Li Li.title: Shake It Off
Li Li.description: Gain 35 Armor while Stunned, Silenced, or Rooted.  Passive: Increase Fast Feet's cooldown refresh rate to 75%

Li-Ming.title: Force Armor
Li-Ming.description: When Magic Missiles damages an enemy Hero, gain 50 Spell Armor, reducing the damage taken by the next Ability by 50%. Gain 1 charge per cast and store up to 4 charges.  Passive: Li-Ming's Mana regeneration is increased by 100% while below 35% Mana.

Li-Ming.title: Aether Walker
Li-Ming.description: Teleport costs no Mana.  If Li-Ming hasn't taken damage in the last 3 seconds, Teleport's cooldown is decreased by 2 seconds.  Casting Teleport causes Li-Ming's next cast of Magic Missiles to deal 10% bonus damage.

Li-Ming.title: Power Hungry
Li-Ming.description: Regeneration Globes restore 100% more Mana and grant 10% Spell Power for 20 seconds.

Li-Ming.title: Charged Blast
Li-Ming.description: Basic Attacking a target recently hit by a Magic Missile does an extra 87 (+4% per level) damage.

Li-Ming.title: Triumvirate
Li-Ming.description: If Arcane Orb hits an enemy Hero after traveling at least 50% of its base range, the cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and 40 Mana is refunded.

Li-Ming.title: Dominance
Li-Ming.description: Takedowns restore 30% of Li-Ming's missing Health.

Li-Ming.title: Seeker
Li-Ming.description: If three Magic Missiles hit the same target, the third one deals an additional 140 (+4% per level) damage.

Li-Ming.title: Zei's Vengeance
Li-Ming.description: Increase Arcane Orb's damage increase for distance traveled by 30%. Additionally, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

Li-Ming.title: Calamity
Li-Ming.description: Teleport does 300 (+3% per level) damage to enemy Heroes near the destination.

Li-Ming.title: Disintegrate
Li-Ming.description: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480 (+5% per level) damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

Li-Ming.title: Wave Of Force
Li-Ming.description: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 (+5% per level) damage.

Li-Ming.title: Illusionist
Li-Ming.description: If Li-Ming loses more than 20% of her Health at once, its cooldown is instantly refreshed.  This effect has a 4 second cooldown.  Passive: Increases Teleport range by 50%

Li-Ming.title: Cannoneer
Li-Ming.description: When Li-Ming uses an Ability, her next Basic Attack's damage is increased by 75% and deals Spell damage instead of Physical.  Stacks up to 3 times.

Li-Ming.title: Glass Cannon
Li-Ming.description: Increase Li-Ming's Spell Power by 20%, but decrease her maximum Health by 15%.

Li-Ming.title: Fireflies
Li-Ming.description: Drastically increases Magic Missiles speed. Its cooldown is reduced by 1 second, and its Mana cost is reduced by 5.

Li-Ming.title: Mirrorball
Li-Ming.description: Magic Missiles fires an additional 2 missiles, but its Mana cost is increased by 5.

Li-Ming.title: Arcane Orbit
Li-Ming.description: Arcane Orb travels 25% farther, increasing its maximum distance damage bonus from 270 (+3% per level) to 371 (+3% per level).

Li-Ming.title: Diamond Skin
Li-Ming.description: Teleport grants a Shield equal to 25% of Li-Ming's maximum Health for 4 seconds.

Li-Ming.title: Temporal Flux
Li-Ming.description: Disintegrate gradually slows enemies caught in its beam, to a maximum of 60%.

Li-Ming.title: Repulsion
Li-Ming.description: Increases Wave of Force knockback distance by 150% and increases its cast range by 100%.

Li-Ming.title: Tal Rasha's Elements
Li-Ming.description: Casting Abilities increases the damage of the next Ability by 5%, up to 20%.  This bonus is reset when the same Ability is used within a chain.

Li-Ming.title: Archon: Pure Power
Li-Ming.description: Activate to enter Archon form, allowing Li-Ming to repeatedly use Disintegrate, but be unable to cast other Abilities.

Lt. Morales.title: Caduceus Feedback
Lt. Morales.description: Increases Attack Range by 1.1 and Basic Attacks against Heroes generate 4 Energy.

Lt. Morales.title: Life Support
Lt. Morales.description: During the first 2 seconds of Energy regeneration, Healing Beam regenerates 100% more Energy.  Passive: Increase your maximum Energy by 10.

Lt. Morales.title: Clear!
Lt. Morales.description: Quest: Each enemy Hero hit with Displacement Grenade restores 3 Energy.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Displacement Grenade from 12 seconds to 9 seconds.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, increase the detonation area of Displacement Grenade by 25%.

Lt. Morales.title: Cellular Reactor
Lt. Morales.description: Consume 30 Energy to heal Lt. Morales for 30% of her maximum Health over 3 seconds. Caduceus Reactor is disabled while this is active.  Passive: Generate 2 Energy each time Safeguard reduces damage, up to a maximum of 10 Energy per use.

Lt. Morales.title: Trauma Trigger
Lt. Morales.description: Taking damage while below 40% Health grants 40 Armor for 3 seconds. This effect has a 30 second cooldown.  Passive: Increase the healing provided by Caduceus Reactor from 2% to 4% of Lt. Morales's maximum Health per second.

Lt. Morales.title: Blast Shield
Lt. Morales.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade are Slowed by 50% for 1 second after being knocked away and grant Lt. Morales a Shield equal to 6% of her maximum Health. This shield stacks up to 5 times.

Lt. Morales.title: Physical Therapy
Lt. Morales.description: Safeguard removes all Slows from its target and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

Lt. Morales.title: Vanadium Plating
Lt. Morales.description: While an ally affected by Safeguard is Stunned or Rooted, Safeguard grants an additional 20 Armor.  Passive: Increase the duration of Safeguard by 1 second.

Lt. Morales.title: Medi-Drone
Lt. Morales.description: Allies with Safeguard receive 75% of the healing done by Healing Beam on another ally.

Lt. Morales.title: Stim Drone
Lt. Morales.description: Grant an allied Hero 75% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 10 seconds.

Lt. Morales.title: Medivac Dropships
Lt. Morales.description: Unlock the Medivac Dropship and Reinforcements abilities. These abilities share a cooldown.  Medivac Dropship Target a location for a Medivac transport. For up to 10 seconds before takeoff, allies can right-click to enter the Medivac.  Reinforcements Call down a Medivac Dropship at your Hall of Storms for your allies. After 10 seconds, or when the Ability is activated again, the Medivac will travel to the original cast location to unload its passengers.

Lt. Morales.title: EMP Grenade
Lt. Morales.description: Displacement Grenade deals an additional 96 (+4% per level) damage over 2 seconds, and up to 400 (+4% per level) bonus damage to Shields.

Lt. Morales.title: System Shock
Lt. Morales.description: Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade deal 30% less damage for 3 seconds.

Lt. Morales.title: Bedside Manner
Lt. Morales.description: Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade will take an additional 6% of maximum Health as damage from Lt. Morales's next Basic Attack against them.  Passive: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal an additional 1% of maximum Health as damage.

Lt. Morales.title: Extended Care
Lt. Morales.description: Channeling Healing Beam on a Hero for at least 3 seconds causes them to be healed for 258 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds when Healing Beam ends.  Passive: Increase the range of Healing Beam by 30%.

Lt. Morales.title: First Responder
Lt. Morales.description: While above 60 Energy, Healing Beam's healing is increased by 20% and both Lt. Morales and her Healing Beam target gain 15% Movement Speed.

Lt. Morales.title: Shield Sequencer
Lt. Morales.description: Safeguard gains a second charge and its range is increased by 60%.

Lt. Morales.title: Hyperactivity
Lt. Morales.description: Reduce the cooldown of Stim Drone from 70 seconds to 35 seconds, and increase the Movement Speed bonus from 25% to 50%.

Lt. Morales.title: Safe Zone
Lt. Morales.description: After exiting the Medivac, allies are Protected from all damage for 3 seconds.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Medivac Dropship abilities by 15 seconds.

Lt. Morales.title: Hospice Care
Lt. Morales.description: Safeguard grants its target Unkillable for 1 second. If the target is under 50% maximum Health when the Unkillable effect ends, they are healed for 8% of their maximum Health.

Lt. Morales.title: Second Opinion
Lt. Morales.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes with Displacement Grenade reduces its cooldown to 2 seconds.

Lúcio.title: Party Mix
Lúcio.description: Quest: Play Lúcio's Crossfade tracks to nearby allies. Multiple allies provide additional time.  Reward: For every 1 Minute played, permanently increase Lucio's maximum Mana by 10.  Reward: Once you have played for 8 minutes or more, permanently increase Crossfade's range by 20%.

Lúcio.title: Accelerando
Lúcio.description: Wall Ride's Movement Speed bonus gradually increases to 40% over 4 seconds while Lúcio maintains its effect.

Lúcio.title: Smooth Moves
Lúcio.description: While Wall Ride is active, Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt and restore 0.5 Mana.  Passive: Increase Wall Ride duration by 1 second.

Lúcio.title: Subwoofer
Lúcio.description: Enemies within the first half of Soundwave's range are knocked back 75% further.  Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Soundwave.  Reward: Increase Soundwave's arc by 50% and its range by 20%.

Lúcio.title: Off the Wall
Lúcio.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave while Wall Ride is active reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

Lúcio.title: Supersonic
Lúcio.description: While Wall Ride is active, Push Off's cooldown recharges 100% faster.

Lúcio.title: Good Vibrations
Lúcio.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave grants Lúcio a 38 (+4% per level) Shield for 7 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes grants 3 times this amount.

Lúcio.title: Reverse Amp
Lúcio.description: Blast Lúcio's active Crossfade track at enemy Heroes. While Amp It Up is active, Healing Boost deals 50 (+4% per level) damage per second and Speed Boost Slows by 20%.  This ability is unaffected by Crossfade talents.

Lúcio.title: Boombox
Lúcio.description: Place a boombox that plays Lúcio's active Crossfade track. Its volume adjusts with Amp It Up. Allied Heroes near the boombox gain 5 Armor.  Crossfade tracks do not stack.

Lúcio.title: Sound Barrier
Lúcio.description: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1296 (+4% per level) point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

Lúcio.title: High Five
Lúcio.description: Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival the ally is healed for 230 (+4% per level), Lúcio is healed for 80 (+4% per level), and both gain Unstoppable for 1 second.

Lúcio.title: All Together
Lúcio.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 5% Movement Speed that stacks with other bonuses.

Lúcio.title: Heavy Casters
Lúcio.description: Push Off no longer Slows enemies, and instead Stuns them for 0.5 seconds.

Lúcio.title: Slip
Lúcio.description: While Wall Ride is active, passing near an enemy Hero increases its Movement Speed bonus to 40%, and grants 15 Armor, for 1 second.

Lúcio.title: Rejuvenescência
Lúcio.description: While Amp It Up is active, Crossfade's Healing Boost heals for an additional 2.5% of the target's maximum Health each second.

Lúcio.title: Up the Frequency
Lúcio.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Amp It Up by 0.4 seconds.  Passive: Wall Ride increases Basic Attack range by 2.2.

Lúcio.title: Up To Eleven
Lúcio.description: Increase the duration of Amp It Up by 1 second. While Amp It Up is active, enemy Heroes hit by Soundwave or Push-Off further increase its duration by 0.3 seconds.

Lúcio.title: Bossa Nova
Lúcio.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sound Barrier to 30 seconds, but the Shield now decays over 4 seconds.

Lúcio.title: Mixing Fire
Lúcio.description: High Five can now be cast on enemy Heroes, dealing 160 (+4% per level) damage and reducing all healing received by 50% for 3 seconds.  Passive: Reduce the cost and cooldown of High Five by 30%.

Lúcio.title: House Party
Lúcio.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 8% increased healing.

Lúcio.title: Summer Anthem
Lúcio.description: Activate for allies affected by Crossfade to become Unkillable for 1.5 seconds.

Lunara.title: Sentinel Wisp
Lunara.description: After remaining in a bush for 5 seconds, Wisp's vision radius is increased by 200% and reveals the surrounding area.

Lunara.title: Natural Perspective
Lunara.description: Nature's Toxin reveals enemies for its duration.

Lunara.title: Hippity Hop
Lunara.description: After not Basic Attacking or taking damage for 2 seconds, increase the Move Speed bonus of Dryad's Swiftness by 10%.

Lunara.title: Blossom Swell
Lunara.description: Increases Noxious Blossom's range by 25% and its radius by 20%.  Blossom Swell applies 2 stacks of Nature's Toxin to enemies hit.

Lunara.title: Nature's Culling
Lunara.description: Increases Nature's Toxin's damage by 125% to non-Heroes.

Lunara.title: Siphoning Toxin
Lunara.description: While at least one enemy is afflicted by Nature's Toxin, heal for 9 (+4% per level) per second.  When an enemy Hero has 3 stacks of Nature's Toxin, increase this healing by 19 (+4% per level) per second.

Lunara.title: Splintered Spear
Lunara.description: Using Noxious Blossom causes Lunara's next Basic Attack to hit up to 4 enemies. These extra attacks can apply Nature's Toxin.

Lunara.title: Choking Pollen
Lunara.description: Noxious Blossom deals 100% more damage to enemies afflicted by Nature's Toxin, increased to 175% against enemies with 3 stacks.

Lunara.title: Wild Vigor
Lunara.description: Using Crippling Spores increases the damage of Lunara's next 4 Basic Attacks by 70%.

Lunara.title: Thornwood Vine
Lunara.description: Send forth vines that deal 184 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in a line.  Stores up to 3 charges.

Lunara.title: Leaping Strike
Lunara.description: Leap over an enemy, Slowing them by 80% for 0.35 seconds and dealing 271 (+4% per level) damage.  Stores up to 2 charges.

Lunara.title: Endless Spores
Lunara.description: Casting Crippling Spores while at least 2 Heroes are afflicted by Nature's Toxin reduces the cooldown by 4 seconds.

Lunara.title: Let Them Wither
Lunara.description: Increases Crippling Spores' Slow duration by 1 second and causes it to no longer decay.

Lunara.title: Greater Spell Shield
Lunara.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 75 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

Lunara.title: Abolish Magic
Lunara.description: Target an ally to remove all damage over time and disabling effects from them and Lunara. For 2 seconds after, the duration of disabling effects is reduced by 50%.

Lunara.title: Accelerated Contamination
Lunara.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Noxious Blossom from 60 to 40.  While at least 1 enemy Hero is afflicted with Nature's Toxin, Noxious Blossom's cooldown recharges 75% faster.

Lunara.title: Star Wood Spear
Lunara.description: Increase Lunara's Basic Attack range by 0.5.  Using Crippling Spores increases Lunara's Basic Attack range by an additional 2.25 for 6 seconds.

Lunara.title: Invigorating Spores
Lunara.description: Crippling Spores grants 30% Attack Speed for 6 seconds.  Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Nature's Toxin deal damage equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health.

Lunara.title: Unfair Advantage
Lunara.description: Nature's Toxin deals 60% more damage to Heroes that are Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

Lunara.title: Forest's Wrath
Lunara.description: Thornwood Vine now applies 2 stacks of Nature's Toxin.  Increase Thornwood Vine's range by 30% and Lunara's vision radius by 35%.

Lunara.title: Boundless Stride
Lunara.description: All Leaping Strike charges are returned every 15 seconds. Leaping Strike can be used on allies.

Lunara.title: Intensifying Toxin
Lunara.description: At 3 stacks, Nature's Toxin deals 40% more damage.

Lunara.title: Galloping Gait
Lunara.description: Activate to increase the Movement Speed bonus of Dryad's Swiftness to 80% for 6 seconds.

Maiev.title: Bonds of Justice
Maiev.description: Quest: Each tether applied to a secondary target of Umbral Bind permanently increases Umbral Bind's pull damage by 15.  Reward: After applying 5 tethers to secondary targets, increase Umbral Bind's pull damage by 75.  Reward: After applying 10 tethers to secondary targets, increase Umbral Bind's cleave damage by 30%.

Maiev.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
Maiev.description: Each Hero tethered by Umbral Bind reduces the cooldown of Spirit of Vengeance by 2.5 seconds and each Hero hit by Spirit of Vengeance reduces the cooldown of Umbral Bind by 1 second.

Maiev.title: Naisha's Memento
Maiev.description: Activate to make primary Basic Attacks bounce between nearby enemies up to 2 times. Lasts 8 seconds.  Recharge Naisha's Memento by hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single Fan of Knives.

Maiev.title: Pin Down
Maiev.description: Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Fan of Knives.  Reward: Increase Fan of Knives damage by 35%.  Reward: Each additional time 3 enemy Heroes are hit by a single Fan of Knives, gain an additional 5% damage, up to 50%.  Reward: Hit 4 enemy Heroes with a single Fan of Knives to instantly gain all Rewards.

Maiev.title: Blade Dance
Maiev.description: Using Fan of Knives deals 50 (+4% per level) Physical Damage to enemies around Maiev.

Maiev.title: Sudden Vengeance
Maiev.description: After blinking with Spirit of Vengeance, the shadow explodes, damaging all nearby enemy Heroes for 6% of their maximum Health.

Maiev.title: Elune's Wrath
Maiev.description: Hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single Fan of Knives causes the next Fan of Knives to drop a star on targets that deals 77 (+4% per level) damage when it impacts.

Maiev.title: Bonds of Corruption
Maiev.description: Enemy Heroes pulled by Umbral Bind have their Armor reduced by 15 and are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds

Maiev.title: Ruthless Spirit
Maiev.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Spirit of Vengeance increases all damage Maiev deals by 15% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 30%.

Maiev.title: Containment Disc
Maiev.description: Throw a glaive in the target direction. If an enemy Hero is hit, Containment Disc can be reactivated to remove their vision and Time Stop them for 4 seconds. Leaving Containment Silences the enemy Hero for 1.5 seconds.  Containment Disc automatically activates 6 seconds after hitting a Hero.

Maiev.title: Warden's Cage
Maiev.description: Summon 8 Warden Avatars as a cage around Maiev. After 1.5 seconds, enemy Heroes that come in contact with an Avatar consume it and are knocked to the center of the cage. Warden Avatars last 5 seconds.

Maiev.title: Bladed Armor
Maiev.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Fan of Knives grants 5 Armor for 5 seconds, up to 20 Armor.

Maiev.title: Chain Gang
Maiev.description: Tethering at least 2 enemy Heroes with Umbral Bind grants 35 Armor for 4 seconds.

Maiev.title: Shadow Armor
Maiev.description: Blink grants 20 Armor for 3.5 seconds. Maiev's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes refresh this duration.

Maiev.title: Vengeful Knives
Maiev.description: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes causes the next cast of Fan of Knives that hits enemy Heroes to deal 1% maximum Health as bonus damage, up to 5%.

Maiev.title: Cruel Chain
Maiev.description: Umbral Bind grants 25% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds. In addition, each time Maiev deals damage to tethered targets, Umbral Bind's pull damage to all targets is increased by 30%, up to 150%.

Maiev.title: Armored Assault
Maiev.description: While Maiev has positive Armor of any kind, all Physical Damage dealt is increased by 25%.

Maiev.title: Shadow Orb: Vengeance
Maiev.description: Activate to reset the cooldown of Spirit of Vengeance.  Recharge Shadow Orb by damaging enemy Heroes with Spirit of Vengeance 5 times.

Maiev.title: Shadow Orb: Huntress
Maiev.description: Activate to increase Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 40% for 5 seconds.  Recharge Shadow Orb by dealing Physical Damage to enemy Heroes 10 times.

Maiev.title: Shadow Orb: Shadow Strike
Maiev.description: Activate to deal 75 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy Hero, Slowing them by 30% and reducing their Armor by 20 for 4 seconds.  Recharge Shadow Orb by dealing Spell Damage to enemy Heroes 10 times.

Mal'Ganis.title: Winged Guard
Mal'Ganis.description: Each time Necrotic Embrace hits an enemy Hero, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack.  If Winged Guard has no charges, Mal'Ganis will gain 1 charge after 6 seconds.

Mal'Ganis.title: Vampiric Aura
Mal'Ganis.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 30% of Physical Damage dealt, and nearby allied Heroes heal for 15% of Physical Damage dealt.

Mal'Ganis.title: Time to Feed
Mal'Ganis.description: Mal'Ganis heals for 70 (+4% per level) when damaging a nearby enemy Hero. This can occur once every 6 seconds against each enemy Hero, but is also refreshed when they are Slept by Night Rush.

Mal'Ganis.title: Fueled by Torment
Mal'Ganis.description: While Necrotic Embrace is active, Mal'Ganis heals for 12 (+4% per level) when damage is taken and Vampiric Touch converts 20% more Hero damage into healing.

Mal'Ganis.title: Might of Sargeras
Mal'Ganis.description: Necrotic Embrace's Armor is increased to 50.

Mal'Ganis.title: Echo of Doom
Mal'Ganis.description: When Necrotic Embrace expires, it explodes again for 68 (+4% per level) damage.  For each enemy Hero hit, gain 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Necrotic Embrace by 0.75 seconds.  Does not wake Sleeping targets.

Mal'Ganis.title: Black Claws
Mal'Ganis.description: After Mal'Ganis hits an enemy Hero with Fel Claws, his next Basic Attack deals 60% more damage and reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes by 15 for 2 seconds.

Mal'Ganis.title: Will of Tichondrius
Mal'Ganis.description: Each enemy Hero hit by the first 2 slashes of Fel Claws causes the final slash to steal 1% of maximum Health from enemy Heroes, up to 4%.  If at least 4 enemy Heroes are hit with the first 2 slashes of Fel Claws, then the final slash Stuns enemies for an additional 0.5 seconds.

Mal'Ganis.title: Spreading Plague
Mal'Ganis.description: After casting Night Rush, deal 33 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.  This effect lasts for 5 seconds and Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh its duration.  Does not wake Sleeping targets.

Mal'Ganis.title: Carrion Swarm
Mal'Ganis.description: After 1 second, disperse into an Invulnerable swarm of bats for 3 seconds, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies.  Vampiric Touch heals for 75% of Carrion Swarm's damage to Heroes.

Mal'Ganis.title: Dark Conversion
Mal'Ganis.description: Channel on an enemy Hero for 0.75 seconds, then swap Health percentages with the target over 3 seconds.

Mal'Ganis.title: Deep Sleep
Mal'Ganis.description: Increase Night Rush's Sleep duration by 0.75 seconds and its Movement Speed bonus by 10%.

Mal'Ganis.title: The Night Beckons
Mal'Ganis.description: Basic Attacks deal 200% bonus damage to Sleeping enemies.  After Night Rush's Sleep ends, targets are Slowed by 30% for 3 seconds.

Mal'Ganis.title: Blood Rush
Mal'Ganis.description: When Mal'Ganis is healed by a Hero, he gains 1% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 15%.

Mal'Ganis.title: Plague Bats
Mal'Ganis.description: Necrotic Embrace unleashes a wave of bats in front of Mal'Ganis, dealing 81 (+4% per level) damage.

Mal'Ganis.title: Frenzied Assault
Mal'Ganis.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes with a higher Health percentage heal for an additional 50% of damage dealt.  Basic Attacks against Heroes with a lower Health percentage grant 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

Mal'Ganis.title: Blind as a Bat
Mal'Ganis.description: Activate to erupt with blind rage, removing the cooldown and Mana cost of Fel Claws, but losing all vision. Lasts 6 seconds.   Enemy Heroes hit by the final slash of Fel Claws reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 4 seconds.

Mal'Ganis.title: Seeker Swarm
Mal'Ganis.description: Upon expiring, Carrion Swarm's bats seek nearby enemy Heroes, dealing 132 (+4% per level) damage and Sleeping them for 2.5 seconds.

Mal'Ganis.title: Wrath of Nathreza
Mal'Ganis.description: Enemy Heroes near the target suffer 75% of the transferred Health as damage over 3 seconds.  Does not benefit from Vampiric Touch.

Mal'Ganis.title: Vanquish the Weak
Mal'Ganis.description: Damage from Fel Claws and Basic Attacks Slows enemies by 25% for 1.5 seconds, and Vampiric Touch converts 10% more damage into healing versus Slowed Heroes.

Mal'Ganis.title: Alone in the Dark
Mal'Ganis.description: Reduce the cooldown of Night Rush by 4 seconds.  Enemy Heroes put to Sleep by Night Rush have their vision greatly reduced during the Sleep and for 2 seconds after.

Malfurion.title: Deep Roots
Malfurion.description: Entangling Roots grows 25% larger, and persist on the ground 40% longer.  Repeatable Quest: Every time an enemy Hero becomes Rooted, gain 14 Mana permanently.

Malfurion.title: Vengeful Roots
Malfurion.description: Entangling Roots spawns a Treant that deals 58 damage per second and lasts 10 seconds.  Repeatable Quest: Hitting enemy Heroes with Entangling Roots permanently increases the Treant's Basic Attack damage by 7.

Malfurion.title: Emerald Dreams
Malfurion.description: Entangling Roots Sleeps enemy Heroes for 2 seconds after its Root expires.

Malfurion.title: Rejuvenation
Malfurion.description: Casting Regrowth on an ally also grants Malfurion its effect for 50% normal duration.

Malfurion.title: Celestial Alignment
Malfurion.description: Increase Moonfire's reveal duration by 3 seconds. Malfurion's Basic Attacks against Heroes revealed by Moonfire deal 85% more damage.

Malfurion.title: Shan'do's Clarity
Malfurion.description: Gain a second charge of Innervate. Its cooldown recharges 25% faster per ally affected by Regrowth.

Malfurion.title: Wild Growth
Malfurion.description: Each Hero hit by Moonfire extends the duration of currently active Regrowths by 1 second.

Malfurion.title: Tenacious Roots
Malfurion.description: Increase the Root duration of Entangling Roots by 25%. When Malfurion is Stunned, the cooldown of Entangling Roots is instantly reset. This can only occur every 10 seconds.

Malfurion.title: Nature's Cure
Malfurion.description: Activate to remove all Stuns, Roots, and Slows from allies affected by Regrowth.

Malfurion.title: Tranquility
Malfurion.description: Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80 (+4% per level) Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affected by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.

Malfurion.title: Twilight Dream
Malfurion.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310 (+4% per level) damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

Malfurion.title: Nature's Swiftness
Malfurion.description: Malfurion gains 6% Movement Speed for every active Regrowth.

Malfurion.title: Hindering Moonfire
Malfurion.description: Moonfire Slows Heroes hit by 25% for 3 seconds.

Malfurion.title: Revitalize
Malfurion.description: Using Innervate also grants Malfurion 15% of his max Mana and causes his Basic Ability cooldowns to refresh 50% faster for 5 seconds.

Malfurion.title: Ysera's Gift
Malfurion.description: While Malfurion is above 75% Health, Regrowth's healing-over-time is increased by 75%.

Malfurion.title: Nature's Balance
Malfurion.description: Increase Moonfire's area by 25% and Regrowth's duration by 5 seconds.

Malfurion.title: Moonlit Harmony
Malfurion.description: Increase Moonfire's heal by 20%, and 15% per ally affected by Regrowth.

Malfurion.title: Serenity
Malfurion.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire reduces the cooldown of Tranquility by 3 seconds. Increase Tranquility's healing by 25% and 10% per ally affected by Regrowth.

Malfurion.title: Astral Communion
Malfurion.description: Activate to Channel for 1 second, and then instantly teleport and cast Twilight Dream at the targeted location.  Cooldown is shared with Twilight Dream.  Passive: Increase Twilight Dream's Silence duration to 5 seconds.

Malfurion.title: Lifebloom
Malfurion.description: Casting Regrowth instantly heals its target for 10% of their missing Health.

Malfurion.title: Lunar Shower
Malfurion.description: If Moonfire hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second and the next Moonfire within 6 seconds deals 20% more damage. This damage bonus stacks up to 60%.

Malthael.title: Death's Reach
Malthael.description: Increase Wraith Strike's range by 35%.

Malthael.title: On a Pale Horse
Malthael.description: Gain an additional 20% Movement Speed while mounted.

Malthael.title: Fear the Reaper
Malthael.description: Activate to increase Movement Speed by 25% and pass through other units for 4 seconds.

Malthael.title: Die Alone
Malthael.description: Soul Rip deals 50% more damage to Heroes if it hits only one Hero.

Malthael.title: Throwing Shade
Malthael.description: Increase Death Shroud's range by 33%, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and reduce its Mana cost from 50 to 30.  Death Shroud's initial impact deals 2% maximum Health as damage to non-Structure enemies.

Malthael.title: Black Harvest
Malthael.description: Quest: Apply Reaper's Mark to Heroes for a total of 180 seconds.  Reward: Permanently increase Reaper's Mark's duration by 2 seconds.

Malthael.title: Cold Hand
Malthael.description: Soul Rip Slows enemies by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

Malthael.title: Massacre
Malthael.description: Wraith Strike now damages and applies Reaper's Mark to enemies around its target.

Malthael.title: Touch of Death
Malthael.description: Activate to reduce healing received by Heroes afflicted by Reaper's Mark by 50% for 4 seconds.

Malthael.title: Tormented Souls
Malthael.description: Unleash a torrent of souls, continually applying Reaper's Mark to nearby enemies for 4 seconds.  When Tormented Souls is cast and when it expires, reset the cooldown of Wraith Strike.

Malthael.title: Last Rites
Malthael.description: Apply a death sentence to an enemy Hero that, after 2 seconds, deals damage equal to 50% of their missing Health.  Quest: Enemies killed between the application of Last Rites and within 1.5 seconds of it dealing damage permanently reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds, to a minimum of 20 seconds.

Malthael.title: Soul Siphon
Malthael.description: Increase Soul Rip's bonus healing from Heroes to 4.75% of the Hero's maximum Health.

Malthael.title: Ethereal Existence
Malthael.description: Gain 10 Physical Armor per enemy Hero afflicted by Reaper's Mark, up to a maximum of 30.

Malthael.title: Inevitable End
Malthael.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds, but remove all active Reaper's Marks.

Malthael.title: Shroud of Wisdom
Malthael.description: After 2 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor for 4 seconds.

Malthael.title: Soul Collector
Malthael.description: Reduce Soul Rip's cooldown by 0.5 seconds and increase its range by 25%.

Malthael.title: Mortality
Malthael.description: When damaging a Hero, Wraith Strike deals bonus damage equal to 8% of the Hero's maximum Health.

Malthael.title: Memento Mori
Malthael.description: Reaper's Mark deals 60% increased damage after afflicting an enemy for more than 4 seconds.

Malthael.title: Reaper of Souls
Malthael.description: Increase Tormented Souls' duration by 2 seconds.  While Tormented Souls is active, Hero Takedowns refresh the duration.

Malthael.title: Angel of Death
Malthael.description: Last Rites heals for 100% of the damage dealt, and its current and future cooldown reduction bonuses are doubled.

Malthael.title: Final Curtain
Malthael.description: Death Shroud leaves a trail in its wake for 4 seconds, applying Reaper's Mark to enemies in its area.

Malthael.title: No One Can Stop Death
Malthael.description: Activate while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms but increase Malthael's next respawn time by 25%.

Medivh.title: Winds of Celerity
Medivh.description: Increases Raven Form's Movement Speed bonus by 50%.

Medivh.title: Raven's Intellect
Medivh.description: Raven Form increases Medivh's Mana and Health Regeneration by 75%.

Medivh.title: Portal Mastery
Medivh.description: Medivh can manually place both Portal locations and it no longer breaks Raven Form.  Activate Medivh's Trait to cancel an unlinked Portal.

Medivh.title: Mage Armor
Medivh.description: The first time an ally uses a Portal, they gain 30 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing their damage taken by 30%.

Medivh.title: Raven Familiar
Medivh.description: A Raven Familiar joins allies each time they use a Portal. The Raven will dive at the ally's next Basic Attack against a Hero within 5 seconds, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

Medivh.title: Dust of Appearance
Medivh.description: Activate to greatly increase sight range for 5 seconds and reveal enemy Heroes in the area for 8 seconds. Does not cancel Raven Form.  Passive: Increase Medivh's sight range while in Raven Form by 25%.

Medivh.title: Mystic Assault
Medivh.description: If Arcane Rift hits an enemy Hero, Medivh's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 50% more damage and heals for 50% of the damage dealt.

Medivh.title: Arcane Explosion
Medivh.description: When Force of Will expires, it deals 80 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, plus 50% of the damage it prevented, up to 315 (+4% per level) additional damage.

Medivh.title: Force of Magic
Medivh.description: Preventing at least 268 (+4% per level) damage with a single cast of Force of Will grants 30% Spell Power for 15 seconds. Stacks up to 2 times.

Medivh.title: Poly Bomb
Medivh.description: Polymorph an enemy Hero for 2 seconds, Silencing them and making them unable to attack. On expiration, Poly Bomb spreads to other nearby enemy Heroes.

Medivh.title: Ley Line Seal
Medivh.description: After 0.5 seconds, unleash a wave of energy that places enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 3 seconds.

Medivh.title: Circle of Protection
Medivh.description: Force of Will also applies to allies near the target, but its cooldown is increased by 2 seconds.

Medivh.title: Enduring Will
Medivh.description: Preventing at least 268 (+4% per level) damage with Force of Will reduces its cooldown to 4 seconds.

Medivh.title: Reabsorption
Medivh.description: Increase the amount of healing from Force of Will to 70% of the damage it absorbed.

Medivh.title: Arcane Charge
Medivh.description: When Arcane Rift damages an enemy Hero, the next Arcane Rift deals 15% more damage.

Medivh.title: Temporal Flux
Medivh.description: Basic Attacks reduce Medivh's Heroic Ability cooldown by 3%. Each enemy Hero hit by Arcane Rift reduces Medivh's Heroic Ability cooldown by 9%.

Medivh.title: Stable Portal
Medivh.description: Decrease Portal cooldown by 25% and increase Portal duration by 50%.

Medivh.title: Glyph Of Poly Bomb
Medivh.description: Poly Bomb explodes 1 second sooner and the spread radius is increased by 25%.

Medivh.title: Medivh Cheats!
Medivh.description: Increase the duration of the Time Stop by 33% and gain the ability to redirect the wave once while it's active.

Medivh.title: Guardian of Tirisfal
Medivh.description: Minions and Catapults hit by Arcane Rift are instantly killed.

Medivh.title: Arcane Brilliance
Medivh.description: Activate to instantly restore 200 mana to all nearby allied Heroes and grant them 15% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

Medivh.title: Dust of Disappearance
Medivh.description: Stealth an allied Hero for 40 seconds, they are Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.  Stores up to 2 charges.

Mei.title: Heavy Pack
Mei.description: Increases the duration of Snow Blind's Slow by 1.5 seconds. Each time Blizzard damages an enemy Hero, reduce the cooldown of Snow Blind by 0.5 seconds and gain 3 Mana.

Mei.title: Ice Storm
Mei.description: Every 3rd hit of Blizzard against enemy Heroes deals an additional 42 (+4% per level) damage. Blizzard's final Stun damage is increased by 150% against all enemies.

Mei.title: Heat Transfer
Mei.description: Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed Heroes deal 33% more damage. Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero she heals for 16 (+4% per level) Health.

Mei.title: Slushball
Mei.description: Snow Blind deals 75% increased damage and Structures hit are disabled for 3 seconds.

Mei.title: Cold Front
Mei.description: Reduce the cooldown of Icing by 3 seconds.  If Mei enters her own Blizzard while Icing is active, the cooldown of Icing is reduced by 5 seconds and she gains 80 Mana.

Mei.title: Crystallize
Mei.description: Reduce the cooldown of Cryo-Freeze by 10 seconds. Mei gains 40 Spell Armor while Cryo-Freeze is active and for 1 second after.

Mei.title: Induce Hibernation
Mei.description: Blizzard reduces the damage dealt by enemy Heroes inside of its area by 40%.  When Blizzard ends, enemy Heroes still within its area gain this effect for an additional 4 seconds.

Mei.title: Skating Away
Mei.description: When Icing ends, Mei and all nearby allied Heroes gain 20% Movement Speed and 50 Physical Armor for 3 seconds.

Mei.title: Backup Battery
Mei.description: Activate to remove all Roots and Slows and regenerate 20% of maximum Health over 2 seconds. The cooldown of this ability is reduced by 10 seconds each time Mei picks up a Regeneration Globe.

Mei.title: Avalanche
Mei.description: After 0.5 seconds, roll a massive snowball that consumes enemy Heroes in its path. At the end of its path, the snowball crumbles, releasing the consumed Heroes, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds per Hero consumed.

Mei.title: Ice Wall
Mei.description: Vector Targeting After a 0.75 second delay, create an impassable wall that traps enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. When the wall expires, trapped Heroes are Slowed by 75%, decaying over 3 seconds.

Mei.title: Flurry
Mei.description: While in her own Blizzard, Mei gains 50% increased Attack Speed and Blizzard's cooldown refreshes 125% faster. If Mei is in her own Blizzard when it ends, gain these bonuses for 3 additional seconds.

Mei.title: Cooling Servos
Mei.description: While Cryo-Freeze is active, Mei's Basic Ability cooldowns recover 200% faster.  Passive: Basic Attacks Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds.

Mei.title: Polar Vortex
Mei.description: Using an ability causes Mei to deal 24 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies for 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes damaged by this effect also have their Movement Speed and Attack Speed Slowed by 20%.

Mei.title: Fresh Powder
Mei.description: Snow Blind gains an additional charge and its range is increased by 33%.

Mei.title: Black Ice
Mei.description: Icing's Slow effect no longer decays over its duration. Icing deals 300% more damage to enemies very close to Mei.

Mei.title: Acclimation
Mei.description: Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero, the damage she deals and healing she receives is increased by 1%, stacking up to 20 times. While at maximum stacks, Mei also gains 10 Armor. Lasts 8 seconds.

Mei.title: Cascade
Mei.description: While traveling, Avalanche constantly launches a volley of untalented Snow Blind snowballs ahead of itself.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Avalanche by 30 seconds.

Mei.title: Shatter
Mei.description: When Ice Wall expires, trapped enemy Heroes hit take 210 (+4% per level) damage and have their Armor reduced by 25 for 5 seconds.

Mei.title: The Big One
Mei.description: Every 15 seconds, the next Snow Blind you cast has 67% increased area and 200% increased damage.

Mei.title: Flash Freeze
Mei.description: When Mei takes fatal damage she instantly gains Cryo-Freeze. This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

Mephisto.title: Unyielding Power
Mephisto.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Skull Missile.  Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, increase Skull Missile's damage by 100.  Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Skull Missile gains an additional charge.

Mephisto.title: Furious Spark
Mephisto.description: Every 3rd hit from Lightning Nova against the same target deals 65 (+4% per level) bonus damage and grants Mephisto 2 Mana.

Mephisto.title: Malicious Intent
Mephisto.description: Shade of Mephisto grants 25% Spell Power while active and for 2.5 seconds after ending.  If Mephisto hits enemy Heroes at least 18 times with his Basic Abilities while Shade of Mephisto is active, then increase the duration of the Spell Power bonus to 10 seconds after it ends.

Mephisto.title: Hateful Mending
Mephisto.description: Skull Missile grants 10 Mana and heals Mephisto for 70% of the damage it deals to Heroes.

Mephisto.title: Static Barrier
Mephisto.description: At the end of its duration, Lightning Nova grants Mephisto a Shield equal to 40% of the damage it dealt to Heroes. Lasts 5 seconds.

Mephisto.title: Spite
Mephisto.description: Increase Regeneration Globe healing duration by 150%. Every tick of Regeneration Globe healing activates Lord of Hatred, reducing Basic Ability cooldowns by 1 second.

Mephisto.title: Ghastly Armor
Mephisto.description: Shade of Mephisto grants 25 Armor while active and for 2.5 seconds after it ends.

Mephisto.title: Frost Storm
Mephisto.description: While Shade of Mephisto is active, enemies who are hit by Lightning Nova are Slowed by 15% for 1 second and the Slow from Skull Missile is increased to 50%.

Mephisto.title: Trickery
Mephisto.description: Shade of Mephisto grants 20% Movement Speed while active and for 2.5 seconds after it ends.  If Mephisto hits enemy Heroes at least 18 times with his Basic Abilities while Shade of Mephisto is active, then reset the cooldown of Shade of Mephisto.

Mephisto.title: Consume Souls
Mephisto.description: Channel for 2.5 seconds, revealing all enemy Heroes. After the Channel completes, all enemy Heroes take 357 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

Mephisto.title: Durance of Hate
Mephisto.description: After 1 second, unleash a wave of evil spirits that Root the first enemy Hero hit for 2.5 seconds and deal 250 (+4% per level) damage to them over the same duration.  Durance of Hate spreads outwards from its initial target, Rooting and damaging additional nearby enemy Heroes.

Mephisto.title: Abhorred Skull
Mephisto.description: Hitting a Hero with Skull Missile grants 25% Spell Power for 6 seconds. Skull Missile deals 40% more damage to Heroes under 50% Health.

Mephisto.title: Hysteria
Mephisto.description: Lord of Hatred also reduces the cooldown of Mephisto's Heroic Ability.  Mephisto is healed for 15% of his maximum Health and Mana when he casts his Heroic Ability.

Mephisto.title: Shard of Hate
Mephisto.description: Basic Attacks hit enemies near the primary target and activate Lord of Hatred against enemy Heroes, reducing Basic Ability cooldowns by 1 second per Hero hit.

Mephisto.title: Lightning Reaction
Mephisto.description: Skull Missile explodes on contact with Lightning Nova, dealing 138 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

Mephisto.title: Static Field
Mephisto.description: When Lightning Nova's damage bonus reaches 30%, enemy Heroes within its radius take damage equal to 10% of their maximum Health.

Mephisto.title: Animosity
Mephisto.description: Increase the duration of Lightning Nova by 1 second and the maximum amount of bonus damage it can deal from 30% to 42%.

Mephisto.title: Consumed by Hatred
Mephisto.description: Consume Souls deals bonus damage equal to 10% of the target's missing Health. If Consume Souls initial cast kills a Hero it will cast 1 additional time.

Mephisto.title: Unspeakable Horror
Mephisto.description: Durance of Hate Silences enemies while they are Rooted and for 3 seconds after its Root expires.

Mephisto.title: Mimic
Mephisto.description: While both Shade of Mephisto and Lightning Nova are active, Lightning Nova also casts from the Shade's location.

Mephisto.title: Shade Lord
Mephisto.description: Activate to swap locations with Shade of Mephisto and refresh its duration.  Passive: Shade of Mephisto benefits from all of Mephisto's level 7 Talents.

Muradin.title: Perfect Storm
Muradin.description: Quest: Every time Muradin hits an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack, increase Storm Bolt's damage by 0.75. If an enemy Hero is killed within 3 seconds of being hit by a Storm Bolt increase its damage by an additional 10.

Muradin.title: Dwarf Block
Muradin.description: Casting Dwarf Toss grants 4 charges of Block. Each Block charge grants 75 Physical Armor against a single enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

Muradin.title: Third Wind
Muradin.description: Increases Health Restoration rate to 90 (+4% per level) per second, and raises Health threshold to 60% Health for improved 180 (+4% per level) per second Restoration.

Muradin.title: Sledgehammer
Muradin.description: Stormbolt deals 350% damage to non-Heroic enemies. Increase Storm Bolt's cooldown reduction from 1 second to 1.25 seconds per Basic Attack.

Muradin.title: Reverberation
Muradin.description: Increases the Attack Speed Slow of Thunder Clap from 30% to 50% and the duration from 2.5 seconds to 3.5 seconds. Each enemy Hero hit reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 5%.

Muradin.title: Thunder Burn
Muradin.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Thunder Clap triggers a second explosion 2 seconds later in the same location that deals 75% damage.

Muradin.title: Heavy Impact
Muradin.description: Enemies hit by Dwarf Toss are Slowed by 80% for 1.5 seconds.

Muradin.title: Give 'em the Axe!
Muradin.description: Attacking a Hero that is Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed increases Muradin's Basic Attack damage by 50% for 3 seconds.

Muradin.title: Skullcracker
Muradin.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same enemy deals 90% bonus damage and Stuns them for 0.25 seconds.

Muradin.title: Avatar
Muradin.description: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 (+4% per level) Health.

Muradin.title: Haymaker
Muradin.description: Stun target enemy Hero, and wind up a punch dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking the target back, hitting enemies in the way for 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking them aside.

Muradin.title: Bronzebeard Rage
Muradin.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and heal for 75% of the damage dealt. Hitting an enemy Hero with Storm Bolt increase this damage by 200% for 3 seconds.

Muradin.title: Healing Static
Muradin.description: Muradin heals for 5% of his maximum Health for each Hero hit by Thunder Clap.

Muradin.title: Thunder Strike
Muradin.description: Thunder Clap deals 300% damage if only one target is hit.  Passive: Increase the duration of Dwarf Toss's Armor by 2 seconds.

Muradin.title: Dwarf Launch
Muradin.description: Increase the range of Dwarf Toss by 40%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Dwarf Toss reduces its cooldown by 2 seconds.

Muradin.title: Imposing Presence
Muradin.description: Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

Muradin.title: Stoneform
Muradin.description: Activate to heal Muradin for 30% of his maximum Health over 10 seconds. Second Wind is disabled during this time.

Muradin.title: Unstoppable Force
Muradin.description: While active, Avatar grants 20 Armor and causes Muradin's Basic Attacks to reduce the cooldowns of Thunder Clap and Dwarf Toss by 0.75 seconds.

Muradin.title: Grand Slam
Muradin.description: Haymaker gains a 2nd charge and its damage is increased by 25%. If a Hero dies within 3 seconds of being hit by Haymaker, instantly gain 1 charge.

Muradin.title: Hardened Shield
Muradin.description: Activate to gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 75% less damage.

Muradin.title: Rewind
Muradin.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.

Murky.title: Fish Eye
Murky.description: Egg's Health is increased by 100%, its sight radius is increased by 300% and it can see Stealthed enemies.  Passive: Spawning from his Egg increases Murky's mount speed to 45% for 5 seconds.

Murky.title: Egg Hunt
Murky.description: Activate to place a fake Egg. If the fake Egg dies, it casts an untalented Slime. Maximum 3 fake Eggs.  Passive: Spawning from his Egg grants Murky Stealth for 5 seconds.

Murky.title: A Fishy Deal
Murky.description: Killing a Minion with Pufferfish grants a stack of Bribe. Use 8 stacks to bribe a Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries.  Maximum of 32 stacks of Bribe.

Murky.title: Slime Time
Murky.description: Quest: Slime enemy Heroes that are already Slimed.  Reward: After Sliming 10 Heroes, increase Slime's bonus damage by 125.  Reward: After Sliming 20 Heroes, increase Slime's slow amount to 30%.

Murky.title: Tufferfish
Murky.description: Pufferfish gains 50 Spell Armor and deals 50% more damage to Slimed targets.

Murky.title: Living the Dream
Murky.description: Quest: Every 15 seconds Murky is alive, he gains 5% Spell Power, up to 25%. This bonus is reset upon his death.

Murky.title: Black Lagoon
Murky.description: Increase Slime's radius by 30%.

Murky.title: Slippery When Wet
Murky.description: Gain 50% Movement Speed and move through units while in Safety Bubble. Additionally, Safety Bubble's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

Murky.title: Time to Krill
Murky.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal an additional 7 (+4% per level) damage a second and slow the target by 7% for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 5 times.

Murky.title: March of the Murlocs
Murky.description: After 0.75 seconds, Murky commands a legion of Murlocs to march in a target direction, each one leaping onto the first enemy Hero or Structure they find. Each Murloc deals 125 (+4% per level) damage and slows its target by 15% for 5 seconds. Murlocs deal 50% damage to Structures.

Murky.title: Octo-Grab
Murky.description: Murky becomes Unstoppable and Stuns target enemy Hero for 3 seconds while he hits them for 1 damage a second.

Murky.title: Rejuvenating Bubble
Murky.description: Safety Bubble restores 40% of Murky's maximum Health.

Murky.title: Egg Shell
Murky.description: Spawning from his Egg grants Murky a Shield equal to 100% of his maximum Health. The shield lasts indefinitely.

Murky.title: Fish Tank
Murky.description: Murky is healed for 25% of the damage he deals with Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities.

Murky.title: Toxic Buildup
Murky.description: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack against an enemy Hero causes a free Slime to be cast upon them.

Murky.title: Fish Oil
Murky.description: The Pufferfish casts Slime at its location upon landing.

Murky.title: Wrath of Cod
Murky.description: Heroes hit by Pufferfish take additional damage equal to 15% of their maximum Health over 5 seconds.

Murky.title: Never-Ending Murlocs
Murky.description: March of the Murlocs can be channeled, sending little Murlocs indefinitely.

Murky.title: ... And a Shark Too!
Murky.description: Increase the damage of Octo-Grab by 13700% (+4% per level).

Murky.title: Big Tuna Kahuna
Murky.description: Murky's maximum Health and Egg respawn time are doubled.

Murky.title: Making Inky
Murky.description: Reduces the cooldown of Slime from 4 seconds to 2 seconds.

Nazeebo.title: Widowmakers
Nazeebo.description: Enemies hit by Corpse Spiders' jar are Slowed by 25% for 1 second.  Reward: After Corpse Spiders attack Heroes 100 times, their attack damage is increased by 25% and their duration is increased by 1 second.

Nazeebo.title: Pandemic
Nazeebo.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Plague of Toads.  Reward: After hitting 35 Heroes with Plague of Toads, it spawns 2 additional toads.  Reward: After hitting 70 Heroes with Plague of Toads, it reduces the damage Heroes deal by 5%, stacking up to 25%.

Nazeebo.title: Thing of the Deep
Nazeebo.description: Increase the range of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 20%.  Reward: After gaining 50 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain 5% Spell Power.  Reward: After gaining 100 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain an additional 5% Spell Power.

Nazeebo.title: Hexed Crawlers
Nazeebo.description: Corpse Spiders restore 1% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana when they attack an enemy Hero.

Nazeebo.title: Big Voodoo
Nazeebo.description: Increases the Health and Mana bonuses from Voodoo Ritual by 100%.

Nazeebo.title: Blood Ritual
Nazeebo.description: If an enemy dies while poisoned by Voodoo Ritual, restore 2% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana.  Passive: Takedowns grant 3 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.

Nazeebo.title: Spirit of Arachyr
Nazeebo.description: The number of Corpse Spiders spawned is increased from 3 to 4. If Corpse Spiders' jar hits only one enemy, it creates an additional spider.

Nazeebo.title: Dead Rush
Nazeebo.description: Zombie Wall deals 100% more damage. When it expires up to 5 remaining Zombies uproot and attack nearby enemies for 3 seconds.

Nazeebo.title: Toads of Hugeness
Nazeebo.description: Increase the damage and explosion radius of Plague of Toads by 25% after each hop, up to a maximum of 100%.

Nazeebo.title: Gargantuan
Nazeebo.description: Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area for 20 seconds. Deals 100 (+4% per level) damage when summoned, attacks for 140 (+4% per level) damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 140 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

Nazeebo.title: Ravenous Spirit
Nazeebo.description: Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230 (+4% per level) damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.

Nazeebo.title: Guardian Toads
Nazeebo.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Plague of Toads grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, stacking up to 6 seconds.

Nazeebo.title: Superstition
Nazeebo.description: Gain 40 Spell Armor. Heroic Basic Attacks against Nazeebo remove this bonus for 3 seconds and spawn a Corpse Spider to attack the Hero.

Nazeebo.title: Ice Block
Nazeebo.description: Activate to place yourself in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds.

Nazeebo.title: Spider Colony
Nazeebo.description: Corpse Spider Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 0.125 seconds.

Nazeebo.title: Ring of Poison
Nazeebo.description: Zombie Wall lasts 1 second longer, and the center is filled with poison that deals a total of 319 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. This damage starts small and increases over the duration.

Nazeebo.title: Soul Harvest
Nazeebo.description: Activate to increase Nazeebo's Health and Spell Power by 7% for each nearby enemy, up to a maximum of 35%. Lasts 15 seconds.

Nazeebo.title: Humongoid
Nazeebo.description: Gargantuan Stomp's area is increased by 25% and its Slow amount is increased to 50%.  Passive: Reduce Gargantuan's cooldown by 40 seconds and its Mana cost by 50%.

Nazeebo.title: Annihilating Spirit
Nazeebo.description: When Ravenous Spirit damages an enemy Hero, reduce their healing received by 50% for 1 second and increase Ravenous Spirit's damage by 5% for the rest of its duration.  Passive: Increases the range of Ravenous Spirit by 50%.

Nazeebo.title: Vile Infection
Nazeebo.description: Quest: Reach 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.  Reward: After reaching 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, it can also be applied to Heroes and its damage is increased from 67 (+4% per level) to 167 (+4% per level) over 6 seconds.

Nazeebo.title: Bad Medicine
Nazeebo.description: Consume 5 stacks of Voodoo Ritual to become Unstoppable, gain 20% increased Movement Speed, and 50 Armor for 2 seconds.

Nova.title: Longshot
Nova.description: Increases the cast range of Pinning Shot by 30%. Pinning Shot also increases the range of Nova's next Basic Attack by 2.

Nova.title: Covert Ops
Nova.description: After being Stealthed for 2 seconds, Pinning Shot's Slow is increased to 60% and costs no Mana. Bonus is lost after losing Stealth for 1 second.

Nova.title: Advanced Cloaking
Nova.description: After being Stealthed for 1 second, gain an additional 10% Movement Speed. While Stealthed, regenerate 3 Mana per second.

Nova.title: Rapid Projection
Nova.description: Reduces Holo Decoy's cooldown and Mana cost by 60%.

Nova.title: Holo Stability
Nova.description: Increase the cast range of Holo Decoy by 100% and its duration by 120%.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Ghost Protocol by 15 seconds.

Nova.title: Covert Mission
Nova.description: Enemy Minions killed near Nova grant a stack of Bribe. Hero Takedowns grant 10 stacks of Bribe. Use 25 stacks to bribe a Mercenary, instantly defeating them.  Does not work on Elite Mercenaries.  Maximum of 100 stacks. If a camp is defeated entirely with Bribe, the camp respawns 50% faster.

Nova.title: Perfect Shot
Nova.description: Hitting an enemy with Snipe reduces its cooldown by 2 seconds and refunds half its Mana cost, doubled against enemy Heroes.

Nova.title: One in the Chamber
Nova.description: After using an Ability, Nova's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals 65% additional damage.

Nova.title: Anti-Armor Shells
Nova.description: Nova's Basic Attacks deal 250% damage and decrease the Physical Armor of Heroic targets by 15 for 3 seconds, but her Attack Speed is proportionally slower.

Nova.title: Triple Tap
Nova.description: Locks in on the target Hero, then fires 3 shots that hit the first Hero or Structure they come in contact with for 372 (+4% per level) damage each.

Nova.title: Precision Strike
Nova.description: After a 1.5 second delay, deals 435 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within an area. Unlimited range.

Nova.title: Psionic Efficiency
Nova.description: Snipe's range is increased by 15% and hitting a Hero grants an additional stack of Precision Sniper.

Nova.title: Double Tap
Nova.description: Pinning Shot now has 2 charges, but its cooldown is increased by 2 seconds.

Nova.title: Ionic Force Field
Nova.description: Gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds after losing Stealth.

Nova.title: Explosive Round
Nova.description: Snipe also deals 90% damage to enemies near the impact.

Nova.title: Crippling Shot
Nova.description: Pinning Shot lowers a Hero's Armor by 20 for the duration of the Slow, causing them to take 20% increased damage.

Nova.title: Lethal Decoy
Nova.description: Increases the damage Holo Decoy deals to 30% of Nova's damage.

Nova.title: Fast Reload
Nova.description: Triple Tap's cooldown is reset if it kills an enemy Hero.

Nova.title: Precision Barrage
Nova.description: Precision Strike gains a 2nd charge and its cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

Nova.title: Apollo Suit
Nova.description: Reduce the cooldown of Permanent Cloak by 2 seconds.

Nova.title: Rewind
Nova.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.

Orphea.title: En Pointe
Orphea.description: Shadow Waltz deals an increased 90% damage to enemies hit by its end and grants 1 additional Chaos.

Orphea.title: Growing Nightmare
Orphea.description: Increase Dread's damage by 50%.   Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single cast of Dread's eruption.  Reward: Permanently increase Dread's eruption damage by 50% and increase the Slow amount of Dread's eruption by 15%.

Orphea.title: Ancestral Strength
Orphea.description: Non-Heroic Abilities deal 15% more damage to Stunned, Rooted, Silenced or Slowed enemies. Enemy Heroes who are hit with Overflowing Chaos are Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

Orphea.title: Allegrissimo
Orphea.description: Reduce the cooldown of Shadow Waltz by 1 second.  Hitting Heroes with the end of Shadow Waltz sets its cooldown to 0.75 seconds.

Orphea.title: Backbiter
Orphea.description: If Chomp hits a Hero, Orphea immediately dashes a short distance backwards.  Passive: Gain 15% maximum Health.

Orphea.title: Chaotic Assault
Orphea.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes while having 3 stacks of Chaos deal an additional 75% bonus damage.

Orphea.title: Insatiable
Orphea.description: Hitting a Hero with Chomp sets its cooldown to 2 seconds.

Orphea.title: Ravenous Hunger
Orphea.description: Quest: Minions that die within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Chomp permanently increase its damage by 2 and heal Orphea for 60 (+4% per level).  Heroes that die increase its damage by 40 and heal Orphea for 25% of her maximum Health.

Orphea.title: Mind Devourer
Orphea.description: Quest: Hitting Heroes with Dread increases its damage by 5, up to 150.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, hitting an enemy Hero with Dread's eruption sets its cooldown to 6 seconds and refunds 50 Mana.

Orphea.title: Eternal Feast
Orphea.description: After 1.5 seconds, deal 210 (+4% per level) damage in an area. Eternal Feast repeats every 1 second as long as it hits an enemy Hero.

Orphea.title: Crushing Jaws
Orphea.description: After 1.25 seconds, pull enemies in an area towards the center, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

Orphea.title: Determination
Orphea.description: After dashing with Shadow Waltz, Orphea gains 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability, stacking up to 2 times. While Orphea has Determination, her Physical damage is increased by 15%.

Orphea.title: Abyssal Symbiosis
Orphea.description: Hitting a Hero with Chomp instantly grants Orphea maximum Chaos and a 170 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds.

Orphea.title: Invasive Miasma
Orphea.description: Activate to deal 150 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies after 2 seconds. For each Hero hit, heal for 182 (+4% per level) and gain 1 Chaos.

Orphea.title: Bond of Anguish
Orphea.description: Shadow Waltz deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 3% of their maximum Health, healing Orphea for 50% of damage dealt.

Orphea.title: Dead Magic
Orphea.description: Basic Attacks that consume Chaos ignore Armor and deal 90 (+4% per level) Spell Damage to the target and all enemies around them.

Orphea.title: Lurking Terror
Orphea.description: After Dread erupts and for 2 seconds after, activate to cast Chomp from the eruption area. Enemy Heroes hit by this Chomp are Slowed by 70% for 1.5 seconds.

Orphea.title: Monster Within
Orphea.description: Eternal Feast grants 1 Chaos each time it hits a Hero. While Eternal Feast is active and for 5 seconds afterwards, Orphea's Basic Abilities recharge 150% faster.

Orphea.title: Engulfing Oblivion
Orphea.description: Crushing Jaws reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 50 for 3 seconds. Takedowns set its cooldown to 5 seconds.

Orphea.title: Eldritch Conduit
Orphea.description: Each Chaos consumed increases Orphea's Spell Power by 3%, up to 30%. After reaching the maximum bonus, the Spell Power is increased by an additional 30%. Lasts 10 seconds.

Orphea.title: Final Toccata
Orphea.description: Activate to instantly reset the cooldown of Shadow Waltz. For the next 5 seconds, dashing with Shadow Waltz resets its cooldown and increases the duration of Final Toccata by 1 second.

Probius.title: Echo Pulse
Probius.description: Disruption Pulse now returns to Probius 1.25 seconds after reaching its target, dealing 100% damage on the return trip.

Probius.title: Warp Resonance
Probius.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Warp Rift explosions.  Reward: After hitting 8 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, increase the explosion damage by 120.  Reward: After hitting 16 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, Warp Rift gains 1 additional charge.

Probius.title: Gather Minerals
Probius.description: Quest: Gather Minerals to increase the Health of Photon Cannons by 8, up to 560.  Reward: After collecting 70 Minerals, Photon Cannons deal 35% more damage.

Probius.title: Photon Barrier
Probius.description: While a Photon Cannon is alive and powered, Probius gains 40 Spell Armor.

Probius.title: Turbo Charged
Probius.description: Worker Rush grants an additional 10% passive Movement Speed while in a Power Field, and its cooldown is reduced by 14 seconds.

Probius.title: Shield Capacitor
Probius.description: Probius gains permanent Shields equal to 10% of his max Health. Shields regenerate quickly as long as he hasn't taken damage recently.

Probius.title: Particle Accelerator
Probius.description: After hitting 3 Heroes with Disruption Pulse, the next Warp Rift detonated by a Disruption Pulse fires 4 additional pulses that deal 78 (+5% per level) damage from the impact location in different directions.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

Probius.title: Rift Shock
Probius.description: Hitting a Warp Rift with Disruption Pulse within 1 second of it arming deals 105 (+5% per level) damage over 3 seconds.

Probius.title: Tower Defense
Probius.description: Reduce Photon Cannon's cooldown by 3.5 seconds when Disruption Pulse or Warp Rift damages an enemy Hero.

Probius.title: Pylon Overcharge
Probius.description: For 8 seconds, increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemy Heroes within it for 96 (+4% per level) damage per second. Pylons are Invulnerable for the duration.

Probius.title: Null Gate
Probius.description: Vector Targeting Project a barrier of negative energy in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies who touch the barrier take 76 (+4% per level) damage per second and are Slowed by 80% for as long as they remain in contact with it.

Probius.title: Aggressive Matrix
Probius.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 35% increased Attack Damage.

Probius.title: Power Overflowing
Probius.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 10% increased Spell Power and 2 Mana per second.

Probius.title: Shield Battery
Probius.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 28 (+4% per level) Shields per second, up to 112 (+4% per level). Shields persist for 2 seconds after exiting a Pylon Power Field.

Probius.title: Quantum Entanglement
Probius.description: Enemies continue to be slowed for 3 seconds after their last contact with a Warp Rift.

Probius.title: Gravity Well
Probius.description: Enemies are slowed more the closer they are to the center of the Warp Rift, up to a maximum slow of 60%.

Probius.title: Interference
Probius.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Warp Rift explosions have their Spell Power reduced by 35% for 5 seconds.  Additionally, enemies hit by Warp Rift explosions are knocked away from the center.

Probius.title: Construct Additional Pylons
Probius.description: Probius can now have up to 3 active Pylons, and increase the damage of Pylon Overcharge by 25%.

Probius.title: Gate Keeper
Probius.description: Null Gate lasts indefinitely if either end is within a Power Field.

Probius.title: Shoot 'Em Up
Probius.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Disruption Pulse take a  bonus 2.5% of their maximum Health as damage.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

Probius.title: Probius Loop
Probius.description: Whenever a Rift explosion hits 1 or more enemy Heroes, create a new Warp Rift in the same location.

Qhira.title: Maximum Effort
Qhira.description: If Carnage damages the same enemy Hero 3 times it deals an additional 108 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

Qhira.title: Fatal Wounds
Qhira.description: While at maximum stacks, Blood Rage's bleed deals 30% additional damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health.  Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage.  Reward: After damaging Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage 150 times, Blood Rage's duration is increased by 2 seconds.

Qhira.title: Finishing Touch
Qhira.description: Gain 20% Basic Attack damage. When Qhira Basic Attacks an enemy Hero below 50% Health it deals 20% additional damage, and she gains 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

Qhira.title: Upstage
Qhira.description: Damaging at least 2 Heroes with Blood Rage causes Qhira to Evade the next 4 Heroic Basic Attacks within 12 seconds.

Qhira.title: Ensnaring Swing
Qhira.description: The primary target of Revolving Sweep is Slowed by 60% while Qhira is attached to them. Secondary targets hit by Revolving Sweep's swing are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds.

Qhira.title: Your Pain, My Gain
Qhira.description: Basic Attacking an enemy Hero causes Qhira to gain 10 Armor for 3 seconds. Stacks 3 times.

Qhira.title: The Thirst
Qhira.description: Carnage heals for 50% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes. Anytime Carnage damages an enemy Hero, Qhira's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds against an enemy Hero deals 15% additional damage, stacking up to 10 times.

Qhira.title: Healmonger
Qhira.description: If Blood Rage damages an enemy Hero below 50% Health, it heals for an additional 190 (+4% per level) Health.

Qhira.title: Siphoning Link
Qhira.description: Damaging an enemy Hero with Revolving Sweep's initial impact or swing causes Qhira to regenerate 96 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.  Passive: Basic Attacks heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

Qhira.title: Unrelenting Strikes
Qhira.description: Deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 2.5 seconds as your sword grows outward. Upon expiring, deal 160 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemy Heroes and Stun them for 1.5 seconds.

Qhira.title: Final Strike
Qhira.description: After 1 second, deal 395 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. This damage is increased by 25% against enemy Heroes who are below 50% Health.

Qhira.title: Chainsaw
Qhira.description: Carnage's cooldown recharges 100% faster while an enemy Hero has maximum Blood Rage stacks.

Qhira.title: Pulsing Pain
