Qhira.description: Each additional enemy Hero hit by Revolving Sweep causes the primary target to take an additional 135 (+4% per level) damage.

Qhira.title: The Hunted
Qhira.description: Basic Attacking an enemy Hero increases your Basic Attack damage against that Hero by 25%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 4 seconds. Bonus is reset if a different Hero is attacked.

Qhira.title: Booming Kick
Qhira.description: Increase the Stun duration of Revolving Sweep's re-activation by 0.25 seconds. Enemy Heroes around the primary target are also affected by Revolving Sweep's re-activation.

Qhira.title: Lingering Ailment
Qhira.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Revolving Sweep or by Grappling Hook have their Armor reduced by 25 for 3 seconds.

Qhira.title: Swing Life Away
Qhira.description: Revolving Sweep's cooldown recharges 250% faster while Qhira is swinging around her target. She also gains 60 Spell Armor for 5 seconds after the re-activation impact.

Qhira.title: Silent Killer
Qhira.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Unrelenting Strikes Silences them for 0.5 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

Qhira.title: Unleashed Potential
Qhira.description: Increase the damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health from 25% to 50%.  If an enemy Hero dies within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Final Strike, then reset the cooldowns of Final Strike and all of Qhira's Basic Abilities.

Qhira.title: Utility Belt
Qhira.description: Grappling Hook's cooldown is reset when hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Revolving Sweep and recharges 900% faster if Qhira hasn't taken damage within the last 2 seconds.

Qhira.title: No Sanctuary
Qhira.description: Nearby enemy Heroes below 50% Health are revealed and you gain 20% Movement Speed while an enemy Hero is revealed by you in this way.  Additionally, you deal 20% increased damage to these revealed enemies.

Ragnaros.title: Sulfuras Hungers
Ragnaros.description: Quest: Every time Empower Sulfuras kills a Minion, its damage is increased by 1, up to 25.  Reward: After killing 25 Minions, increase its damage by an additional 100.

Ragnaros.title: Shifting Meteor
Ragnaros.description: Each time an enemy is hit by the same Living Meteor, they take 6% increased damage from it.  Quest: Hit 75 Heroes with Living Meteor.  Reward: After hitting 75 Heroes with Living Meteor, its duration is increased to 2.25 seconds, and it can be reactivated to change its direction once per use.

Ragnaros.title: Engulfing Flame
Ragnaros.description: Increase Blast Wave's damage by 75% and its radius by 15%.

Ragnaros.title: Fire Ward
Ragnaros.description: When Living Meteor hits an enemy Hero, gain a charge of Spell Armor, reducing damage from the next enemy ability by 50%.  Stores up to 2 charges.

Ragnaros.title: Slow Burn
Ragnaros.description: Blast Wave slows enemies hit by 40% for 2 seconds.

Ragnaros.title: Catching Fire
Ragnaros.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Ragnaros' Health Regeneration by 1.25 per second, up to 18.75.  Reward: After gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, activate Catching Fire to gain 25 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 25%.

Ragnaros.title: Hand of Ragnaros
Ragnaros.description: If Empower Sulfuras hits at least 2 enemy Heroes, refund 10 Mana and its cooldown recharges 100% faster for 4 seconds.

Ragnaros.title: Molten Power
Ragnaros.description: If Living Meteor hits enemy Heroes at least 5 times, reduce its cooldown by 7 seconds, and refund 30 Mana.

Ragnaros.title: Blistering Attacks
Ragnaros.description: Every 10 seconds, Ragnaros's next Basic Attack against a Hero deals 60% bonus damage. Hitting enemies with Basic Abilities reduces this cooldown by 1 second.

Ragnaros.title: Sulfuras Smash
Ragnaros.description: Hurl Sulfuras at the target area, landing after 0.75 seconds, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies in the center take 594 (+4% per level) damage instead and are Stunned for 0.5 seconds.

Ragnaros.title: Lava Wave
Ragnaros.description: Release a wave of lava from Ragnaros's Core that travels down the targeted lane, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage per second to non-Structure enemies in its path and instantly killing enemy Minions. Damage increased by 100% versus Heroes.

Ragnaros.title: Cauterize Wounds
Ragnaros.description: Empower Sulfuras heals for an additional 45% of damage dealt to Heroes over 2 seconds.

Ragnaros.title: Tempered Flame
Ragnaros.description: When Blast Wave damages an enemy Hero, gain a Shield equal to 100% of the damage dealt for 3 seconds.

Ragnaros.title: Resilient Flame
Ragnaros.description: When Ragnaros is Stunned, he gains 40 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 40%.  This effect has a 15 second cooldown.

Ragnaros.title: Giant Scorcher
Ragnaros.description: Empower Sulfuras burns enemy Heroes for 9% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds. This additional damage does not heal Ragnaros.

Ragnaros.title: Meteor Bomb
Ragnaros.description: Living Meteor explodes at the end of its path, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies at its center take 30% increased damage.

Ragnaros.title: Blast Echo
Ragnaros.description: After Blast Wave explodes, another Blast Wave is created on Ragnaros.

Ragnaros.title: Flames of Sulfuron
Ragnaros.description: Sulfuras Smash Slows enemies by 50% for 2.5 seconds, and the Stun duration of enemies hit in the center is increased by 1 second.

Ragnaros.title: Lava Surge
Ragnaros.description: Lava Wave gains an additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds.

Ragnaros.title: Heroic Difficulty
Ragnaros.description: Molten Core has 25% increased Health and Damage, and its cooldown is reduced by 50 seconds.

Ragnaros.title: Submerge
Ragnaros.description: Ragnaros submerges below, entering Stasis and healing for 600 (+4% per level) Health over 3 seconds.

Raynor.title: Exterminator
Raynor.description: Basic Attacks deal 50% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters. This is increased to 125% while Inspire is active.  Passive: Inspire does not expire on friendly Minions and Mercenaries.

Raynor.title: Veteran Marksman
Raynor.description: Quest: Every time the primary target of Give 'Em Some Pepper is a Hero, permanently increase its damage bonus by 0.75%.  Gambit: Gain 60% bonus Give 'Em Some Pepper damage. Every death reduces this bonus by 15%.

Raynor.title: Ace in the Hole
Raynor.description: Deal 12% more damage to Stunned or Slowed Heroes.  Enemy Heroes hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper are Slowed by 10% for 2.5 seconds.

Raynor.title: Fight or Flight
Raynor.description: Reduce Adrenaline Rush's cooldown by 10 seconds. Casting Adrenaline Rush grants 25 Armor for 3 seconds.

Raynor.title: Sustaining Rounds
Raynor.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper heals Raynor for 3% of his maximum Health, increased to 6% if the primary target is a Hero.

Raynor.title: Behemoth Armor
Raynor.description: Gain 200 bonus maximum Health.   Quest: Every time Give 'Em Some Pepper's primary target is a Hero, gain an additional 8 maximum Health.

Raynor.title: Heavy Slugs
Raynor.description: Increase Penetrating Round's Slow by 15% and its duration by 2 seconds.

Raynor.title: Fuel the Rush
Raynor.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Adrenaline Rush from 75 to 45. While Inspire is active, increase Adrenaline Rush's cooldown reduction from Basic Attacks by 300%.

Raynor.title: Unstable Compound
Raynor.description: Increase the area of Give 'Em Some Pepper by 15%. Each enemy Hero hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper grants Raynor 10 Mana and reduces the cooldown of Penetrating Round by 1.5 seconds.

Raynor.title: Hyperion
Raynor.description: Order the Hyperion to make a strafing run for 12 seconds, hitting up to 4 enemies for 66 (+4% per level) damage every second. Every 4 seconds, it can fire its Yamato Cannon at a Structure, dealing 794 (+4% per level) damage.

Raynor.title: Raynor's Raider
Raynor.description: Summon a Banshee that assists Raynor. The Banshee deals 84 (+4% per level) damage per second and regenerates 75 (+4% per level) Health per second if it hasn't taken damage in the last 4 seconds. Can reactivate to retarget or move the Banshee.  The Banshee respawns automatically after 45 seconds.

Raynor.title: Line 'Em Up
Raynor.description: Reduce the cooldown of Penetrating Round by 3 seconds. Penetrating Round hitting two or more enemy Heroes reduces its cooldown by an additional 3 seconds.

Raynor.title: Giddy-Up
Raynor.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed while mounted and unmounted. Inspire grants 10% more Movement Speed.

Raynor.title: Give Me More!
Raynor.description: Increase Adrenaline Rush healing by 50%. While Inspire is active, gain 1 Basic Attack range.

Raynor.title: Paint Them Red
Raynor.description: Increase the damage of Penetrating Round by 50% and heal for 90% of the damage Penetrating Round deals to Heroes.

Raynor.title: Rallying Cry
Raynor.description: Increase the Attack Speed bonus of Inspire by 20%.  Passive: After every 12 Basic Attacks, cast Inspire for free.

Raynor.title: Bounty Hunter
Raynor.description: If Give 'Em Some Pepper's target is a Hero, it deals an additional 3% of their maximum Health as damage and grants Raynor 10 Armor for 3 seconds.  Activate Give 'Em Some Pepper to apply it to Raynor's next Basic Attack.

Raynor.title: Cavalry's Arrived
Raynor.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper lowers the cooldown of Hyperion by 5 seconds if the primary target is a Hero. These Heroes are targeted by the Hyperion for 100% increased damage for 6 seconds.

Raynor.title: Dusk Wing
Raynor.description: Increase the Health and leash range of Raynor's Raider by 100%. Its Basic Attack lowers enemy Hero Armor by 3 for 1 second, stacking up to 30.

Raynor.title: Raiders Roll
Raynor.description: Adrenaline Rush grants Unstoppable and continues healing for an additional 2 seconds. The additional duration ends upon reaching 70% Health.

Raynor.title: Sergeant Pepper
Raynor.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper now activates every 3 Basic Attacks.

Raynor.title: Execute Orders
Raynor.description: Reduce Raynor's death timer by 35 seconds. Upon death, the Hyperion is cast towards the closest enemy Hero.

Rehgar.title: Stormcaller
Rehgar.description: Increase the radius of Lightning Shield by 25%.  Quest: Each time Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, permanently increase Rehgar's Health by 2 and Mana by 1, stacking up to 300 times.

Rehgar.title: Colossal Totem
Rehgar.description: Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

Rehgar.title: Feral Heart
Rehgar.description: Ghost Wolf's Movement Speed bonus is increased to 40% for the first second, then falls to 30%. Entering or exiting Ghost Wolf form grants 15 Armor for 1 second.

Rehgar.title: Earthliving Enchant
Rehgar.description: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds.

Rehgar.title: Electric Charge
Rehgar.description: The bearer of Lightning Shield Heals for 20% of the damage it deals to enemy Heroes, doubled if the bearer is Rehgar.  While Lightning Shield is damaging an enemy, its bearer gains 10% increased Movement Speed.

Rehgar.title: Healing Totem
Rehgar.description: Activate to place a Totem that heals allied Heroes in an area for 2% of their maximum Health every second. This Totem has 125 (+4% per level) Health and lasts for 10 seconds.

Rehgar.title: Grounded Totem
Rehgar.description: Enemy Heroes in Earthbind Totem's area also have their Attack Speed Slowed by 25% and their Spell Power reduced by 15%.  Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's range by 50%.

Rehgar.title: Purification
Rehgar.description: If Purge removes a Slow, Stun, Root, or Silence effect from an ally, heal them for 220 (+4% per level).  Using Purge on an enemy Hero deals up to 330 (+4% per level) damage to Shields and reduces healing received by 40% for 2 seconds.  Passive: Reduce Purge's cooldown by 15 seconds.

Rehgar.title: Blood and Thunder
Rehgar.description: Ghost Wolf attacks reduce Basic Ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and restore 5% of Rehgar's maximum Mana.

Rehgar.title: Ancestral Healing
Rehgar.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

Rehgar.title: Bloodlust
Rehgar.description: Grant nearby allied Heroes 40% Attack Speed and 35% Movement Speed and causes them to heal for 30% of the Basic Attack damage to their primary target. Lasts for 6 seconds.

Rehgar.title: Tidal Waves
Rehgar.description: Reduces Chain Heal's cooldown by 1 second for each Hero healed, and reduces its Mana cost from 60 to 40.

Rehgar.title: Earth Shield
Rehgar.description: Lightning Shield gives Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 14% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.

Rehgar.title: Wellspring
Rehgar.description: Every 2 seconds, Earthbind Totem will cast an untalented Chain Heal at the nearest allied Hero with the lowest Health. This Chain Heal heals for 35% of its normal amount.

Rehgar.title: Rising Storm
Rehgar.description: Every time a Lighting Shield damages an enemy Hero, increase its damage by 10%. Stacks up to 15 times.  Passive: Increase the duration of Lightning Shield by 3 seconds.

Rehgar.title: Earthgrasp Totem
Rehgar.description: When Earthbind Totem is first cast, it deals 115 (+4% per level) damage and Slows nearby enemies by 90% for 1 second.

Rehgar.title: Hunger of the Wolf
Rehgar.description: Ghost Wolf attacks against Heroes deal an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health and heal Rehgar for 6% of his maximum Health.

Rehgar.title: Farseer's Blessing
Rehgar.description: After 1.5 seconds, Ancestral Healing is cast a second time on the same target. Allies near the target are healed for 590 (+4% per level).

Rehgar.title: Gladiator's War Shout
Rehgar.description: Increase the duration and range of Bloodlust by 100%.

Rehgar.title: Elemental Conduit
Rehgar.description: Activate to gain Lightning Shield and grant all nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 10% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds.  For up to 5 seconds after activating, hitting an enemy Hero with this effects' Lightning Shield gives nearby allies a Shield equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds.

Rehgar.title: Pit Fighter
Rehgar.description: Gain 10% increased Attack Damage and 3 Spell Power. Each nearby ally Hero grants an additional stack of this effect, up to 5 stacks.  While at 2 or more stacks, Purge's cooldown refreshes 50% faster.

Rexxar.title: Bird of Prey
Rexxar.description: Increases Spirit Swoop's damage by 150% to Minions.

Rexxar.title: Easy Prey
Rexxar.description: Increases Misha's basic attack damage to Minions and Mercenaries by 150%, and Misha gains 50 Armor against Minions and Mercenaries, reducing damage taken by 50%.

Rexxar.title: Flare
Rexxar.description: Fire a flare at an area, revealing it for 20 seconds.

Rexxar.title: Hungry Bear
Rexxar.description: Misha's Basic Attacks heal her for 4.5% of her maximum Health.

Rexxar.title: Hunter-Gatherer
Rexxar.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Rexxar and Misha's Health Regeneration by 1 per second, up to 25 per second.  Reward: After gathering 25 Globes, Rexxar and Misha gain 15 Armor.

Rexxar.title: Grizzled Fortitude
Rexxar.description: Every 6 seconds, Rexxar and Misha gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.  Stores up to 2 charges. Both Rexxar and Misha have their own charges.

Rexxar.title: Animal Husbandry
Rexxar.description: Rexxar and Misha gain 2 Maximum Health every second Rexxar remains alive. These bonuses are lost on Rexxar's death.

Rexxar.title: Crippling Talons
Rexxar.description: Increases Spirit Swoop's slow amount to 50% and its duration to 3.5 seconds.

Rexxar.title: Taking Flight
Rexxar.description: Increases Spirit Swoop's range by 20%. If Spirit Swoop hits an enemy Hero, the Mana cost is refunded and its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

Rexxar.title: Aspect of the Beast
Rexxar.description: Misha's Basic Attacks lower the cooldown of Misha, Charge! by 1 second.

Rexxar.title: Bestial Wrath
Rexxar.description: Increases Misha's Basic Attack damage by 200% for 12 seconds.

Rexxar.title: Unleash the Boars
Rexxar.description: Release a herd of boars that track down all enemy Heroes in a direction, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, and slowing enemies by 40% for 5 seconds.

Rexxar.title: Aspect of the Hawk
Rexxar.description: When Spirit Swoop hits an enemy Hero, Rexxar gains 125% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Misha's Basic Attacks increase the duration of this buff by 0.75 seconds.

Rexxar.title: Dire Beast
Rexxar.description: Rexxar and Misha's Basic Attacks increase the damage of the next Misha, Charge! by 15%, stacking up to a 150% bonus.

Rexxar.title: Wildfire Bear
Rexxar.description: Misha deals 28 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

Rexxar.title: Thrill of the Hunt
Rexxar.description: Rexxar's Basic Attacks increase both his and Misha's Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds.

Rexxar.title: Primal Intimidation
Rexxar.description: Activate to slow the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of Heroes and Summons near Rexxar and Misha for 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack Rexxar or Misha have their Attack Speed slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

Rexxar.title: Feign Death
Rexxar.description: Rexxar fakes his death, becoming Invulnerable and untargetable for 5 seconds. During this time you control Misha.

Rexxar.title: Spirit Bond
Rexxar.description: Increases the duration of Bestial Wrath by 50% and Misha's Basic Attacks heal Rexxar for 50% of her damage dealt during Bestial Wrath.

Rexxar.title: Kill Command
Rexxar.description: Unleash the Boars deals 50% more damage and roots for 1.5 seconds.

Rexxar.title: Frenzy of Kalimdor
Rexxar.description: Rexxar's Basic Attacks deal 10% more damage, and Misha's Basic Attacks slow the target by 20% for 1.25 seconds.

Rexxar.title: Hardened Skin
Rexxar.description: Rexxar and Misha gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing damage taken by 75%.

Samuro.title: Way of Illusion
Samuro.description: Quest: Every time a Mirror Image Critically Strikes a Hero, Samuro gains 0.25 Attack Damage, up to 10.  Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Samuro gains an additional 30 Attack Damage.

Samuro.title: Way of the Blade
Samuro.description: Critical Strike now happens for Samuro and his Mirror Images every 3rd Basic Attack.   Samuro and his Mirror Images' Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes reduce their Physical Armor by 5 for 2.25 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

Samuro.title: Way of the Wind
Samuro.description: Gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds after entering or exiting Wind Walk.  Casting Wind Walk heals Samuro for 4% of his maximum Health.

Samuro.title: Mirage
Samuro.description: Mirror Image grants Samuro and his Images 40 Spell Armor against the next 2 sources of Spell Damage, reducing their damage by 40%.

Samuro.title: One with the Wind
Samuro.description: While Samuro has Wind Walk active and for 3 seconds after breaking it, both he and his Mirror Images gain 30 Armor, taking 30% reduced damage from all sources.

Samuro.title: Deflection
Samuro.description: Advancing Strikes grants Samuro and his Mirror Images 35 Physical Armor.

Samuro.title: Burning Blade
Samuro.description: Critical Strikes from Samuro and Mirror Images deal an additional 50% of their Basic Attack damage as Spell Damage to the target and nearby enemies.

Samuro.title: Phantom Pain
Samuro.description: Samuro's Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes deal an additional 35% of his Basic Attack damage for each Mirror Image that is active and reduce the cooldown of Image Transmission by 1 second.

Samuro.title: Crushing Blows
Samuro.description: Samuro's Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Critical Strike by 2 seconds.   Critical Strikes against enemy Heroes increase Samuro's Basic Attack damage by 10% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

Samuro.title: Bladestorm
Samuro.description: Cause a Bladestorm of destructive force around Samuro for 3 seconds, granting him 25 Armor and dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

Samuro.title: Illusion Master
Samuro.description: Mirror Images can be controlled individually or as a group and their damage is increased by 100%.  Passive: Image Transmission's cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.

Samuro.title: Mirrored Steel
Samuro.description: Samuro's Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Mirror Image by 0.75 seconds.

Samuro.title: Kawarimi
Samuro.description: Wind Walk creates a Mirror Image at Samuro's location that will continue whatever he was doing.

Samuro.title: Shukuchi
Samuro.description: Wind Walk teleports Samuro a short distance in the direction he's currently facing.

Samuro.title: Merciless Strikes
Samuro.description: Samuro's Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemies are always Critical Strikes.

Samuro.title: Harsh Winds
Samuro.description: Attacking a Hero during Wind Walk causes them to take 30% increased damage from Samuro for 3 seconds.

Samuro.title: Press the Attack
Samuro.description: While Advancing Strikes is active, Samuro and his Mirror Images gain 10% Attack Speed every time they Basic Attack, up to 40%.

Samuro.title: Dance of Death
Samuro.description: Mirror Images use Bladestorm when Samuro does, but for 45% damage.  If Samuro hits at least 20 enemy Heroes with Bladestorm, then reset its cooldown.

Samuro.title: Three Blade Style
Samuro.description: Samuro's Mirror Images only deal half of the damage they take to themselves, effectively increasing their Health by 25% and their duration is increased to 16 seconds.

Samuro.title: Wind Strider
Samuro.description: Wind Walk's cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds.

Samuro.title: Blademaster's Pursuit
Samuro.description: Advancing Strikes grants an additional 15% Movement Speed for Samuro and his Mirror Images, and its duration is increased by 2 seconds.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Ambush
Sgt. Hammer.description: Gain Stealth when entering Siege Mode or after not taking or dealing damage for 3 seconds while in Siege Mode. Basic Attacks while Stealthed deal 125% more damage.  Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Advanced Artillery
Sgt. Hammer.description: Increase Siege Mode's splash damage to 60% of Basic Attack damage, and increase its splash radius by 25%.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Maelstrom Rounds
Sgt. Hammer.description: Activate to increase Basic Attack damage dealt by 30% for 5 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode reduces the cooldown of Maelstrom Rounds by 5 seconds.  Stores up to 3 charges.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Barricade
Sgt. Hammer.description: Reduce Concussive Blast's cooldown by 4 seconds, its Mana cost by 40, and when cast create an impassable wall in front of Sgt. Hammer for 4 seconds.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Siege Tactics
Sgt. Hammer.description: Using Neosteel Plating while in Siege Mode grants Unstoppable for 2 seconds, as long as she remains in Siege Mode.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Regenerative Bio-Steel
Sgt. Hammer.description: Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Pulse Detonation Core
Sgt. Hammer.description: Spider Mines detonate 3 times over 3 seconds.  Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Spider Mines by 1.5 seconds.  Increase this bonus to 2.5 seconds while in Siege Mode.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Hover Siege Mode
Sgt. Hammer.description: Sgt. Hammer can move at 50% Movement Speed while in Siege Mode.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Graduating Range
Sgt. Hammer.description: While in Siege Mode, Basic Attack range is increased by 1 every 1.5 seconds, up to 3.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Blunt Force Gun
Sgt. Hammer.description: Fire a missile across the battlefield, dealing 500 (+3% per level) damage to non-Structure enemies in its path.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Napalm Strike
Sgt. Hammer.description: Deals 164 (+4% per level) damage on impact, and leaves a napalm area that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage per second. Lasts for 4 seconds.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Tactical Mine Deployment
Sgt. Hammer.description: Moving while Thrusters is active leaves a trail of up to 5 Spider Mines. Additionally, increase the Slow of Spider Mines by 15%.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Entrenched
Sgt. Hammer.description: While in Siege Mode, Concussive Blasts's damage and knockback distance are increased by 75%.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Hyper-Cooling Engines
Sgt. Hammer.description: While in Siege Mode, hitting Heroes with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Thrusters by 5 seconds.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Mechanical Know-how
Sgt. Hammer.description: Neosteel Plating grants 20% maximum Health as a Shield for 2 seconds and increases Basic Attack damage by 30% for 5 seconds.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Executioner
Sgt. Hammer.description: Attacking a Hero that is slowed, rooted, or stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Giant Killer
Sgt. Hammer.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Orbital BFG
Sgt. Hammer.description: Blunt Force Gun's missile orbits the planet every 5 seconds. Only the last missile fired orbits.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Advanced Lava Strike
Sgt. Hammer.description: Napalm Strike's range is increased by 75% and its impact does 50% more damage.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Shrapnel Mines
Sgt. Hammer.description: Upon detonating, Spider Mines reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 10, up to 50, for 4 seconds.

Sgt. Hammer.title: Ultra Capacitors
Sgt. Hammer.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode grants 10% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, up to 60%.

Sonya.title: Furious Blow
Sonya.description: Every 4th cast of Seismic Slam deals 40% more damage to the primary target and costs no Fury.

Sonya.title: War Paint
Sonya.description: Sonya's Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

Sonya.title: Tough As Nails
Sonya.description: Every 16 seconds, gain 60 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 60%.  Stores up to 3 charges. Charges refresh 200% faster while Fury's Movement Speed bonus is active.

Sonya.title: Shattered Ground
Sonya.description: Increase Seismic Slam's splash damage by 250%. Targeting a Hero with Seismic Slam further increases its splash damage by 250%, while targeting other enemies increases the length of its splash by 66%.

Sonya.title: Hurricane
Sonya.description: Reduce the cooldown of Whirlwind by 2 seconds. Casting Whirlwind removes all Slows and Roots from Sonya.

Sonya.title: Shot Of Fury
Sonya.description: Activate to gain 50 Fury. Usable while Whirlwinding.  Passive: After casting Seismic Slam, your next Basic Attack deals 40% more damage.

Sonya.title: Poisoned Spear
Sonya.description: Ancient Spear deals an additional 100% damage over 6 seconds.

Sonya.title: Life Funnel
Sonya.description: Increases the healing of Whirlwind to 35% of damage dealt.

Sonya.title: Battle Rage
Sonya.description: Activate to instantly restore 10% of Sonya's maximum Health. Stores up to 2 charges. Usable while Whirlwinding.  Passive: Sonya deals 25% more damage to Mercenaries.

Sonya.title: Leap
Sonya.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

Sonya.title: Wrath of the Berserker
Sonya.description: Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.

Sonya.title: Mystical Spear
Sonya.description: Ancient Spear always pulls Sonya to the target location even if it doesn't hit an enemy. When used this way, Ancient Spear's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.

Sonya.title: Ruthless
Sonya.description: Whirlwind deals an additional 50 (+4% per level) damage per second to Heroes below 50% Health. Does not generate additional healing.

Sonya.title: No Escape
Sonya.description: Increases the Movement Speed bonus from using Basic and Heroic Abilities to 20%.

Sonya.title: Giant Slammer
Sonya.description: Basic Attacks and Seismic Slam deal an additional 1.5% of Heroes' maximum Health as damage and heal Sonya for 60% of the damage dealt.

Sonya.title: Rampage
Sonya.description: Increase Basic Attack damage by 25%. Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Ancient Spear by 1.5 seconds.

Sonya.title: Nerves of Steel
Sonya.description: Activate to gain 25% of your maximum Health as a Shield for 3 seconds. Usable while Whirlwinding.

Sonya.title: Arreat Crater
Sonya.description: Leap leaves behind an impassable crater for 5 seconds.  Reduces Leap's cooldown by 20 seconds.

Sonya.title: Striding Giant
Sonya.description: Wrath of the Berserker increases maximum Health by 10% and grants Striding Giant, which can be activated to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds. 30 second cooldown.

Sonya.title: Composite Spear
Sonya.description: Increases Ancient Spear's range by 50%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Ancient Spear grants 25 Armor for 4 seconds.

Sonya.title: Ignore Pain
Sonya.description: Activate to gain 60 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 60% less damage. Usable while Whirlwinding.

Stitches.title: Patchwork Creation
Stitches.description: Gain 3 Armor for every unit afflicted with Vile Gas, stacking up to 8 times. While Shambling Horror is active, this Armor amount is doubled.  Passive: Increase regeneration effects and all healing received by 15%.

Stitches.title: Savor the Flavor
Stitches.description: Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with Devour increases Stitches' Health Regeneration by 1.5 and the damage of Vile Gas by 2%, stacking up to 100 times.

Stitches.title: Hungry for More
Stitches.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed.  Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Stitches's maximum Health by 25.  Reward: Every 20 Globes gathered permanently increases Stitches' Movement Speed by an additional 5%.

Stitches.title: Playtime!
Stitches.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Slam by 0.75 seconds and restores 5 Mana. Hitting Heroes with the inner area of Slam reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

Stitches.title: Vile Cleaver
Stitches.description: Basic Attacks against enemies with Vile Gas deal 35% more damage and spreads Vile Gas to nearby enemies.  Passive: Slam applies Vile Gas to all targets hit.

Stitches.title: Tenderizer
Stitches.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds and restore 1.75% of Stitches' maximum Health.

Stitches.title: Serrated Edge
Stitches.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook deals bonus damage equal to 5% of their maximum Health, reduces Hook's cooldown by 4 seconds, and restores 35 Mana.

Stitches.title: Second Helping
Stitches.description: Devour gains 1 additional charge with a 6 second cooldown between uses.  Gambit: If Stitches is at max Health after using Devour, he gains a Shield equal to 15% of his maximum Health for 10 seconds. Every death, reduce this Shield by 3%.

Stitches.title: Putrefaction
Stitches.description: While Shambling Horror is active, Vile Gas reduces healing received by 40%.  Passive: Vile Gas heals Stitches for 75% of the damage dealt.

Stitches.title: Putrid Bile
Stitches.description: Emit bile that deals 37 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies within, Slowing them by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Gain 20% Movement Speed while emitting bile. Lasts 8 seconds.

Stitches.title: Gorge
Stitches.description: Consume an enemy Hero, trapping them for 4 seconds. When Gorge ends, the enemy Hero takes 274 (+4% per level) damage. The trapped Hero cannot move or act and doesn't take damage from other sources.

Stitches.title: Meat Hook
Stitches.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook heals Stitches for 20% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. While active, Basic Attacks against the Hero hit refresh the duration of this effect.

Stitches.title: Under Pressure
Stitches.description: Increase Slam's damage by 25.  Quest: After damaging Heroes with Vile Gas 6 times, permanently increase the damage of Slam by 1, to a maximum of 75 additional damage.

Stitches.title: Chop Chop
Stitches.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook or activating Shambling Horror grants 40% increased Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh the duration of this effect.

Stitches.title: Pulverize
Stitches.description: All enemies hit by Slam are Slowed by 70% for 0.75 seconds and Heroes have their Armor reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.

Stitches.title: Digestive Juices
Stitches.description: Devour deals an additional 140 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds. When used on a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds and causes the Hero hit to deal 50% reduced damage for 4 seconds.

Stitches.title: Flare Up
Stitches.description: Deals 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook or activating Shambling Horror increases this damage by 150% for 4 seconds.

Stitches.title: Gift From The Embalmer
Stitches.description: Putrid Bile deals 100% more damage to Heroes.  Quest: Each time Putrid Bile damages an enemy Hero, the duration of Stitches' next death timer is reduced by 2%, to a maximum of 80% total reduction. All stacks of this effect are lost upon death.

Stitches.title: Hungry Hungry Stitches
Stitches.description: For 4 seconds after using Gorge, Stitches can teleport a short distance to additional targets and Gorge them. Enemies are Slowed by 75% for 1 second after Gorge ends.

Stitches.title: Master Hooker
Stitches.description: Reduce the cooldown of Hook by 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by Hook have 75% reduced healing for 2 seconds. Allies hit by Helping Hand are Unkillable for 2 seconds.

Stitches.title: Gas Bag
Stitches.description: Activating Shambling Horror grants Unstoppable for 3 seconds.  Passive: Shambling Horror's cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds.

Stukov.title: Fetid Touch
Stukov.description: Basic Attacks become ranged and Slow enemies by 20% for 1.5 seconds, but deal 35% less damage. This effect can be toggled.  Quest: Hit Heroes with Weighted Pustule.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Weighted Pustule by 5 seconds and remove its Mana cost.

Stukov.title: Low Blow
Stukov.description: Lurking Arm deals 100% more damage to enemy Heroes below 50% Health and persists for 1 second after it is canceled.

Stukov.title: Reactive Ballistospores
Stukov.description: While below 50% Health, the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch refreshes 100% faster.  Activate to instantly spread a Weighted Pustule to all nearby enemy Heroes and reset the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch.  This effect has a 75 second cooldown.

Stukov.title: One Good Spread...
Stukov.description: After a Healing Pathogen infests 3 targets, restore 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Healing Pathogen by 2 seconds.

Stukov.title: Biotic Armor
Stukov.description: Healing Pathogen grants 10 Physical Armor to targets while active on them. Detonating Bio-Kill Switch increases this bonus to 50 for 2.5 seconds.

Stukov.title: Vigorous Reuptake
Stukov.description: Bio-Kill Switch heals for 30% more when detonating 3 or more Healing Pathogens.

Stukov.title: The Long Pitch
Stukov.description: Increase the range of Weighted Pustule by 50%. Detonating 2 or more Weighted Pustules causes Stukov's Bio-Kill Switch and Basic Ability cooldowns to recharge 100% faster for 4 seconds.

Stukov.title: Growing Infestation
Stukov.description: Lurking Arm's area expands by 50% over 2.5 seconds, but it cannot be Channeled for longer than 3 seconds.

Stukov.title: Targeted Excision
Stukov.description: Detonating exactly 1 Weighted Pustule (but any number of Healing Pathogens) with Bio-Kill Switch reduces the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch to 7 seconds and other Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds.

Stukov.title: Flailing Swipe
Stukov.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

Stukov.title: Massive Shove
Stukov.description: Extend Stukov's arm. If it hits an enemy Hero, they are rapidly shoved until they collide with terrain, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Stukov gains 50 Armor while shoving an enemy.

Stukov.title: It Hungers
Stukov.description: Increase the range of Lurking Arm by 30%. If Lurking Arm damages enemy Heroes 8 times, its cooldown is reset and its Mana cost is refunded.

Stukov.title: Virulent Reaction
Stukov.description: Detonating a Weighted Pustule on an enemy who is inside of Lurking Arm Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

Stukov.title: Poppin' Pustules
Stukov.description: Detonating Weighted Pustule with Bio-Kill Switch within 1.5 seconds of its expiration increases its damage by 150% and applies its damage and Slow in an area. Enemy Heroes hit have a Weighted Pustule applied to them.

Stukov.title: Superstrain
Stukov.description: Whenever an ally with Healing Pathogen is Stunned or Rooted, they are instantly healed for 300 (+4% per level) Health.

Stukov.title: Universal Carrier
Stukov.description: Healing Pathogen can continually spread through Stukov, but its healing is reduced by 25%.

Stukov.title: Pox Populi
Stukov.description: Bio-Kill Switch no longer removes Healing Pathogen but instead sets its duration to 3 seconds.

Stukov.title: Controlled Chaos
Stukov.description: Flailing Swipe gains 2 additional charges, but each use only swings 1 time, at maximum range.  Additionally, its cooldown is decreased to 25 seconds, and its Mana cost is reduced from 60 to 25.

Stukov.title: Push Comes To Shove
Stukov.description: Massive Shove Slows its target by 50% for 4 seconds upon colliding with terrain. If Massive Shove pushes a target for more than 1.25 seconds, its cooldown is reduced by 15 seconds.

Stukov.title: Top Off
Stukov.description: Healing Pathogen's heal over time is increased by 30% while its target is above 60% Health.

Stukov.title: Bio-Explosion Switch
Stukov.description: Bio-Kill Switch now also detonates Lurking Arm, dealing 230 (+4% per level) damage, applying a Weighted Pustule, and Silencing enemy Heroes inside for 2.5 seconds.

Sylvanas.title: Might of the Banshee Queen
Sylvanas.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Withering Fire increases Sylvanas's Attack Speed and Spell Power by 5% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

Sylvanas.title: Unfurling Shadows
Sylvanas.description: Quest: Each time an enemy Hero with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse is hit by Shadow Dagger, its damage is permanently increased by 0.5%.

Sylvanas.title: Overwhelming Affliction
Sylvanas.description: Enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse are Slowed by 15%. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against Slowed enemy Heroes deal 1% of their maximum Health as damage.

Sylvanas.title: Unstable Poison
Sylvanas.description: Minions that die under the effects of Shadow Dagger or Sylvanas's Traits explode, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Minions, Mercenaries, and Summons.

Sylvanas.title: Mercenary Queen
Sylvanas.description: Friendly non-Elite Mercenaries near Sylvanas deal 60% more damage. Sylvanas Stuns and deals 30% additional damage to Mercenaries with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse.

Sylvanas.title: Possession
Sylvanas.description: Activate to force an enemy Minion to fight for Sylvanas's team. Catapults require 3 charges. Stores up to 3 charges.

Sylvanas.title: Barbed Shot
Sylvanas.description: Hitting the same enemy with 5 shots of Withering Fire causes the 5th shot to deal 350% bonus damage.

Sylvanas.title: Lost Soul
Sylvanas.description: Increase Shadow Dagger's damage by 10%.  Basic Attacks against Heroes with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse reduce the cooldown of Shadow Dagger by 1.75 seconds.

Sylvanas.title: Festering Wounds
Sylvanas.description: Increase Haunting Wave's damage by 15%. Haunting Wave applies 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse.

Sylvanas.title: Wailing Arrow
Sylvanas.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 (+4% per level) damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

Sylvanas.title: Mind Control
Sylvanas.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

Sylvanas.title: Cold Embrace
Sylvanas.description: Shadow Dagger reduces the Armor of the initial target by 25 and any enemy it spreads to by 10 for 2.5 seconds.

Sylvanas.title: Windrunner
Sylvanas.description: Haunting Wave can be cast a second time for free within 5 seconds after teleporting. Teleporting with Haunting Wave resets the cooldown of Withering Fire.

Sylvanas.title: Remorseless
Sylvanas.description: Increase Sylvanas's Basic Attack range by 1. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse shoot an untalented shot of Withering Fire. This shot of Withering Fire applies Banshee's Curse.

Sylvanas.title: Evasive Fire
Sylvanas.description: Hitting an enemy with Withering Fire grants 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%. Basic Attacks refresh this duration.

Sylvanas.title: Life Drain
Sylvanas.description: Heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sylvanas to enemies with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse. Healing is doubled against Heroes.

Sylvanas.title: Will of the Forsaken
Sylvanas.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

Sylvanas.title: Deafening Blast
Sylvanas.description: Enemies at the center of Wailing Arrow's explosion take 50% more damage and are Silenced for twice as long.

Sylvanas.title: Dark Lady's Call
Sylvanas.description: Heroes hit by Mind Control have their vision radius greatly reduced for 5 seconds. Mind Control's cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

Sylvanas.title: Withering Barrage
Sylvanas.description: Withering Fire applies Banshee's Curse, and Heroes hit by Withering Fire reduce its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

Sylvanas.title: Bolt of the Storm
Sylvanas.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

Tassadar.title: Static Charge
Tassadar.description: Quest: Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increases its damage by 5 and grants 33% Resonance Beam charge.  Maximum of 200 bonus damage.

Tassadar.title: Psi-Infusion
Tassadar.description: Increases the range of Psionic Storm by 33%. Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.

Tassadar.title: Khaydarin Amulet
Tassadar.description: Quest: Resonance Beam charges 50% faster.  Reward: After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 80 seconds, it bounces to hit 1 additional target for 75% damage, prioritizing Heroes.  Reward: After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 160 seconds, it bounces to hit 2 additional targets for 75% damage, prioritizing Heroes.

Tassadar.title: Induction
Tassadar.description: Tassadar gains 10% increased Movement Speed. Casting Shock Ray increases this bonus to 30% for 3 seconds.

Tassadar.title: Electric Fence
Tassadar.description: Force Wall deals 92 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies and Slows them by 35%.

Tassadar.title: Plasma Shield
Tassadar.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, gain a Shield equal to 3% of max Health every second, stacking up to 12%.

Tassadar.title: Beam Alignment
Tassadar.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, Shock Ray's cooldown refreshes 100% faster and its Slow duration is increased to 4 seconds.  Passive: Reduce the Mana cost of Shock Ray from 55 to 40.

Tassadar.title: Psionic Echo
Tassadar.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

Tassadar.title: Arc Discharge
Tassadar.description: When Resonance Beam is fully charged, Tassadar's Basic Attack range is increased by 1 and its next instance of damage also creates a Psionic Storm on the target.  This effect has a 20 second cooldown that decays twice as fast while Resonance Beam is fully charged.

Tassadar.title: Archon
Tassadar.description: Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds.  Resonance Beam: Deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to the target and splashes 70 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

Tassadar.title: Black Hole
Tassadar.description: After a 0.5 second cast, create a Black Hole that travels in a long line. Enemy Heroes within the Black Hole's area are quickly pulled towards its center. Touching the center deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns the target for 1.25 seconds.

Tassadar.title: Feedback
Tassadar.description: When an enemy Hero is affected by Psionic Storm, Resonance Beam's Slow is increased to 50% and it reduces Physical Armor by 25.

Tassadar.title: Shadow Walk
Tassadar.description: Tassadar becomes Stealthed and Unrevealable, but cannot attack or use Abilities for 1.5 seconds. While this effect is active, gain 40% increased Movement Speed and 35 Armor.  Can be cast while Channeling Shock Ray.

Tassadar.title: Oracle
Tassadar.description: Passive: While stationary, gain 30 Spell Armor for 0.75 seconds and restore 12 (+4% per level) Health a second.  Activate to Channel for up to 4 seconds, revealing a gradually increasing area anywhere on the map.

Tassadar.title: Thermal Lance
Tassadar.description: Shock Ray deals an additional 8% of maximum Health as damage to the first Hero it hits.

Tassadar.title: Psychic Shock
Tassadar.description: Psionic Storm deals damage 25% faster.

Tassadar.title: Executor's Will
Tassadar.description: Activate to gain full Resonance Beam charge, 20% Spell Power, and cause Basic and Heroic Ability cooldowns to regenerate 25% faster. This effect lasts as long as Resonance Beam remains at full charge.

Tassadar.title: Twilight Archon
Tassadar.description: Basic Attacks while in Archon form increase its duration by 2 seconds.

Tassadar.title: Kugelblitz
Tassadar.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Black Hole's center have their Armor reduced by 20 for 3 seconds and have a Psionic Storm created at their location.

Tassadar.title: Force Barrier
Tassadar.description: Increase the duration of Force Wall by 0.5 seconds, its range by 50%, and reduce its cooldown by 10 seconds.

Tassadar.title: Khala's Gift
Tassadar.description: Gain 4% Spell Power for yourself and each nearby ally Hero, up to 20% total Spell Power. Your total bonus is shared with all contributing allies.

The Butcher.title: Invigoration
The Butcher.description: If Hamstring hits a Hero, half of the Mana cost is refunded and the cooldown is reduced by 1 second.

The Butcher.title: Block
The Butcher.description: Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.  Stores up to 2 charges.

The Butcher.title: Chop Meat
The Butcher.description: Increases Hamstring damage by 100% to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

The Butcher.title: Flail Axe
The Butcher.description: Increases the length of Hamstring by 40%.

The Butcher.title: Unrelenting Pursuit
The Butcher.description: Reduces the cooldown of Ruthless Onslaught by 33% upon impact.

The Butcher.title: Cheap Shot
The Butcher.description: Hamstring does 100% more damage to targets affected by a Slow, Root, or Stun.

The Butcher.title: Insatiable Blade
The Butcher.description: While facing a branded enemy, The Butcher's Movement Speed is increased by 25%.

The Butcher.title: Victuals
The Butcher.description: Every time a nearby enemy minion dies, The Butcher heals 5% of his maximum health.

The Butcher.title: Meat Shield
The Butcher.description: When Ruthless Onslaught impacts an enemy Hero, The Butcher gains 50 Spell Armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 50%.

The Butcher.title: Furnace Blast
The Butcher.description: After a 3 second delay, fire explodes around The Butcher dealing 500 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.  Can be cast while using Ruthless Onslaught.

The Butcher.title: Lamb to the Slaughter
The Butcher.description: Throw a hitching post that attaches to the nearest enemy Hero after a 1 second delay. This deals 171 (+4% per level) damage and causes the enemy to be chained to the post and Silenced for 3 seconds.

The Butcher.title: Cleaver
The Butcher.description: Basic Attacks deal 35% of The Butcher's Basic Attack Damage in an area around the target.

The Butcher.title: Savage Charge
The Butcher.description: Ruthless Onslaught deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 10% of their maximum Health.

The Butcher.title: Brutal Strike
The Butcher.description: After using Hamstring, The Butcher's next 3 Basic Attacks within 5 seconds deal an additional 15% damage.

The Butcher.title: Crippling Slam
The Butcher.description: Hamstring's slow no longer fades out, and the duration is increased by 30%.

The Butcher.title: Enraged
The Butcher.description: While below 50% of his maximum Health, taking damage causes The Butcher to become Enraged for 10 seconds, gaining 40% Attack Speed and 25 Armor, reducing damage taken by 25%.  This effect has a 25 second cooldown.

The Butcher.title: Blood Frenzy
The Butcher.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant 5% increased Attack and Movement Speed for 3 seconds, up to 25%.

The Butcher.title: Fires of Hell
The Butcher.description: Furnace Blast explodes a second time 3 seconds after the initial explosion.

The Butcher.title: Slaughterhouse
The Butcher.description: Lamb to the Slaughter now chains all enemy Heroes in range.

The Butcher.title: Nexus Blades
The Butcher.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

The Butcher.title: Bolt of the Storm
The Butcher.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

The Lost Vikings.title: Olaf the Stout
The Lost Vikings.description: Passive: Olaf gains 20% bonus maximum Health.  Every 5 seconds, Olaf gains 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.  Stores up to 2 charges.

The Lost Vikings.title: Spy Games
The Lost Vikings.description: After standing still for 3 seconds, Erik gains Stealth and his Sight Radius is increased by 75%. The Stealth persists for 3 seconds after moving and once removed, Erik gains 75% bonus Basic Attack damage for 6 seconds.

The Lost Vikings.title: Explosive Attacks
The Lost Vikings.description: Increases Baleog's splash damage against non-Heroes to 100%.

The Lost Vikings.title: Viking Bribery
The Lost Vikings.description: Enemy Minions or captured Mercenaries killed near The Lost Vikings grant stacks of Bribe. Use 40 stacks to bribe target Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum stacks available: 200.

The Lost Vikings.title: Pain Don't Hurt
The Lost Vikings.description: Baleog's Basic Attacks and splash damage heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Healing is doubled against Heroes.

The Lost Vikings.title: Erik the Swift
The Lost Vikings.description: Permanently increases Erik's base Movement Speed by 10%, and as long as Erik is moving he heals 34 (+4% per level) Health per second.

The Lost Vikings.title: It's a Sabotage!
The Lost Vikings.description: Erik's Basic Attacks against Structures light them on fire for 3 seconds, causing 225 (+4% per level) damage.

The Lost Vikings.title: Mercenary Lord
The Lost Vikings.description: Friendly non-Boss Mercenaries near your Hero deal 50% more damage. Gain 50 Armor against Minions and Mercenaries, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

The Lost Vikings.title: Baleog the Fierce
The Lost Vikings.description: Increase Baleog's attack range by 2.5.  While near Olaf and Erik, he becomes inspired by the power of teamwork and his Attack Speed is increased by 50%.

The Lost Vikings.title: Spin To Win!
The Lost Vikings.description: Activate to have each Viking deal 85 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  Deals 100% bonus damage to enemy Heroes.

The Lost Vikings.title: Norse Force!
The Lost Vikings.description: All Vikings gain a 140 (+4% per level) to 308 (+4% per level) point Shield, increasing in strength for each Viking alive. Lasts 4 seconds.

The Lost Vikings.title: Longboat Raid!
The Lost Vikings.description: Hop into an Unstoppable Longboat that fires at nearby enemies for 128 (+4% per level) damage per second and can fire a mortar that deals 228 (+4% per level) damage in an area.  The boat has increased Health for each Viking inside. If the boat is destroyed by enemies, all Vikings are Stunned for 1 second. Lasts 15 seconds.  Requires all surviving Vikings to be nearby.

The Lost Vikings.title: Play Again!
The Lost Vikings.description: Summon, fully heal, and revive all Lost Vikings at target location after a Viking channels for 2 seconds.  Only one Viking may attempt to summon at a time.

The Lost Vikings.title: Hunka' Burning Olaf
The Lost Vikings.description: Olaf deals 34 (+4% per level) damage every second to nearby enemies.

The Lost Vikings.title: Jump!
The Lost Vikings.description: Makes all Vikings Invulnerable and able to pass over enemies for 1.5 seconds.

The Lost Vikings.title: Nordic Attack Squad
The Lost Vikings.description: While Olaf, Baleog, and Erik are near each of the other two Vikings, their Basic Attacks deal bonus damage equal to 1.25% maximum Health to enemy Heroes.

The Lost Vikings.title: Large and In Charge
The Lost Vikings.description: When Olaf charges enemies, they are stunned for 1 second.

The Lost Vikings.title: Impatience Is a Virtue
The Lost Vikings.description: Enemies damaged by a Viking's Basic Attack reduce the cooldown of all Viking Abilities by 0.31 seconds.

The Lost Vikings.title: 64 KB Marathon
The Lost Vikings.description: Activating Go Go Go! grants an additional 40% Movement Speed and breaks the Vikings out of Roots and Slows.

The Lost Vikings.title: Executioner
The Lost Vikings.description: Attacking a Hero that is slowed, rooted, or stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

The Lost Vikings.title: Ragnarok 'n' Roll!
The Lost Vikings.description: The Longboat can attack two targets at once and the range of its Mortar is increased by 100%. Reduce Longboat Raid!'s cooldown by 30 seconds.

The Lost Vikings.title: Checkpoint Reached
The Lost Vikings.description: 10 seconds after using Play Again!, any dead Vikings are revived and summoned again, and all are healed to full.

The Lost Vikings.title: The Sequel!
The Lost Vikings.description: Reduces the Lost Vikings's death timer by 50%.

The Lost Vikings.title: Fury of the Storm
The Lost Vikings.description: Every 5 seconds, the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 41 (+4% per level) damage to the target, and 105 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby Minions, Mercenaries and Monsters.  Each Viking has their own cooldown.

Thrall.title: Echo of the Elements
Thrall.description: Quest: Kill Minions or Heroes within 1.5 seconds of hitting them with Chain Lightning.  Reward: After killing 10 enemies, reduce the Mana cost of Chain Lightning from 40 to 20.  Reward: After killing 20 enemies, gain a second charge of Chain Lightning.

Thrall.title: Crash Lightning
Thrall.description: Repeatable Quest: Hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single use of Chain Lightning increases the damage of its bounces by 12, up to 360.  Reward: After hitting multiple Heroes 30 times, Chain Lightning prioritizes bouncing to Heroes.

Thrall.title: Rolling Thunder
Thrall.description: For 8 seconds after hitting an enemy with Chain Lightning, Thrall's next Basic Attack against them grants a stack of Frostwolf Resilience. If the target is an enemy Hero, then he also deals damage to them equal to 3% of their maximum Health and healing for the same amount.  Passive: Increase the number of Chain Lightning bounces by 1.

Thrall.title: Feral Resilience
Thrall.description: Heroes damaged by Feral Spirit grant 4 stacks of Frostwolf Resilience and 2 stacks of Feral Resilience, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next incoming Hero Basic Attack.  Stacks are consumed on the next cast of Feral Spirit.

Thrall.title: Frostwolf Pack
Thrall.description: Quest: Hit 6 Heroes with Feral Spirit. Progress is lost on death and when Thrall fails to hit a Hero.  Reward: Reduce the cooldown and Mana cost of Feral Spirit by 50%.

Thrall.title: Mana Tide
Thrall.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

Thrall.title: Maelstrom Weapon
Thrall.description: Repeatable Quest: Basic Attacks against Heroes while Windfury's Movement Speed bonus is active increase Attack Damage by 1.  Reward: After gaining 20 Attack Damage, increase the Movement Speed bonus of Windfury to 40%.  Reward: After gaining 40 Attack Damage, Thrall permanently gains 15% increased Movement Speed.

Thrall.title: Ancestral Wrath
Thrall.description: Activate to consume 8 stacks of Ancestral Wrath, damaging a target enemy Hero for 15% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds, and healing Thrall for 150% of the damage dealt.  Gain 1 stack of Ancestral Wrath every time Frostwolf Resilience activates.

Thrall.title: Follow Through
Thrall.description: After using an Ability, your next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 40% additional damage.

Thrall.title: Sundering
Thrall.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 (+4% per level) damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

Thrall.title: Earthquake
Thrall.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon a massive Earthquake that pulses every 4 seconds. Each pulse lasts 2 seconds, Slowing all enemies in the area by 50%, and deals 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes. Does 3 pulses.

Thrall.title: Grace Of Air
Thrall.description: Windfury attacks grant twice as many stacks of Frostwolf Resilience.

Thrall.title: Frostwolf's Grace
Thrall.description: Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing health.

Thrall.title: Spirit Shield
Thrall.description: Every 45 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 4 seconds. Frostwolf Resilience reduces this cooldown by 10 seconds.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

Thrall.title: Tempest Fury
Thrall.description: The final strike of Windfury hits 3 times for 75% normal damage.

Thrall.title: Thunderstorm
Thrall.description: Chain Lightning Slows targets by 8% for 2 seconds.  Quest: Targeting a Hero directly with Chain Lightning increases this Slow by 8%, up to an additional 40%.  Reward: While at a 40% bonus, Chain Lightning's damage is increased by 25%.  Bonuses are reset if Chain Lightning is used on the same Hero it was last used on, or if Thrall dies.

Thrall.title: Alpha Wolf
Thrall.description: For 3 seconds after a Hero is hit by Feral Spirit, Thrall's Basic Attacks against them deal an additional 3% of the target's maximum Health as damage.  Passive: Increase the duration of Feral Spirit's Root to 1.5 seconds.

Thrall.title: Worldbreaker
Thrall.description: Lower the cooldown of Sundering by 40 seconds. After Sundering impacts, it leaves behind an impassable rift, blocking unit movement for 3 seconds.

Thrall.title: Earthen Shields
Thrall.description: Allies within the Earthquake area gain a Shield equal to 15% of their maximum Health each pulse. This shield lasts 4 seconds.

Thrall.title: Elemental Momentum
Thrall.description: Basic Attacks reduce Thrall's Basic and Heroic Ability cooldowns by 0.25 seconds, tripled against Heroes.

Thrall.title: Nexus Blades
Thrall.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

Thrall.title: Wind Rush
Thrall.description: Activate to immediately teleport to a target location and gain Windfury.

Tracer.title: One-Two Punch
Tracer.description: Reduce the cooldown of Melee by 1 second and it gains an additional charge.

Tracer.title: Parting Gift
Tracer.description: Recall leaves behind 6 bombs that deal 240 (+4% per level) damage each to different targets. Heroes hit with these bombs are slowed by 50% for 0.75 seconds and grant 7% Pulse Bomb charge.

Tracer.title: Tracer Rounds
Tracer.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 10%. Basic Attacks against Heroes reveal a small area around them for 3 seconds.

Tracer.title: Leeching Rounds
Tracer.description: Increase the healing from Basic Attacks by up to 200%, based on the amount of health Tracer is missing.

Tracer.title: Pulse Generator
Tracer.description: Successfully sticking a Pulse Bomb to an enemy Hero heals Tracer for 18% of her maximum Health over 1.5 seconds and refunds a charge of Blink.

Tracer.title: Is That a Health Pack?!
Tracer.description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe instantly heals Tracer for 10% of her maximum Health and reduces the cooldown of Healing Fountain by 15 seconds.  Drinking from a Healing Fountain instantly heals for 20% of Tracer's maximum Health.

Tracer.title: Sleight of Hand
Tracer.description: Reduces Reload time by 50%. This equals 20% more damage per second.

Tracer.title: Focus Fire
Tracer.description: If an entire ammo magazine is unloaded on an enemy, the last bullet will deal 80 (+4% per level) bonus damage.  This is equal to 35% of the total magazine.

Tracer.title: Locked and Loaded
Tracer.description: Reactivate Reload within the last 50% of its cast time to increase Tracer's Basic Attack damage by 40% for that magazine.

Tracer.title: Sticky Bomb
Tracer.description: Increases Pulse Bomb's radius by 50% and enemies hit are Slowed by 70% for 3 seconds.

Tracer.title: Quantum Spike
Tracer.description: Pulse Bomb deals an additional 6% of maximum Health as damage to Heroes.

Tracer.title: Pulse Rounds
Tracer.description: Increases Pulse Bomb's range and charge rate from Basic Attacks against Heroes by 100%.

Tracer.title: Untouchable
Tracer.description: Passive: After Blinking, gain 20% Movement Speed for 1.25 seconds.  Quest: Takedowns increase Tracer's Basic Attack damage by 5%, up to 25%. These bonuses are lost on death.

Tracer.title: Jumper
Tracer.description: Passive: When Blink has no charges remaining, its cooldown refreshes 150% faster.  Casting Blink grants Tracer a Shield equal to 6.5% of her maximum Health for 3 seconds. This Shield stacks up to 3 times.

Tracer.title: Telefrag
Tracer.description: Passive: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Recall by 0.1875 seconds.  When Tracer arrives at her Recall location she becomes Unkillable for 1 second and nearby enemies take 175 (+4% per level) damage and are knocked back.

Tracer.title: Bullet Spray
Tracer.description: Increases the radius of Melee by 30%, and causes it to damage all enemies in range.

Tracer.title: Heavy Handed
Tracer.description: Heroes hit by Melee have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

Tracer.title: Ricochet
Tracer.description: Tracer's Basic Attacks have a 60% chance to hit another nearby enemy, prioritizing Heroes.

Tracer.title: Chrono Triggers
Tracer.description: Casting Blink causes Basic Attacks to not consume ammo for 1 second.

Tracer.title: Get Stuffed!
Tracer.description: Increases Melee's Pulse Bomb charge against Heroes from 10% to 20%. Hitting an enemy with Melee who is stuck with a Pulse Bomb causes the bomb to instantly explode and knock the target away.

Tracer.title: Total Recall
Tracer.description: Recall heals Tracer equal to the amount of Health she lost during that time.

Tracer.title: Composition B
Tracer.description: Successfully sticking a Pulse Bomb to an enemy Hero also drops another one at their feet that deals 50% damage and explodes slightly earlier.

Tychus.title: Quarterback
Tychus.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 50%.

Tychus.title: Dash
Tychus.description: Increase the range of Run and Gun by 50%. When cast, increase Tychus's Movement Speed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

Tychus.title: Press the Advantage
Tychus.description: Increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.

Tychus.title: In the Rhythm
Tychus.description: Quest: While Minigun is active, Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increase future Minigun durations by 0.03 seconds.

Tychus.title: The Bigger They Are...
Tychus.description: Increase the damage bonus to 4% while enemy Heroes are above 30% Health, but Minigun no longer has any effect on targets below 30%.

Tychus.title: Master Assassin
Tychus.description: Passive: Increase Tychus's Attack Speed by 10%.  Reward: After getting 15 Takedowns, Tychus's Attack Speed is increased by an additional 15%.

Tychus.title: Melting Point
Tychus.description: Enemies hit by Frag Grenade take an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

Tychus.title: Combat Tactician
Tychus.description: Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by 4 seconds. Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by an additional 4 seconds after using Run and Gun.

Tychus.title: Relentless Soldier
Tychus.description: Being Stunned or Rooted grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

Tychus.title: Commandeer Odin
Tychus.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

Tychus.title: Drakken Laser Drill
Tychus.description: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142 (+4% per level) damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Lasts 22 seconds.

Tychus.title: Spray 'n' Pray
Tychus.description: Overkill Slows enemy Movement Speed by 25% and its range is increased by 25%.

Tychus.title: That's the Stuff!
Tychus.description: Minigun heals Tychus for 100% of the bonus damage dealt after it expires.

Tychus.title: Neosteel Coating
Tychus.description: Activate to gain 75 Spell Armor for 4 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

Tychus.title: Armor Piercing Rounds
Tychus.description: Each time Overkill hits an enemy, its damage against them is increased by 15%, stacking up to 60% bonus damage.

Tychus.title: Titan Grenade
Tychus.description: Frag Grenade deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their maximum Health.  Each enemy Hero hit by Frag Grenade reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

Tychus.title: Sizzlin' Attacks
Tychus.description: Basic Attacks deal bonus damage to Heroes equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Stacks with Minigun.

Tychus.title: Big Red Button
Tychus.description: Odin lasts 50% longer and Ragnarok Missiles also launches a Nuclear Missile which lands 2.5 seconds later, dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage in its area.

Tychus.title: Focusing Diodes
Tychus.description: Increases the range of the Drakken Laser Drill by 50%.  Deals increasing damage the longer it remains on a single target, up to 100% extra damage.

Tychus.title: Can Do This All Day
Tychus.description: Reduce Overkill's cooldown by 5 seconds.  While Channeling Overkill, Tychus gains 40 Armor.

Tychus.title: Bob and Weave
Tychus.description: Run and Gun and Odin's Thrusters gain 2 additional charges and reduces Run and Gun's Mana cost from 50 to 25.  After using Run and Gun, increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.5 for 4 seconds.

Tyrael.title: Salvation
Tyrael.description: Increase the Shield amount Tyrael gains from Righteousness by 40% and heal Tyrael for 140 (+4% per level) Health if his Shield is destroyed. Does not increase the Shield amount gained by allies.

Tyrael.title: Justice for All
Tyrael.description: Increase the Shield applied to allies by Righteousness to 80% of the Shield gained by Tyrael.

Tyrael.title: Ardent Restoration
Tyrael.description: Dealing damage to a Hero heals Tyrael for 20 (+4% per level) Health over 5 seconds. Dealing damage resets this timer, and the heal amount stacks up to 10 times.  Quest: Every Regeneration Globe gathered increases this heal amount by 1%.

Tyrael.title: Stalwart Angel
Tyrael.description: Gain 25 Armor while El'druin's Might is active, and for 3 seconds after teleporting.

Tyrael.title: Bound by Law
Tyrael.description: Heroes hit by El'druin's Might heal Tyrael for 3% of his maximum Health. Tyrael's Basic Attacks against enemies Slowed by El'druin's Might increase the Slow duration by 1 second, up to 4 seconds.

Tyrael.title: Divine Vigor
Tyrael.description: If Smite hits an enemy, Tyrael's Basic Attacks within the next 4 seconds heal for 70% of the damage dealt.

Tyrael.title: Reciprocate
Tyrael.description: When Tyrael's Shield from Righteousness expires or is destroyed, it deals 190 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

Tyrael.title: Purge Evil
Tyrael.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Smite increases Tyrael's Basic Attack damage by 60% for 4 seconds.

Tyrael.title: Swift Retribution
Tyrael.description: Smite grants 20% more Movement Speed and also grants 25% Attack Speed for 2 seconds.

Tyrael.title: Judgment
Tyrael.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75 (+4% per level) damage.

Tyrael.title: Sanctification
Tyrael.description: After 0.5 seconds create a field of holy energy that makes allied Heroes Invulnerable. Lasts 3 seconds.

Tyrael.title: Sword of Justice
Tyrael.description: Upon teleporting using El'druin's Might, El'druin swaps places with Tyrael, and El'druin's Might can be reactivated to teleport an additional time.

Tyrael.title: Holy Ground
Tyrael.description: Create a ring for 3 seconds that blocks enemies from entering the area teleported to using El'druin's Might.

Tyrael.title: Law and Order
Tyrael.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Smite reduces the cooldown of Righteousness by 1 second. Each allied Hero Shielded by Righteousness increases the damage of the next Smite by 35%.

Tyrael.title: Horadric Reforging
Tyrael.description: Tyrael's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of El'druin's Might by 2 seconds.

Tyrael.title: Burning Halo
Tyrael.description: Both Tyrael and El'druin deal 18 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Teleporting increases this damage from Tyrael by 150% for 2 seconds.

Tyrael.title: Smite the Wicked
Tyrael.description: While El'druin's Might is active, and for 2 seconds after teleporting, Smite's cooldown recharges 125% faster.

Tyrael.title: Angel of Justice
Tyrael.description: Increases the cast range of Judgment by 50%, and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.

Tyrael.title: Holy Arena
Tyrael.description: Increase the duration of Sanctification by 1 second and increase the damage of allies inside by 25%.

Tyrael.title: Seal of El'Druin
Tyrael.description: Using a Basic Ability grants 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

Tyrael.title: Defense of the Angels
Tyrael.description: Activate to gain 50 Armor for 3 seconds.  Each time Tyrael damages an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack or Basic Ability, increase the duration of this Armor bonus by 0.5 seconds.

Tyrande.title: Ranger
Tyrande.description: Sentinel pierces the first Hero hit. Its width is increased by 25% and deals up to 250% more damage based on distance traveled.

Tyrande.title: Lunar Blaze
Tyrande.description: Increase Lunar Flare's range by 30%.  Quest: Hitting a Hero with Lunar Flare increases its damage by 5%, up to 150%.

Tyrande.title: Trueshot Aura
Tyrande.description: Activate to grant other nearby allied Heroes 40% increased Attack Damage for 5 seconds, and to reset the cooldown of Hunter's Mark.  Passive: Basic Attack damage increased by 30%.

Tyrande.title: Everlasting Light
Tyrande.description: If Light of Elune's second charge is cast on a different target from the first, it heals for 80% more.

Tyrande.title: Mark of Mending
Tyrande.description: Tyrande's Basic Attacks against Marked targets heal other allied Heroes near the enemy for 4% of their maximum Health.

Tyrande.title: Elune's Chosen
Tyrande.description: Activate to make Tyrande's Basic Attacks heal target allied Hero for 175% of the damage dealt. Lasts for 8 seconds.

Tyrande.title: Moonlit Arrows
Tyrande.description: Basic Attacks decrease the cooldown of Light of Elune by an additional 0.75 seconds.

Tyrande.title: Kaldorei Resistance
Tyrande.description: Light of Elune grants the target 10 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 2 times.

Tyrande.title: Huntress' Fury
Tyrande.description: Increase the cast range and duration of Hunter's Mark by 25%. Tyrande's Basic Attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark bounce  to nearby enemy Heroes.

Tyrande.title: Shadowstalk
Tyrande.description: Grant all allied Heroes Stealth for 10 seconds and heal them for 380 (+4% per level) Health over 10 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

Tyrande.title: Starfall
Tyrande.description: Deal 92 (+4% per level) damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.

Tyrande.title: Quickening Blessing
Tyrande.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Light of Elune increases the target's Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

Tyrande.title: Harsh Moonlight
Tyrande.description: Sentinel Slows enemies hit by 35% and reduces their damage dealt by 35% for 3 seconds.

Tyrande.title: Ranger's Mark
Tyrande.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hunter's Mark by 2 second. Basic Attacks against marked targets reduce the cooldown of Lunar Flare by 4 seconds.

Tyrande.title: Celestial Attunement
Tyrande.description: Light of Elune removes Stuns, Silences, and Slows from its target.

Tyrande.title: Empower
Tyrande.description: Reduce Sentinel's cooldown by 3 seconds. Heroes hit by Sentinel takes bonus damage equal to 6% of their maximum Health.

Tyrande.title: Darnassian Archery
Tyrande.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant a stacking 12% increased Attack Damage bonus for 4 seconds.

Tyrande.title: Eyes of the Huntress
Tyrande.description: Shadowstalk reveals all enemy Heroes for 10 seconds and heals for 75% more.

Tyrande.title: Celestial Wrath
Tyrande.description: Increase the Slow of Starfall to 60% and cause it to apply Hunter's Mark to enemy Heroes while inside of its area of effect.

Tyrande.title: Shooting Star
Tyrande.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1. Every 8th Basic Attack casts a free Lunar Flare at a random enemy near Tyrande's position. This prefers Heroic targets.

Tyrande.title: Iceblade Arrows
Tyrande.description: Increase Attack Speed by 20%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce their damage dealt by 8% for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times.

Uther.title: Silver Touch
Uther.description: Quest: Reduce damage from Heroic sources with Devotion.  Reward: After reducing damage 40 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced from 80 to 60.  Reward: After reducing damage 80 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced to 40, and its range is increased by 50%.

Uther.title: Wave of Light
Uther.description: Quest: Damage or heal Heroes 60 times with Holy Radiance.  Reward: Increase the duration of Devotion by 0.5 seconds.  Passive: Damaging or healing Heroes with Holy Radiance refunds 5 Mana and reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

Uther.title: Hammer of the Lightbringer
Uther.description: Quest: Basic Attack enemies 75 times.  Reward: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hammer of Justice by 1.5 seconds.  Passive: Basic Attacks restore 1.5% of Uther's maximum Mana.

Uther.title: Holy Shock
Uther.description: Holy Light can be used on an enemy to do 40% of its healing amount as damage. When used this way, Uther receives its self-healing benefits, its cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds, and it refunds 45 Mana.

Uther.title: Pursuit of Justice
Uther.description: Hammer of Justice increases Uther's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.

Uther.title: Holy Fire
Uther.description: Deal 13 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase this damage by 20% for 3 seconds. This can stack up to 3 times.

Uther.title: Armor of Faith
Uther.description: Being Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants Uther 90 Mana and causes Holy Light's cooldown to recharge 200% faster for 6 seconds. This effect has a 20 second cooldown.

Uther.title: Guardian of Ancient Kings
Uther.description: Healing a Hero with a Basic Ability that is Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants them 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

Uther.title: Hand of Protection
Uther.description: Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.

Uther.title: Divine Shield
Uther.description: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

Uther.title: Divine Storm
Uther.description: Deal 170 (+4% per level) damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.

Uther.title: Blessed Champion
Uther.description: For the next 5 seconds after using Holy Light, Uther's Basic Attacks heal him and nearby allied Heroes for 15% of the total amount healed by Holy Light.

Uther.title: Well Met
Uther.description: When used against Heroes, Hammer of Justice reduces the target's Movement Speed and damage dealt by 25% for 3 seconds.

Uther.title: Spell Shield
Uther.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

Uther.title: Beacon of Light
Uther.description: Uther receives 125% bonus self-healing when targeting others with Holy Light.  This bonus is increased to 250% while he is below 50% Health.

Uther.title: Tyr's Deliverance
Uther.description: Increase the damage and healing of Holy Radiance by 10%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes cause Uther's next cast of Holy Radiance to have its damage and healing increased by an additional 10%, stacking up to 7 times.

Uther.title: Benediction
Uther.description: Activate to reduce the Mana cost of Uther's next Basic Ability by 50 and its cooldown by 10 seconds.

Uther.title: Bulwark of Light
Uther.description: Divine Shield is also applied to all nearby allied Heroes and lasts 1 second longer.

Uther.title: Divine Hurricane
Uther.description: Divine Storm's radius is increased by 50% and its cooldown is reduced by 40 seconds.

Uther.title: Redemption
Uther.description: After Eternal Vanguard ends, Uther revives at the spirit's location with 50% of his maximum Health.  This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

Uther.title: Divine Protection
Uther.description: Increase Devotion Armor to 50 and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

Valeera.title: Vigor
Valeera.description: Valeera regenerates an additional 3 Energy per second.  Reward: After Gathering 20 Regen Globes, increase Valeera's maximum Energy to 120.

Valeera.title: Subtlety
Valeera.description: After teleporting with Ambush, Cheap Shot, or Garrote, regenerate 10 Energy per second for 5 seconds.

Valeera.title: Combat Readiness
Valeera.description: Each Combo Point spent grants 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing its damage by 75%. Stores up to 3 charges.

Valeera.title: Crippling Poison
Valeera.description: Activate to make Valeera's next damaging Ability and subsequent Abilities within 4 seconds Slow targets by 20% for 4 seconds.  Activating Crippling Poison does not break Stealth.
