Valeera.title: Relentless Strikes
Valeera.description: Reduces the Energy cost of Sinister Strike by 10.

Valeera.title: Hemorrhage
Valeera.description: Valeera's Basic Attacks deal 40% additional damage to enemies affected by Garrote.

Valeera.title: Initiative
Valeera.description: Ambush, Cheap Shot, and Garrote grant 15% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and award 2 Combo Points.

Valeera.title: Wound Poison
Valeera.description: Activate to make Valeera's next damaging Ability and subsequent Abilities within 4 seconds reduce enemy healing received by 50% for 4 seconds.  Activating Wound Poison does not break Stealth.

Valeera.title: Mutilate
Valeera.description: Sinister Strike now hits with both blades, dealing 125% additional damage, but its range is reduced by 1.

Valeera.title: Fatal Finesse
Valeera.description: Quest: Each time Blade Flurry damages an enemy Hero, its damage increases by 6, up to 90.  Reward: After damaging 15 Heroes with Blade Flurry, permanently reduce its Energy cost by 20.

Valeera.title: Slice and Dice
Valeera.description: Eviscerating an enemy with 3 Combo Points grants 150% Attack Speed. Lasts 3 seconds or 3 Basic Attacks.  Passive: Basic Attacks restore 2 Energy.

Valeera.title: Smoke Bomb
Valeera.description: Create a cloud of smoke. While in the smoke, Valeera is Unrevealable, can pass through other units, and gains 60 Armor, reducing damage taken by 60%. Valeera can continue to attack and use abilities without being revealed. Lasts 5 seconds.  Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

Valeera.title: Cloak of Shadows
Valeera.description: Valeera is enveloped in a Cloak of Shadows, which immediately removes all damage over time effects from her. For 1.5 seconds, she becomes Unstoppable and gains 75 Spell Armor, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.  Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

Valeera.title: Death From Above
Valeera.description: Teleporting with Ambush reduces the cooldown of Vanish by 4 seconds.

Valeera.title: Blind
Valeera.description: Increase the duration of Cheap Shot's Blind by 2.5 seconds.

Valeera.title: Strangle
Valeera.description: Using Garrote on a Hero reduces their Spell Power by 40% for 6 seconds.

Valeera.title: Seal Fate
Valeera.description: Sinister Strike deals 50% additional damage and generates an additional Combo Point when used against Silenced, Rooted, or Stunned enemy Heroes.

Valeera.title: Assassinate
Valeera.description: Ambush deals 50% additional damage and reduces the target's Armor by an additional 10 if no other enemy Heroes are within 4 range of the victim.

Valeera.title: Thistle Tea
Valeera.description: Activate to instantly restore 100 Energy.  Activating Thistle Tea does not break Stealth.

Valeera.title: Adrenaline Rush
Valeera.description: While in the Smoke Bomb, Valeera regenerates an additional 40 Energy per second.

Valeera.title: Enveloping Shadows
Valeera.description: Whenever Valeera uses Vanish, she also gains Cloak of Shadows.

Valeera.title: Rupture
Valeera.description: Increase Garrote's damage over time by 100%. Valeera's Basic Attacks refresh the duration of Garrote.

Valeera.title: Elusiveness
Valeera.description: Increases Valeera's Movement Speed while Vanished by an additional 20%.

Valla.title: Puncturing Arrow
Valla.description: Increase the number of Hungering Arrow bounces by 1.  Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Hungering Arrow refunds 40 Mana and permanently increases the damage of its initial impact by 6.

Valla.title: Fire At Will
Valla.description: Quest: Hitting a Hero with Multishot grants 2 Hatred and permanently increases its damage by 2.  Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes with Multishot, increase its damage by 40.

Valla.title: Creed of the Hunter
Valla.description: Quest: Every 50 Basic Attacks against Heroes increases Hatred's damage bonus per stack by 1%, up to 6%.  Gambit: Gain 25% bonus Attack Speed. Every death reduces this bonus by 5%.

Valla.title: Arsenal
Valla.description: Increase the range of Multishot by 20%. Multishot also fires 3 grenades that deal 100 (+4% per level) damage and refund 25 Mana after hitting enemy Heroes.

Valla.title: Death Dealer
Valla.description: Increase Vaults Basic Attack damage bonus from 6% to 15% per stack of Hatred. If this attack kills its victim within 1.5 seconds, the Mana cost and cooldown of Vault are refunded.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Vault by 5 seconds.

Valla.title: Repeating Arrow
Valla.description: Vault no longer has a Mana cost. Casting Vault resets the cooldown of Hungering Arrow.

Valla.title: Monster Hunter
Valla.description: Hungering Arrow deals 150% additional damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

Valla.title: Frost Shot
Valla.description: Multishot Slows enemies by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Hungering Arrows deals 25% more damage to Slowed enemies.

Valla.title: Hot Pursuit
Valla.description: Increase the Movement Speed bonus of each stack of Hatred to 2%.

Valla.title: Strafe
Valla.description: Rapidly attack enemies within 10 range for 60 (+4% per level) damage per hit, prioritizing Heroes over Minions. Valla is able to move and use Vault while strafing. Lasts for 4 seconds.

Valla.title: Rain of Vengeance
Valla.description: Launch a wave of Shadow Beasts that deals 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns enemies in the target area for 0.5 seconds.  Stores up to 2 charges.

Valla.title: Siphoning Arrows
Valla.description: Hitting a Hero with Hungering Arrow heals Valla for 4% of her maximum Health, and Multishot heals for 2%.

Valla.title: Tempered by Discipline
Valla.description: Basic Attacks heal for 10% of the damage dealt, increased by 2% per Hatred stack.

Valla.title: Gloom
Valla.description: Activate to consume all Hatred, granting 3 Spell Armor per Hatred consumed for 5 seconds.  Passive: Gain 15 Spell Armor, and each stack of Hatred heals for 1.2 (+4% per level) Health per second.

Valla.title: Punishment
Valla.description: While at max Hatred, Multishot's cooldown recharges 50% faster.

Valla.title: Seething Hatred
Valla.description: While at max Hatred, increase all damage dealt by 10%.

Valla.title: Manticore
Valla.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 5% of their maximum Health as damage.

Valla.title: Death Siphon
Valla.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Strafe increases its duration by 0.125 seconds. Strafe also fires penetrating bolts in a line for 34 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds.

Valla.title: Storm of Vengeance
Valla.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Rain of Vengeance by 5 seconds.  Passive: Each stack of Hatred increases your Attack Speed by 2%. While at max Hatred, gain an additional 30% Attack Speed.

Valla.title: Acrobat
Valla.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Vault. Drop 3 Caltrops while Vaulting that deal 60 (+4% per level) damage and Slow enemies by 40% for 1 second.

Valla.title: Farflight Quiver
Valla.description: Gain 20% Basic Attack range. While at max Hatred, gain an additional 30% Basic Attack range.

Varian.title: Lion's Maw
Varian.description: Quest: Every time Lion's Fang hits a Hero, increase its damage by 7, up to 175.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, the Slow is increased to 50% and its duration is increased to 2 seconds.

Varian.title: Overpower
Varian.description: When Parry blocks a Hero's Basic Attack, Heroic Strike's cooldown is refreshed and the next one does 40% more damage.

Varian.title: High King's Quest
Varian.description: Quest: Hit 50 Heroes with Basic Attacks. Quest: Participate in 5 Hero Takedowns. Quest: Gather 15 Regeneration Globes.  Reward: Completing a Quest grants 10 Base Attack Damage. Completing all 3 Quests grants an additional 30 Base Attack Damage.

Varian.title: Taunt
Varian.description: Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds.  Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.

Varian.title: Colossus Smash
Varian.description: Smash a target enemy, dealing 185 (+4% per level) damage and lowering their Armor by 25 for 3 seconds, causing them to take 25% increased damage.  Passive: Base Attack Damage increased by 100%. Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration reduced by 10%.

Varian.title: Twin Blades of Fury
Varian.description: Basic Attacks reduce Heroic Strike's cooldown by 9 seconds, and increase Varian's Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.  Passive: Attack Speed increased by 100%. Passive: Base Attack Damage reduced by 25%.

Varian.title: Lionheart
Varian.description: Increase Lion's Fang's healing from Heroes by 75%.

Varian.title: Second Wind
Varian.description: Basic Attacks heal Varian for 1% of his maximum Health. While below 50% Health, they also heal him for 50% of the damage dealt.

Varian.title: Victory Rush
Varian.description: Every 30 seconds, Varian's next Basic Attack will heal him for 350 (+4% per level) Health. When a nearby enemy Minion or Monster dies, the cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

Varian.title: Shield Wall
Varian.description: Parry grants Protected, preventing all incoming damage while active. Additionally, Parry's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds, but it loses 1 charge.

Varian.title: Warbringer
Varian.description: Reduce Charge's cooldown by 8 seconds and Mana cost from 45 to 22. Additionally, Charge can be cast on allied Heroes.

Varian.title: Juggernaut
Varian.description: Charge deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 4% of their maximum Health.

Varian.title: Mortal Strike
Varian.description: Heroes hit by Heroic Strike receive 40% reduced healing for 4 seconds.

Varian.title: Shattering Throw
Varian.description: Activate to throw a sword at a target Hero that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage, and up to 1400 (+4% per level) bonus damage to their Shields.  Passive: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal up to 200% bonus Physical Damage to Shields.

Varian.title: Banner of Stormwind
Varian.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 25% increased Movement Speed to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.

Varian.title: Banner of Ironforge
Varian.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 20 Armor to nearby allied Heroes, reducing damage taken by 20%. Lasts 12 seconds.

Varian.title: Banner of Dalaran
Varian.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 20% increased Spell Power to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.

Varian.title: Vigilance
Varian.description: Being hit by a Hero Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Taunt by 1 second.

Varian.title: Master at Arms
Varian.description: Colossus Smash affects all enemies near the target, and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

Varian.title: Frenzy
Varian.description: Twin Blades of Fury increases Heroic Strike damage by an additional 25%, and Basic Attacks increase his Movement Speed by an additional 10%.

Varian.title: Glory to the Alliance
Varian.description: Banner now also increases health regeneration and all healing received for nearby allied Heroes by 50%, and the cooldown is reduced by 50%.

Varian.title: Demoralizing Shout
Varian.description: Activate to demoralize nearby enemy Heroes, reducing damage they deal by 40% for 5 seconds.

Whitemane.title: Pity the Frail
Whitemane.description: For every Hero hit with Searing Lash, lower the cooldown of Inquisition by 1.5 seconds. Allies below 30% Health receive 25% more healing from Whitemane.

Whitemane.title: Righteous Flame
Whitemane.description: Searing Lash deals 25% more damage to enemies. If the second strike hits an enemy Hero, they take an additional 25% damage and Whitemane gains 40% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

Whitemane.title: Inquisitor's Prayer
Whitemane.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Searing Lash.  Reward: Each Hero hit grants 3 permanent Health and 2 permanent Mana. Heroes hit with the second strike count as 2 hits.

Whitemane.title: Unwavering Faith
Whitemane.description: Increase Whitemane's Basic Attack range by 1.1. Whitemane gains 20% increased Basic Attack damage for each active Zeal buff.

Whitemane.title: Martyrdom
Whitemane.description: Desperate Plea's healing is increased by 30%. Increase this by an additional 10% for each active Zeal.

Whitemane.title: Indulgence
Whitemane.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Increase this by an additional 5% for each active Zeal.

Whitemane.title: Zealous Spirit
Whitemane.description: Upon reaching 2 stacks of Desperation, Whitemane gains Zeal.

Whitemane.title: Saintly Greatstaff
Whitemane.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Searing Lash are marked for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks against them deal an additional 55 (+4% per level) Spell damage and remove the mark.

Whitemane.title: Intercession
Whitemane.description: Activate to make an ally Unstoppable for 1 second.

Whitemane.title: Scarlet Aegis
Whitemane.description: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 (+4% per level) and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

Whitemane.title: Divine Reckoning
Whitemane.description: After 1 second, consecrate an area for 4 seconds, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies inside. 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes is returned as Mana.

Whitemane.title: Subjugation
Whitemane.description: Inquisition reduces all damage the target deals by 50%.

Whitemane.title: Lashing Out
Whitemane.description: If Searing Lash's second strike hits an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown to 1 second.

Whitemane.title: Scarlet Wrath
Whitemane.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes increase the duration of all active Zeals by 0.75 seconds and lower the cooldown of Zeals activation by 4 seconds.

Whitemane.title: Radiance
Whitemane.description: Reaching 3 stacks of Desperation heals for 175 (+4% per level) and reapplies Zeal to allies with Zeal.

Whitemane.title: Shared Punishment
Whitemane.description: Upon casting, Inquisition can chain to an additional enemy Hero near its target, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds. Affected enemies lose 10 Armor.

Whitemane.title: Harsh Discipline
Whitemane.description: Hitting a Hero with Searing Lash while they are being targeted by Inquisition Roots them for 1.5 seconds.  Passive: Reduce Inquisition's cooldown by 2 seconds.

Whitemane.title: Scarlet Crusade
Whitemane.description: Scarlet Aegis heals for 50% more and makes affected allies Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

Whitemane.title: Judgment Day
Whitemane.description: Divine Reckoning deals 50% more damage and pulls enemies to its center the first time it hits them.

Whitemane.title: Guiding Light
Whitemane.description: Activate to cast a permanent Zeal on an allied Hero that costs no Mana and doesn't grant Desperation. Only one can be active at a time and has global cast range.

Whitemane.title: Purge the Wicked
Whitemane.description: Activate to blast an enemy Hero with holy fire, reducing their Armor by 25 and dealing 300 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds.

Xul.title: Backlash
Xul.description: When Bone Armor expires, nearby enemy Heroes take damage equal to 12% of their maximum Health.

Xul.title: Shackler
Xul.description: While Bone Armor is active, nearby enemies are Slowed by 35% for 1 second. Basic Attacks against Heroes that are Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed reduce the cooldown of Bone Armor by 2 seconds.

Xul.title: Shade
Xul.description: While Bone Armor is active, Xul evades all Basic Attacks, but increases the cooldown of Bone Armor by 10 seconds.

Xul.title: Reaper's Toll
Xul.description: Reduce the cooldown of Spectral Scythe by 2 seconds and its Mana cost by 15.

Xul.title: Grim Scythe
Xul.description: Increase Xul's Basic Attack damage by 15%.  Each enemy hit by Cursed Strikes reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 12 seconds.

Xul.title: Jailors
Xul.description: Bone Prison spawns 2 Skeletal Warriors.  These do not count towards Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum.  Quest: Spawn 80 Skeletal Warriors.  Reward: While fixating on an enemy, Skeletal Warriors gain 25% Movement and Attack Speed.

Xul.title: Harvest Vitality
Xul.description: Cursed Strikes heals for 70% of the damage dealt to Heroes.

Xul.title: Trag'Oul's Essence
Xul.description: Every time a Skeletal Warrior attacks an enemy, restore 0.5% of Xul's maximum Health and 0.2% of his maximum Mana.

Xul.title: Wall Of Bones
Xul.description: Increase the Shield amount of Bone Armor to 35% of Xul's maximum Health, and Xul gains 20 Spell Armor for its duration.

Xul.title: Poison Nova
Xul.description: After 0.5 seconds, release poisonous missiles that deal 630 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies hit over 10 seconds.

Xul.title: Skeletal Mages
Xul.description: Vector Targeting Summon 4 Frost Mages in a line that attack nearby enemies for 47 (+4% per level) damage a second and Slow them by 30% for 2 seconds. Last up to 15 seconds.

Xul.title: Echoes of Death
Xul.description: Spectral Scythe spawns 2 additional scythes next to the first after 1.5 seconds, dealing 40% damage.

Xul.title: Rapid Harvest
Xul.description: Gain 5% Attack Speed for 3 seconds each time Cursed Strikes hits an enemy, up to 75%.

Xul.title: Amplify Damage
Xul.description: Increase the Root duration of Bone Prison by 0.25 seconds.  Enemies Rooted by Bone Prison lose 25 Armor for 2 seconds.

Xul.title: Decrepify
Xul.description: Enemy Heroes that are damaged by Spectral Scythe or Skeletal Warriors are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

Xul.title: Weaken
Xul.description: Enemy Heroes who are damaged by Cursed Strikes or Skeletal Warriors deal 35% less damage for 3 seconds.

Xul.title: Bone Spear
Xul.description: Deal 230 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line.

Xul.title: Andariel's Visage
Xul.description: Poison Nova heals for 50% of the damage dealt and its duration is increased by 50%.

Xul.title: Cold Hand of Death
Xul.description: Increase the Slow of Frost Mages by 20%.   Every 5th Spectral Scythe that hits enemy Heroes spawns a Frost Mage instead of a Skeletal Warrior at their location.

Xul.title: Mortal Wound
Xul.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Spectral Scythe receive 75% less healing for 4 seconds.

Xul.title: Kalan's Edict
Xul.description: Each time Skeletal Warriors deal damage, reduce the cooldown of Bone Armor and Xul's Heroic Ability by 1.5%.

Yrel.title: Light of Karabor
Yrel.description: Increase Vindication's radius by 15%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Vindication's healing by 45%. If more than one Hero is hit, the bonus is increased to 90%.

Yrel.title: Dauntless
Yrel.description: Casting a Basic Ability grants Yrel 35 Physical Armor for 2.5 seconds.

Yrel.title: Maraad's Insight
Yrel.description: After damaging an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack heals her for 140 (+4% per level).

Yrel.title: Aegis of Light
Yrel.description: Upon landing, Avenging Wrath grants other nearby allied Heroes 30 Armor for 4 seconds.

Yrel.title: Gift of the Naaru
Yrel.description: Divine Purpose heals the lowest Health nearby allied Hero other than Yrel for 275 (+4% per level).

Yrel.title: Hand of Freedom
Yrel.description: Grant an allied Hero 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and remove all Slows and Roots from them.

Yrel.title: Righteous Momentum
Yrel.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Yrel is no longer Slowed while Channeling Righteous Hammer, and instead this bonus is quadrupled.

Yrel.title: Holy Avenger
Yrel.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Avenging Wrath at maximum charge deals 25% more damage and reduces its cooldown to 1 second.

Yrel.title: Divine Steed
Yrel.description: Mounting is instant and grants 60% Movement Speed that decays over 3 seconds.

Yrel.title: Ardent Defender
Yrel.description: Surround Yrel in a barrier for 3 seconds, absorbing all damage taken and healing her for 50% of the damage received.

Yrel.title: Sacred Ground
Yrel.description: Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.

Yrel.title: Aldor Peacekeeper
Yrel.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Vindication at maximum charge deal 40% less damage for 3 seconds.

Yrel.title: Repentance
Yrel.description: Increase Avenging Wrath's Slow by 25% and duration by 0.75 seconds.

Yrel.title: Velen's Chosen
Yrel.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability at maximum charge grants 10% Spell Power for 10 seconds, up to 30%.

Yrel.title: Templar's Verdict
Yrel.description: Righteous Hammer reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 20 for 4 seconds and deals bonus damage equal to 7% of their maximum Health.

Yrel.title: Divine Favor
Yrel.description: Casting a Basic Ability reduces the cooldown of Divine Purpose by 2.5 seconds.

Yrel.title: Holy Wrath
Yrel.description: After casting a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack splashes for 35% increased damage around the target.

Yrel.title: Word of Glory
Yrel.description: Increase the amount that Yrel heals from damage received from 50% to 75%. Ardent Defender heals nearby allied Heroes for 100% of the healing received by Yrel.

Yrel.title: Hallowed Ground
Yrel.description: Casting Avenging Wrath while inside Sacred Ground moves Sacred Ground to Yrel's location upon landing.

Yrel.title: Bubble Hearth
Yrel.description: After 1 second, Yrel becomes Invulnerable and casts Hearthstone. Cannot be canceled.

Yrel.title: Seraphim
Yrel.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

Zagara.title: Volatile Acid
Zagara.description: Banelings can travel 50% further before exploding.

Zagara.title: Corpse Feeders
Zagara.description: Reduces the cooldown of Infested Drop by 3 seconds and Roachlings have 30% more Health.

Zagara.title: Infest
Zagara.description: Nearby Ranged Minions deal an additional 125% damage, plus an additional 1% per 1000 Siege damage Zagara has dealt. Can be toggled on or off.

Zagara.title: Envenomed Spines
Zagara.description: Activate to have Zagara's next Basic Attack apply 230 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds.

Zagara.title: Medusa Blades
Zagara.description: Basic Attacks deal 33% damage to three nearby targets.

Zagara.title: Serrated Spines
Zagara.description: Quest: Each Basic Attack against a Hero increases Zagara's Attack Damage by 0.2%.

Zagara.title: Baneling Massacre
Zagara.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Banelings Barrage, but increase its cooldown by 2 seconds.

Zagara.title: Viscous Acid
Zagara.description: Banelings Slow enemies by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

Zagara.title: Bile Drop
Zagara.description: Quest: Passively increases the radius of Infested Drop by 20%.  Reward: After hitting 12 Heroes with Infested Drop, it spawns an additional Roachling.

Zagara.title: Devouring Maw
Zagara.description: Summon a Devouring Maw that devours enemies for 4 seconds. Devoured enemies cannot fight and take 94 (+4% per level) damage per second.  Usable on Unstoppable enemies.

Zagara.title: Nydus Network
Zagara.description: Summon a Nydus Worm on Creep anywhere that Zagara has vision. Zagara can enter a Nydus Worm and travel to any other Nydus Worm by right-clicking near it. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara regenerates 10% Health and Mana per second.  Stores up to 2 charges. Maximum of 4 Nydus Worms at a time.  Passive: Creep spreads 15% farther.  Passive: While on Creep, each Basic Attack reduces all of Zagara's cooldowns by 0.4 seconds.

Zagara.title: Hydralisk Transfusion
Zagara.description: Zagara is healed for 60% of the damage dealt by Hunter Killers' Basic Attacks to Heroes.

Zagara.title: Protective Coating
Zagara.description: While on Creep, Zagara gains 20 Armor, taking 20% less damage.

Zagara.title: Spell Shield
Zagara.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

Zagara.title: Corrosive Saliva
Zagara.description: When attacking Heroes, Hunter Killers and Roachlings deal additional damage equal to 1.75% of their maximum Health.

Zagara.title: Mutalisk
Zagara.description: Reduce the cooldown of Hunter Killer by 4 seconds.  Hunter Killer now spawns a Mutalisk. Mutalisks have a bounce attack and last for 30 seconds.

Zagara.title: Jagged Barbs
Zagara.description: While on Creep, Zagara gains 50% more Basic Attack damage and her attack range is increased by 1.1.

Zagara.title: Tyrant Maw
Zagara.description: Devouring Maw deals 50% more damage. Takedowns reduce its cooldown by 25 seconds.

Zagara.title: Endless Creep
Zagara.description: The cast range for Creep Tumor is increased by 2000%. Creep Tumors now last 600 seconds. While on Creep, Zagara gains an additional 10% Movement Speed.

Zagara.title: Broodmother
Zagara.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack also launches a Baneling towards the target.  Passive: Gain 20% bonus Attack Speed.

Zagara.title: Pack Instinct
Zagara.description: Zagara and her summons deal 20% more damage to enemies attacked by a Hunter Killer in the last 2 seconds.

Zarya.title: Demolitions Expert
Zarya.description: Quest: For every 5 enemy Heroes hit by Particle Grenade, its recharge rate lowers by 0.4375 seconds, up to 3.5 seconds.  Reward: Once Particle Grenade has hit 40 enemy Heroes, its radius is increased by 15%.

Zarya.title: Together We Are Strong
Zarya.description: For 3 seconds after gaining Shield Ally, every 5.35 (+4% per level) damage done by the bearer contributes 1 Energy to Zarya, up to 40 Energy per Shield.

Zarya.title: Feel the Heat
Zarya.description: Zarya's Basic Attack deals 50% additional damage to enemies in melee range. While above 40 Energy, Zarya's Basic Attack size is increased by 35%.

Zarya.title: Maximum Charge
Zarya.description: Regen Globes now instantly grant 20 Energy.  Quest: Spend 150 seconds at or above 50 Energy.  Reward: Gain an additional 20 maximum Energy.

Zarya.title: I Am the Strongest
Zarya.description: Personal Barrier absorbs an additional 140 (+4% per level) damage.  Passive: Damage absorbed by Zarya's Shields contributes 20% more Energy.

Zarya.title: Give Me Twenty
Zarya.description: Quest: Regeneration Globes increase Shield Ally absorb amount by 15, up to 300 permanently.  Reward: After collecting 20 Regen Globes, permanently reduce the cooldown of Shield Ally by 2 seconds.

Zarya.title: Speed Barrier
Zarya.description: Shield Ally increases the allied Hero's Movement Speed by 50% for the duration.

Zarya.title: Defensive Shielding
Zarya.description: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier and Shield Ally grant 75 Physical Armor against the next 2 Hero Basic Attacks for 6 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

Zarya.title: Pinpoint Accuracy
Zarya.description: Particle Grenade deals 30 (+4% per level) more damage and Slows Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds to enemies hit by the center of the blast.

Zarya.title: Deep Burn
Zarya.description: Hitting a Hero with Particle Grenade causes Basic Attacks against them to generate 2 Energy. Lasts 3 seconds.

Zarya.title: Explosive Barrier
Zarya.description: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier explodes, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

Zarya.title: Graviton Surge
Zarya.description: Launch a gravity bomb that detonates after 1 second and draws enemy Heroes toward the center for 2.5 seconds. Affected Heroes take 30 (+4% per level) damage a second.

Zarya.title: Expulsion Zone
Zarya.description: Launch a gravity bomb that deals 124 (+4% per level) damage and creates an expulsion zone for 3.5 seconds. Enemies who enter the affected area are knocked back and have their Movement Speed reduced by 50% for 1 second.

Zarya.title: Unstoppable Competitor
Zarya.description: Personal Barrier makes Zarya Unstoppable for up to 2 seconds.

Zarya.title: Spell Barrier
Zarya.description: Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier grants Zarya 75 Spell Armor for 3 Seconds, reducing the damage taken from Abilities by 75%.

Zarya.title: Endurance Training
Zarya.description: While at or above 75 Energy, Zarya gains 20 Armor, reducing all damage taken by 20%.

Zarya.title: Pain is Temporary
Zarya.description: Activate to consume all Energy and gain a Shield that absorbs 0.5% of Zarya's maximum Health per Energy consumed and lasts for 3 seconds. Zarya may only have one personal Shield active on herself at a time.

Zarya.title: Cleansing Shield
Zarya.description: Causes Shield Ally to remove all disabling effects and reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

Zarya.title: Gain Train
Zarya.description: Shield Ally now grants an untalented Shield to a nearby ally upon impact.

Zarya.title: Born in Battle
Zarya.description: While at or above 75 Energy, Zarya's cooldowns regenerate 25% faster.

Zarya.title: Gravity Kills
Zarya.description: Increases Graviton Surge's duration by 1 second and it Silences Heroes caught in its area.

Zarya.title: Clear Out
Zarya.description: Reduce Expulsion Zone's cooldown by 25 seconds and increase its duration by 1.5 seconds.

Zarya.title: Grenadier
Zarya.description: All Particle Grenade charges are returned at once.

Zarya.title: Unyielding Defender
Zarya.description: Activate to reset the cooldown of Personal Barrier and Shield Ally.

Zeratul.title: Greater Cleave
Zeratul.description: Increases the radius of Cleave by 33%.

Zeratul.title: Shadow Hunter
Zeratul.description: Quest: Gather Regeneration Globes to lower the Mana cost of Blink by 3, up to 45.  Reward: Upon gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Blink by 1.5 seconds.

Zeratul.title: Move Unseen
Zeratul.description: Reduce the cooldown of Permanent Cloak by 1 second. Gain 30% Movement Speed while Stealthed.

Zeratul.title: Rending Cleave
Zeratul.description: Cleave deals an additional 40% damage over 3 seconds.

Zeratul.title: Psionic Strength
Zeratul.description: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes increases all damage dealt by 6% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 30%.

Zeratul.title: Darkness Descends
Zeratul.description: Activate to gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.  Passive: Gain 20% Attack Speed.

Zeratul.title: Wormhole
Zeratul.description: After 1.25 seconds, reactivate Blink to return to the point where it was cast from within 4 seconds.

Zeratul.title: Seeker In the Dark
Zeratul.description: Singularity Spike takes 50% longer to explode. It can be reactivated to teleport to the target, granting 30% increased Move Speed for 3 seconds.

Zeratul.title: Warp Skirmisher
Zeratul.description: Vorpal Blade gains a 2nd charge. Teleporting to an enemy with Vorpal Blade or entering Permanent Cloak causes Zeratul's next Basic Attack to deal 50% more damage.

Zeratul.title: Might of the Nerazim
Zeratul.description: Activate to cast an untalented version of Zeratul's most recently used Basic Ability, dealing 50% less damage.  Passive: After using an Ability, Zeratul's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 30% more damage.

Zeratul.title: Void Prison
Zeratul.description: Slows time in an area to a near standstill, placing allies and enemies in Time Stop for 5 seconds. Zeratul is not affected.

Zeratul.title: Shroud of Adun
Zeratul.description: Zeratul gains a Shield equal to 20% of his Maximum Health over 3 seconds while under Permanent Cloak.

Zeratul.title: Mending Strikes
Zeratul.description: Basic Attacks heal for 35% of the damage dealt.

Zeratul.title: Spell Shield
Zeratul.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

Zeratul.title: Master Warp-Blade
Zeratul.description: Every third consecutive Basic Attack against the same target deals 125% bonus damage.

Zeratul.title: Void Slash
Zeratul.description: If Cleave hits more than one enemy Hero, it deals 40% increased damage and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

Zeratul.title: Sentenced to Death
Zeratul.description: Deal 25% increased damage to enemies while they are marked or Slowed by Singularity Spike.

Zeratul.title: Twilight Falls
Zeratul.description: Might of the Nerazim resets the cooldown of all Basic Abilities.

Zeratul.title: Unwavering Pressure
Zeratul.description: Singularity Spike no longer costs Mana. Basic Attacks against enemies reduce its cooldown by 1.25 seconds, double versus Heroes.

Zeratul.title: Shadow Stride
Zeratul.description: Reduce the cooldown of Vorpal Blade by 10 seconds. Casting Vorpal Blade grants Zeratul a Shield that absorbs up to 260 (+4% per level) damage for 3 seconds.

Zeratul.title: Shadow Mending
Zeratul.description: Heal for 60% of Spell Damage dealt to Heroes.

Zul'jin.title: Boneslicer
Zul'jin.description: Grievous Throw now pierces through all enemies hit and restores 15 Mana per Hero hit. Additionally, Grievous Throw's mark is no longer removed by Basic Attacks.

Zul'jin.title: Recklessness
Zul'jin.description: While Zul'jin is below 75% Health, he gains 10% Spell Power. While he is below 50% Health, his Basic Attack damage is increased by 15% and Basic Attacks against Heroes grant an additional stack of You Want Axe?.

Zul'jin.title: Headhunter
Zul'jin.description: Quest: Zul'jin's first Takedown against each enemy Hero permanently increases his damage dealt by 2%.  Reward: After getting Takedowns on every enemy Hero, Basic Attack range is increased by 1.1.

Zul'jin.title: Troll's Blood
Zul'jin.description: Increase Regeneration's healing by 25%. If Regeneration fully finishes, restore 10% of Zul'jin's maximum Mana.

Zul'jin.title: Voodoo Shuffle
Zul'jin.description: Activate to remove Roots and Slows.  Passive: Lower the cooldown and Mana cost of Regeneration by 40%.

Zul'jin.title: Amani Hide
Zul'jin.description: Lower the cooldown of Amani Rage by 10 seconds and gain 15 Armor while regenerating Health from it.

Zul'jin.title: Vicious Assault
Zul'jin.description: Increase the duration of Grievous Throw's mark by 3 seconds and its damage bonus by 45%.

Zul'jin.title: Arcanite Axes
Zul'jin.description: Quest: Twin Cleave's damage is permanently increased by 0.75 every time it hits a Hero.

Zul'jin.title: Ferocity
Zul'jin.description: Increases the Attack Speed bonus of Berserker by 40%.

Zul'jin.title: Taz'dingo!
Zul'jin.description: For the next 4 seconds, Zul'jin is Unkillable, and cannot be reduced to less than 1 Health. Taz'dingo!

Zul'jin.title: Guillotine
Zul'jin.description: Zul'jin launches a massive axe into the air that drops on the targeted area, dealing 330 (+4% per level) damage plus bonus damage the lower his Health is.

Zul'jin.title: Lacerate
Zul'jin.description: Increase the Slow amount of each Twin Cleave axe by 10% and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

Zul'jin.title: Eye of Zul'jin
Zul'jin.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant Zul'jin 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%.

Zul'jin.title: Ensnare
Zul'jin.description: Throw a net forward, Rooting the first enemy Hero hit for 1.5 seconds. If no Heroes are hit, Ensnare's cooldown is reduced to 10 seconds.

Zul'jin.title: No Mercy!
Zul'jin.description: Zul'jin's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes marked with Grievous Throw ignore Armor and deal an additional 2% of maximum Health as damage.

Zul'jin.title: Wrong Place Wrong Time
Zul'jin.description: If an enemy is hit by both Twin Cleave axes at the same time, they take an additional 100 (+4% per level) damage and count as 5 Hero hits for You Want Axe?.

Zul'jin.title: Let the Killing Begin
Zul'jin.description: When Zul'jin kills an enemy, his Attack Speed is increased by 5%, up to 40%, for 12 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh the duration.  Hero Takedowns instantly grant 40% Attack Speed.

Zul'jin.title: Amani Resilience
Zul'jin.description: Increase Taz'dingo's duration by 1 second. Upon expiring, Zul'jin heals for 50% of the damage he dealt during Taz'dingo.

Zul'jin.title: Buzzsaw
Zul'jin.description: After impact, Guillotine continues forward, dealing 75% damage to enemies hit. If a Hero is killed by Guillotine, Zul'jin is instantly healed to full.

Zul'jin.title: Forest Medicine
Zul'jin.description: Regeneration is no longer Channeled, and cannot be interrupted.

Zul'jin.title: A Surprise For Ya
Zul'jin.description: Basic Attacks bounce to a nearby enemy for 50% damage, prioritizing enemy Heroes.
